edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was among the exiles by the River Chebar, the heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בָּרְבִיעִי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹדֶשׁ וַאֲנִי בְתוֹךְ־הַגּוֹלָה עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָר נִפְתְּחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וָאֶרְאֶה מַרְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s exile—
verses.hebrew: בַּחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹדֶשׁ הִיא הַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁית לְגָלוּת הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹיָכִין׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word indeed came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; YHWH’s hand was upon him there.
verses.hebrew: הָיֹה הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־יְחֶזְקֵאל בֶּן־בּוּזִי הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָר וַתְּהִי עָלָיו שָׁם יַד־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: I looked, and behold, a storm wind was coming from the north: a great cloud and fire flashing continually, with brightness around it; from within it, from within the fire, was something like the gleam of ḥashmal.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה רוּחַ סְעָרָה בָּאָה מִן־הַצָּפוֹן עָנָן גָּדוֹל וְאֵשׁ מִתְלַקַּחַת וְנֹגַהּ לוֹ סָבִיב וּמִתּוֹכָהּ כְּעֵין הַחַשְׁמַל מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

verses.english: From within it appeared the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: they had a human likeness.
verses.hebrew: וּמִתּוֹכָהּ דְּמוּת אַרְבַּע חַיּוֹת וְזֶה מַרְאֵיהֶן דְּמוּת אָדָם לָהֵנָּה׃

verses.english: Each had four faces, and each of them had four wings.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה פָנִים לְאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע כְּנָפַיִם לְאַחַת לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a calf’s foot. They sparkled with the gleam of burnished bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְרַגְלֵיהֶם רֶגֶל יְשָׁרָה וְכַף רַגְלֵיהֶם כְּכַף רֶגֶל עֵגֶל וְנֹצְצִים כְּעֵין נְחֹשֶׁת קָלָל׃

verses.english: A human hand was beneath their wings on their four sides; and their faces and their wings belonged to all four of them.
verses.hebrew: וידו [וִידֵי] אָדָם מִתַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶם עַל אַרְבַּעַת רִבְעֵיהֶם וּפְנֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם׃

verses.english: Their wings joined one to another. They did not turn as they went; each went straight toward its face.
verses.hebrew: חֹבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָהּ כַּנְפֵיהֶם לֹא־יִסַּבּוּ בְלֶכְתָּן אִישׁ אֶל־עֵבֶר פָּנָיו יֵלֵכוּ׃

verses.english: The likeness of their faces was a human face; all four had a lion’s face on the right, all four an ox’s face on the left, and all four an eagle’s face.
verses.hebrew: וּדְמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם פְּנֵי אָדָם וּפְנֵי אַרְיֵה אֶל־הַיָּמִין לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם וּפְנֵי־שׁוֹר מֵהַשְּׂמֹאול לְאַרְבַּעְתָּן וּפְנֵי־נֶשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּעְתָּן׃

verses.english: Their faces and their wings were separated above; each had two wings joining another’s, and two covering their bodies.
verses.hebrew: וּפְנֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם פְּרֻדוֹת מִלְמָעְלָה לְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם חֹבְרוֹת אִישׁ וּשְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת אֵת גְּוִיֹתֵיהֶנָה׃

verses.english: Each went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. They did not turn as they went.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶל־עֵבֶר פָּנָיו יֵלֵכוּ אֶל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָׁמָּה הָרוּחַ לָלֶכֶת יֵלֵכוּ לֹא יִסַּבּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּן׃

verses.english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. It moved among the living creatures; the fire had brightness, and lightning came out of the fire.
verses.hebrew: וּדְמוּת הַחַיּוֹת מַרְאֵיהֶם כְּגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ בֹּעֲרוֹת כְּמַרְאֵה הַלַּפִּדִים הִיא מִתְהַלֶּכֶת בֵּין הַחַיּוֹת וְנֹגַהּ לָאֵשׁ וּמִן־הָאֵשׁ יוֹצֵא בָרָק׃

verses.english: I looked at the living creatures, and behold, one wheel was on the earth beside the living creatures, by its four faces.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא הַחַיּוֹת וְהִנֵּה אוֹפַן אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֵצֶל הַחַיּוֹת לְאַרְבַּעַת פָּנָיו׃

verses.english: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship was like the gleam of tarshish; all four had one likeness. Their appearance and workmanship was as though a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.hebrew: מַרְאֵה הָאוֹפַנִּים וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם כְּעֵין תַּרְשִׁישׁ וּדְמוּת אֶחָד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּן וּמַרְאֵיהֶם וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הָאוֹפַן בְּתוֹךְ הָאוֹפָן׃

verses.english: As they went, they went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went.
verses.hebrew: עַל־אַרְבַּעַת רִבְעֵיהֶן בְּלֶכְתָּם יֵלֵכוּ לֹא יִסַּבּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּן׃

verses.english: Their rims were high and awe-inspiring; the rims of all four were full of eyes all around.
verses.hebrew: וְגַבֵּיהֶן וְגֹבַהּ לָהֶם וְיִרְאָה לָהֶם וְגַבֹּתָם מְלֵאֹת עֵינַיִם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּן׃

verses.english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.
verses.hebrew: וּבְלֶכֶת הַחַיּוֹת יֵלְכוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים אֶצְלָם וּבְהִנָּשֵׂא הַחַיּוֹת מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ יִנָּשְׂאוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים׃

verses.english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went—there the spirit was to go—and the wheels rose alongside them, for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.hebrew: עַל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם הָרוּחַ לָלֶכֶת יֵלֵכוּ שָׁמָּה הָרוּחַ לָלֶכֶת וְהָאוֹפַנִּים יִנָּשְׂאוּ לְעֻמָּתָם כִּי רוּחַ הַחַיָּה בָּאוֹפַנִּים׃

verses.english: When they went, these went; when they stood, these stood; when they rose from the earth, the wheels rose alongside them, for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֶכְתָּם יֵלֵכוּ וּבְעָמְדָם יַעֲמֹדוּ וּבְהִנָּשְׂאָם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ יִנָּשְׂאוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם כִּי רוּחַ הַחַיָּה בָּאוֹפַנִּים׃

verses.english: Over the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an expanse, like the gleam of awe-inspiring ice, stretched out above their heads.
verses.hebrew: וּדְמוּת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הַחַיָּה רָקִיעַ כְּעֵין הַקֶּרַח הַנּוֹרָא נָטוּי עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: Beneath the expanse their wings were straight, one toward another; each had two covering them, and each had two covering them—their bodies.
verses.hebrew: וְתַחַת הָרָקִיעַ כַּנְפֵיהֶם יְשָׁרוֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת לָהֵנָּה וּלְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת לָהֵנָּה אֵת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I heard the sound of their wings as they went, like the sound of many waters, like the voice of Shaddai—a sound of tumult, like the sound of an army. When they stood, they lowered their wings.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־קוֹל כַּנְפֵיהֶם כְּקוֹל מַיִם רַבִּים כְּקוֹל־שַׁדַּי בְּלֶכְתָּם קוֹל הֲמֻלָּה כְּקוֹל מַחֲנֶה בְּעָמְדָם תְּרַפֶּינָה כַנְפֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: A voice came from above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they lowered their wings.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־קוֹל מֵעַל לָרָקִיעַ אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשָׁם בְּעָמְדָם תְּרַפֶּינָה כַנְפֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: Above the expanse over their heads was something like the appearance of a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne; above the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the appearance of a human being upon it.
verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּעַל לָרָקִיעַ אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשָׁם כְּמַרְאֵה אֶבֶן־סַפִּיר דְּמוּת כִּסֵּא וְעַל דְּמוּת הַכִּסֵּא דְּמוּת כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: I saw something like the gleam of ḥashmal, like the appearance of fire enclosed around it, from the appearance of His waist upward; and from the appearance of His waist downward I saw something like the appearance of fire, with brightness around Him.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא כְּעֵין חַשְׁמַל כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵשׁ בֵּית־לָהּ סָבִיב מִמַּרְאֵה מָתְנָיו וּלְמָעְלָה וּמִמַּרְאֵה מָתְנָיו וּלְמַטָּה רָאִיתִי כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵשׁ וְנֹגַהּ לוֹ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: Like the appearance of the rainbow in the cloud on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the brightness around Him. This was the appearance of the likeness of YHWH’s glory. I saw it, fell upon my face, and heard a voice speaking.
verses.hebrew: כְּמַרְאֵה הַקֶּשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בֶעָנָן בְּיוֹם הַגֶּשֶׁם כֵּן מַרְאֵה הַנֹּגַהּ סָבִיב הוּא מַרְאֵה דְּמוּת כְּבוֹד־יְהוָה וָאֶרְאֶה וָאֶפֹּל עַל־פָּנַי וָאֶשְׁמַע קוֹל מְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֶּן־אָדָם עֲמֹד עַל־רַגְלֶיךָ וַאֲדַבֵּר אֹתָךְ׃

verses.english: A spirit entered me as He spoke to me and set me on my feet; I heard the One speaking to me.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא בִי רוּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלַי וַתַּעֲמִדֵנִי עַל־רַגְלָי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֵת מִדַּבֵּר אֵלָי׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to the rebellious nations that have rebelled against Me. They and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם שׁוֹלֵחַ אֲנִי אוֹתְךָ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גּוֹיִם הַמּוֹרְדִים אֲשֶׁר מָרְדוּ־בִי הֵמָּה וַאֲבוֹתָם פָּשְׁעוּ בִי עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: The sons are hard-faced and strong-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH.’
verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּנִים קְשֵׁי פָנִים וְחִזְקֵי־לֵב אֲנִי שׁוֹלֵחַ אוֹתְךָ אֲלֵיהֶם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: Whether they listen or refrain—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּלוּ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי נָבִיא הָיָה בְתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, do not fear them, and do not fear their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you dwell among scorpions. Do not fear their words or be dismayed at their faces, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם אַל־תִּירָא מֵהֶם וּמִדִּבְרֵיהֶם אַל־תִּירָא כִּי סָרָבִים וְסַלּוֹנִים אוֹתָךְ וְאֶל־עַקְרַבִּים אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב מִדִּבְרֵיהֶם אַל־תִּירָא וּמִפְּנֵיהֶם אַל־תֵּחָת כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Speak My words to them, whether they listen or refrain, for they are rebellious.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶת־דְּבָרַי אֲלֵיהֶם אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּלוּ כִּי מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, hear what I am speaking to you. Do not be rebellious like the rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם שְׁמַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־תְּהִי־מֶרִי כְּבֵית הַמֶּרִי פְּצֵה פִיךָ וֶאֱכֹל אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I looked, and behold, a hand was stretched toward me; behold, in it was a written scroll.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה־יָד שְׁלוּחָה אֵלָי וְהִנֵּה־בוֹ מְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר׃

verses.english: He spread it before me. It was written on front and back, and on it were written lamentations, mourning and woe.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אוֹתָהּ לְפָנַי וְהִיא כְתוּבָה פָּנִים וְאָחוֹר וְכָתוּב אֵלֶיהָ קִנִים וָהֶגֶה וָהִי׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תִּמְצָא אֱכוֹל אֱכוֹל אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּאת וְלֵךְ דַּבֵּר אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: I opened my mouth, and He fed me this scroll.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶפְתַּח אֶת־פִּי וַיַּאֲכִלֵנִי אֵת הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, feed your belly and fill your inward parts with this scroll that I am giving you.” I ate it, and in my mouth it was like honey for sweetness.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם בִּטְנְךָ תַאֲכֵל וּמֵעֶיךָ תְמַלֵּא אֵת הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֵלֶיךָ וָאֹכְלָה וַתְּהִי בְּפִי כִּדְבַשׁ לְמָתוֹק׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the house of Israel, and speak My words to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֶּן־אָדָם לֶךְ־בֹּא אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְדִבַּרְתָּ בִדְבָרַי אֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: For you are not sent to a people of obscure speech and heavy tongue, but to the house of Israel—
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא אֶל־עַם עִמְקֵי שָׂפָה וְכִבְדֵי לָשׁוֹן אַתָּה שָׁלוּחַ אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: not to many peoples of obscure speech and heavy tongue whose words you cannot understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
verses.hebrew: לֹא אֶל־עַמִּים רַבִּים עִמְקֵי שָׂפָה וְכִבְדֵי לָשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תִשְׁמַע דִּבְרֵיהֶם אִם־לֹא אֲלֵיהֶם שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ הֵמָּה יִשְׁמְעוּ אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: But the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, because they are not willing to listen to Me; the entire house of Israel is hard-foreheaded and hard-hearted.
verses.hebrew: וּבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵלֶיךָ כִּי־אֵינָם אֹבִים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵלָי כִּי כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל חִזְקֵי־מֵצַח וּקְשֵׁי־לֵב הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their forehead.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ חֲזָקִים לְעֻמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־מִצְחֲךָ חָזָק לְעֻמַּת מִצְחָם׃

verses.english: Like adamant, harder than flint, I have made your forehead. Do not fear them or be dismayed before their faces, for they are a rebellious house.”
verses.hebrew: כְּשָׁמִיר חָזָק מִצֹּר נָתַתִּי מִצְחֶךָ לֹא־תִירָא אוֹתָם וְלֹא־תֵחַת מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי בֵּית־מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all My words that I will speak to you, and hear them with your ears.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֶּן־אָדָם אֶת־כָּל־דְּבָרַי אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ קַח בִּלְבָבְךָ וּבְאָזְנֶיךָ שְׁמָע׃

verses.english: Go, enter among the exiles, the sons of your people; speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH,’ whether they listen or refrain.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֵךְ בֹּא אֶל־הַגּוֹלָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּלוּ׃

verses.english: A spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great shaking: “Blessed be YHWH’s glory from His place!”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂאֵנִי רוּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַע אַחֲרַי קוֹל רַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: There was the sound of the living creatures’ wings touching one another, the sound of the wheels beside them, and the sound of a great shaking.
verses.hebrew: וְקוֹל כַּנְפֵי הַחַיּוֹת מַשִּׁיקוֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָהּ וְקוֹל הָאוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם וְקוֹל רַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל׃

verses.english: The spirit lifted me up and took me away. I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit, while YHWH’s hand was strong upon me.
verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ נְשָׂאַתְנִי וַתִּקָּחֵנִי וָאֵלֵךְ מַר בַּחֲמַת רוּחִי וְיַד־יְהוָה עָלַי חָזָקָה׃

verses.english: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib, those dwelling by the River Chebar. I sat where they were dwelling, and I sat there seven days, appalled among them.
verses.hebrew: וָאָבוֹא אֶל־הַגּוֹלָה תֵּל אָבִיב הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶל־נְהַר־כְּבָר ואשר [וָאֵשֵׁב] הֵמָּה יוֹשְׁבִים שָׁם וָאֵשֵׁב שָׁם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַשְׁמִים בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: At the end of seven days, YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel. Hear a word from My mouth and warn them from Me.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם צֹפֶה נְתַתִּיךָ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מִפִּי דָּבָר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ אוֹתָם מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: When I say to the wicked person, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you do not warn him or speak to warn the wicked person from his wicked way, to preserve his life, that wicked person will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.hebrew: בְּאָמְרִי לָרָשָׁע מוֹת תָּמוּת וְלֹא הִזְהַרְתּוֹ וְלֹא דִבַּרְתָּ לְהַזְהִיר רָשָׁע מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרְשָׁעָה לְחַיֹּתוֹ הוּא רָשָׁע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ יָמוּת וְדָמוֹ מִיָּדְךָ אֲבַקֵּשׁ׃

verses.english: But if you warn the wicked person and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, while you have rescued your life.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה כִּי־הִזְהַרְתָּ רָשָׁע וְלֹא־שָׁב מֵרִשְׁעוֹ וּמִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרְשָׁעָה הוּא בַּעֲוֺנוֹ יָמוּת וְאַתָּה אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הִצַּלְתָּ׃

verses.english: When a righteous person turns from his righteousness and does injustice, and I place a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you did not warn him, he will die in his sin; the righteous deeds he did will not be remembered, and I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשׁוּב צַדִּיק מִצִּדְקוֹ וְעָשָׂה עָוֶל וְנָתַתִּי מִכְשׁוֹל לְפָנָיו הוּא יָמוּת כִּי לֹא הִזְהַרְתּוֹ בְּחַטָּאתוֹ יָמוּת וְלֹא תִזָּכַרְןָ צִדְקֹתָו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְדָמוֹ מִיָּדְךָ אֲבַקֵּשׁ׃

verses.english: But if you warn the righteous person so that the righteous person does not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live because he took warning; and you have rescued your life.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה כִּי הִזְהַרְתּוֹ צַדִּיק לְבִלְתִּי חֲטֹא צַדִּיק וְהוּא לֹא־חָטָא חָיוֹ יִחְיֶה כִּי נִזְהָר וְאַתָּה אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הִצַּלְתָּ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s hand was upon me there, and He said to me, “Rise, go out to the valley, and there I will speak with you.”
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי עָלַי שָׁם יַד־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי קוּם צֵא אֶל־הַבִּקְעָה וְשָׁם אֲדַבֵּר אוֹתָךְ׃

verses.english: I rose and went out to the valley, and behold, YHWH’s glory stood there, like the glory I had seen by the River Chebar. I fell upon my face.
verses.hebrew: וָאָקוּם וָאֵצֵא אֶל־הַבִּקְעָה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם כְּבוֹד־יְהוָה עֹמֵד כַּכָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָר וָאֶפֹּל עַל־פָּנָי׃

verses.english: A spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא־בִי רוּחַ וַתַּעֲמִדֵנִי עַל־רַגְלָי וַיְדַבֵּר אֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֹּא הִסָּגֵר בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, behold, they have placed cords upon you and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם הִנֵּה נָתְנוּ עָלֶיךָ עֲבוֹתִים וַאֲסָרוּךָ בָּהֶם וְלֹא תֵצֵא בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: I will make your tongue cling to your palate, and you will become mute; you will not be a man rebuking them, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.hebrew: וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ אַדְבִּיק אֶל־חִכֶּךָ וְנֶאֱלַמְתָּ וְלֹא־תִהְיֶה לָהֶם לְאִישׁ מוֹכִיחַ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: Let the one who hears hear, and let the one who refrains refrain,’ for they are a rebellious house.”
verses.hebrew: וּבְדַבְּרִי אוֹתְךָ אֶפְתַּח אֶת־פִּיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִשְׁמָע וְהֶחָדֵל יֶחְדָּל כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: “And you, son of man, take a brick, set it before you, and engrave on it a city—Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם קַח־לְךָ לְבֵנָה וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָהּ לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַקּוֹתָ עָלֶיהָ עִיר אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Lay siege against it: build siegeworks against it, heap a ramp against it, set camps against it, and place battering rams around it.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה עָלֶיהָ מָצוֹר וּבָנִיתָ עָלֶיהָ דָּיֵק וְשָׁפַכְתָּ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה וְנָתַתָּה עָלֶיהָ מַחֲנוֹת וְשִׂים־עָלֶיהָ כָּרִים סָבִיב׃

verses.english: Take an iron griddle and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Set your face toward it; it shall be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This is a sign for the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קַח־לְךָ מַחֲבַת בַּרְזֶל וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָהּ קִיר בַּרְזֶל בֵּינְךָ וּבֵין הָעִיר וַהֲכִינֹתָה אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ אֵלֶיהָ וְהָיְתָה בַמָּצוֹר וְצַרְתָּ עָלֶיהָ אוֹת הִיא לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Lie on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it. For the number of days you lie upon it, bear their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה שְׁכַב עַל־צִדְּךָ הַשְּׂמָאלִי וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת־עֲוֺן בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלָיו מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו תִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: I have assigned you the years of their iniquity as a number of days, three hundred ninety days; bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת־שְׁנֵי עֲוֺנָם לְמִסְפַּר יָמִים שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְתִשְׁעִים יוֹם וְנָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: When you finish these, lie a second time on your right side and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days; a day for a year, a day for a year, I have assigned it to you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלִּיתָ אֶת־אֵלֶּה וְשָׁכַבְתָּ עַל־צִדְּךָ הימוני [הַיְמָנִי] שֵׁנִית וְנָשָׂאתָ אֶת־עֲוֺן בֵּית־יְהוּדָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה נְתַתִּיו לָךְ׃

verses.english: Set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־מְצוֹר יְרוּשָׁלִַם תָּכִין פָּנֶיךָ וּזְרֹעֲךָ חֲשׂוּפָה וְנִבֵּאתָ עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Behold, I have placed cords upon you, and you shall not turn from side to side until you finish the days of your siege.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה נָתַתִּי עָלֶיךָ עֲבוֹתִים וְלֹא־תֵהָפֵךְ מִצִּדְּךָ אֶל־צִדֶּךָ עַד־כַּלּוֹתְךָ יְמֵי מְצוּרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt; put them in one vessel and make bread from them for yourself. For the number of days you lie on your side—three hundred ninety days—you shall eat it.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קַח־לְךָ חִטִּין וּשְׂעֹרִים וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְדֹחַן וְכֻסְּמִים וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָם בִּכְלִי אֶחָד וְעָשִׂיתָ אוֹתָם לְךָ לְלָחֶם מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה שׁוֹכֵב עַל־צִדְּךָ שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְתִשְׁעִים יוֹם תֹּאכֲלֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: The food you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; eat it at fixed times.
verses.hebrew: וּמַאֲכָלְךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכֲלֶנּוּ בְּמִשְׁקוֹל עֶשְׂרִים שֶׁקֶל לַיּוֹם מֵעֵת עַד־עֵת תֹּאכֲלֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Drink water by measure, a sixth of a hin; drink it at fixed times.
verses.hebrew: וּמַיִם בִּמְשׂוּרָה תִשְׁתֶּה שִׁשִּׁית הַהִין מֵעֵת עַד־עֵת תִּשְׁתֶּה׃

verses.english: Eat it as a barley cake, and bake it over pellets of human excrement before their eyes.”
verses.hebrew: וְעֻגַת שְׂעֹרִים תֹּאכֲלֶנָּה וְהִיא בְּגֶלְלֵי צֵאַת הָאָדָם תְּעֻגֶנָה לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH said, “Thus the sons of Israel will eat their bread unclean among the nations where I will drive them.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה כָּכָה יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־לַחְמָם טָמֵא בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אַדִּיחֵם שָׁם׃

verses.english: I said, “Ah, Lord YHWH! Behold, I have not been defiled; from my youth until now I have not eaten an animal that died of itself or was torn, and tainted meat has not entered my mouth.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנֵּה נַפְשִׁי לֹא מְטֻמָּאָה וּנְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא־אָכַלְתִּי מִנְּעוּרַי וְעַד־עַתָּה וְלֹא־בָא בְּפִי בְּשַׂר פִּגּוּל׃

verses.english: He said to me, “See, I have given you cattle dung instead of human dung; prepare your bread over it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת־צפועי [צְפִיעֵי] הַבָּקָר תַּחַת גֶּלְלֵי הָאָדָם וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת־לַחְמְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am breaking the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight and in anxiety, and drink water by measure and in dismay,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם הִנְנִי שֹׁבֵר מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וְאָכְלוּ־לֶחֶם בְּמִשְׁקָל וּבִדְאָגָה וּמַיִם בִּמְשׂוּרָה וּבְשִׁמָּמוֹן יִשְׁתּוּ׃

verses.english: so that they lack bread and water, are appalled, one with his brother, and waste away in their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יַחְסְרוּ לֶחֶם וָמָיִם וְנָשַׁמּוּ אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְנָמַקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: “And you, son of man, take a sharp sword; take it as a barber’s razor, and pass it over your head and your beard. Take weighing scales and divide the hairs.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם קַח־לְךָ חֶרֶב חַדָּה תַּעַר הַגַּלָּבִים תִּקָּחֶנָּה לָּךְ וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ עַל־רֹאשְׁךָ וְעַל־זְקָנֶךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ לְךָ מֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁקָל וְחִלַּקְתָּם׃

verses.english: Burn a third in the fire inside the city when the days of siege are fulfilled. Take a third and strike it with the sword around the city; scatter a third to the wind, and I will draw a sword after them.
verses.hebrew: שְׁלִשִׁית בָּאוּר תַּבְעִיר בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר כִּמְלֹאת יְמֵי הַמָּצוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַשְּׁלִשִׁית תַּכֶּה בַחֶרֶב סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית תִּזְרֶה לָרוּחַ וְחֶרֶב אָרִיק אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Take a few of them in number and bind them in the folds of your garment.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִשָּׁם מְעַט בְּמִסְפָּר וְצַרְתָּ אוֹתָם בִּכְנָפֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Take some of these again, cast them into the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it fire will go out to the entire house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵהֶם עוֹד תִּקָּח וְהִשְׁלַכְתָּ אוֹתָם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ וְשָׂרַפְתָּ אֹתָם בָּאֵשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ תֵצֵא־אֵשׁ אֶל־כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: This is Jerusalem. I placed her amid the nations, with lands around her.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה זֹאת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בְּתוֹךְ הַגּוֹיִם שַׂמְתִּיהָ וּסְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ אֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: She rebelled against My judgments in wickedness more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the lands around her; for they rejected My judgments and did not walk in My statutes.
verses.hebrew: וַתֶּמֶר אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי לְרִשְׁעָה מִן־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־חֻקּוֹתַי מִן־הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ כִּי בְמִשְׁפָּטַי מָאָסוּ וְחֻקּוֹתַי לֹא־הָלְכוּ בָהֶם׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because your tumult exceeds that of the nations around you, and you have not walked in My statutes or carried out My judgments, nor even acted according to the judgments of the nations around you—
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן הֲמָנְכֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחֻקּוֹתַי לֹא הֲלַכְתֶּם וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא עֲשִׂיתֶם וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם לֹא עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

verses.english: therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I too am against you. I will execute judgments in your midst before the eyes of the nations.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי עָלַיִךְ גַּם־אָנִי וְעָשִׂיתִי בְתוֹכֵךְ מִשְׁפָּטִים לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: Because of all your abominations I will do among you what I have never done, and the like of which I will never do again.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתִי בָךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָשִׂיתִי וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־לֹא־אֶעֱשֶׂה כָמֹהוּ עוֹד יַעַן כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Therefore fathers will eat sons in your midst, and sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your remainder to every wind.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אָבוֹת יֹאכְלוּ בָנִים בְּתוֹכֵךְ וּבָנִים יֹאכְלוּ אֲבוֹתָם וְעָשִׂיתִי בָךְ שְׁפָטִים וְזֵרִיתִי אֶת־כָּל־שְׁאֵרִיתֵךְ לְכָל־רוּחַ׃

verses.english: Therefore, as I live—declares Lord YHWH—surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things and all your abominations, I too will diminish you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no compassion.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן חַי־אָנִי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אִם־לֹא יַעַן אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי טִמֵּאת בְּכָל־שִׁקּוּצַיִךְ וּבְכָל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָיִךְ וְגַם־אֲנִי אֶגְרַע וְלֹא־תָחוֹס עֵינִי וְגַם־אֲנִי לֹא אֶחְמוֹל׃

verses.english: A third of you will die by pestilence and perish by famine within you; a third will fall by the sword around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, drawing a sword after them.
verses.hebrew: שְׁלִשִׁתֵיךְ בַּדֶּבֶר יָמוּתוּ וּבָרָעָב יִכְלוּ בְתוֹכֵךְ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּחֶרֶב יִפְּלוּ סְבִיבוֹתָיִךְ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית לְכָל־רוּחַ אֱזָרֶה וְחֶרֶב אָרִיק אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: My anger will be spent; I will bring My fury to rest upon them and be appeased. They will know that I, YHWH, have spoken in My jealousy when I have spent My fury upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְכָלָה אַפִּי וַהֲנִחוֹתִי חֲמָתִי בָּם וְהִנֶּחָמְתִּי וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי בְּקִנְאָתִי בְּכַלּוֹתִי חֲמָתִי בָּם׃

verses.english: I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, before the eyes of every passerby.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְּנֵךְ לְחָרְבָּה וּלְחֶרְפָּה בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתָיִךְ לְעֵינֵי כָּל־עוֹבֵר׃

verses.english: It will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, fury and furious rebukes. I, YHWH, have spoken.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה חֶרְפָּה וּגְדוּפָה מוּסָר וּמְשַׁמָּה לַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתָיִךְ בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי בָךְ שְׁפָטִים בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה וּבְתֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי׃

verses.english: When I send among them the evil arrows of famine, which are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, I will add famine upon you and break your staff of bread.
verses.hebrew: בְּשַׁלְּחִי אֶת־חִצֵּי הָרָעָב הָרָעִים בָּהֶם אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְמַשְׁחִית אֲשֶׁר־אֲשַׁלַּח אוֹתָם לְשַׁחֶתְכֶם וְרָעָב אֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם וְשָׁבַרְתִּי לָכֶם מַטֵּה־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: I will send famine and harmful wild animals against you, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, YHWH, have spoken.”
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם רָעָב וְחַיָּה רָעָה וְשִׁכְּלֻךְ וְדֶבֶר וָדָם יַעֲבָר־בָּךְ וְחֶרֶב אָבִיא עָלַיִךְ אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy to them.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל־הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִנָּבֵא אֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of Lord YHWH. Thus says Lord YHWH to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys: Behold, I am bringing a sword against you and will destroy your high places.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֶהָרִים וְלַגְּבָעוֹת לָאֲפִיקִים ולגאית [וְלַגֵּאָיוֹת] הִנְנִי אֲנִי מֵבִיא עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב וְאִבַּדְתִּי בָּמוֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Your altars will be devastated and your incense altars broken; I will cast your slain before your idols.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשַׁמּוּ מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְהִפַּלְתִּי חַלְלֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I will place the corpses of the sons of Israel before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־פִּגְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם וְזֵרִיתִי אֶת־עַצְמוֹתֵיכֶם סְבִיבוֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: In all your dwelling places the cities will be ruined and the high places desolate, so that your altars are ruined and laid waste, your idols broken and brought to an end, your incense altars cut down, and your works wiped out.
verses.hebrew: בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם הֶעָרִים תֶּחֱרַבְנָה וְהַבָּמוֹת תִּישָׁמְנָה לְמַעַן יֶחֶרְבוּ וְיֶאְשְׁמוּ מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ וְנִשְׁבְּתוּ גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְנִגְדְּעוּ חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנִמְחוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם׃

verses.english: The slain will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנָפַל חָלָל בְּתוֹכְכֶם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Yet I will leave a remainder, when you have survivors of the sword among the nations, when you are scattered in the lands.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתַרְתִּי בִּהְיוֹת לָכֶם פְּלִיטֵי חֶרֶב בַּגּוֹיִם בְּהִזָּרוֹתֵיכֶם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: Your survivors will remember Me among the nations where they were taken captive: how I was broken by their whoring heart that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that whored after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evils they did, for all their abominations.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכְרוּ פְלִיטֵיכֶם אוֹתִי בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּרְתִּי אֶת־לִבָּם הַזּוֹנֶה אֲשֶׁר־סָר מֵעָלַי וְאֵת עֵינֵיהֶם הַזֹּנוֹת אַחֲרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם וְנָקֹטּוּ בִּפְנֵיהֶם אֶל־הָרָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לְכֹל תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They will know that I am YHWH; I did not speak in vain about bringing this evil upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה לֹא אֶל־חִנָּם דִּבַּרְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Clap your hand, stamp your foot, and say, “Alas!” over all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, for they will fall by sword, famine and pestilence.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הַכֵּה בְכַפְּךָ וּרְקַע בְּרַגְלְךָ וֶאֱמָר־אָח אֶל כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹת רָעוֹת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בַּחֶרֶב בָּרָעָב וּבַדֶּבֶר יִפֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: The one far away will die by pestilence, the one near will fall by the sword, and the one left and besieged will die by famine; I will spend My fury upon them.
verses.hebrew: הָרָחוֹק בַּדֶּבֶר יָמוּת וְהַקָּרוֹב בַּחֶרֶב יִפּוֹל וְהַנִּשְׁאָר וְהַנָּצוּר בָּרָעָב יָמוּת וְכִלֵּיתִי חֲמָתִי בָּם׃

verses.english: You will know that I am YHWH when their slain lie among their idols, around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, beneath every flourishing tree and beneath every thick-leaved terebinth, the place where they offered a pleasing aroma to all their idols.
verses.hebrew: וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בִּהְיוֹת חַלְלֵיהֶם בְּתוֹךְ גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם סְבִיבוֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם אֶל כָּל־גִּבְעָה רָמָה בְּכֹל רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וְתַחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן וְתַחַת כָּל־אֵלָה עֲבֻתָּה מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ־שָׁם רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לְכֹל גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land a desolation and a horror, from the wilderness toward Diblah, in all their dwelling places; they will know that I am YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: וְנָטִיתִי אֶת־יָדִי עֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה וּמְשַׁמָּה מִמִּדְבַּר דִּבְלָתָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “And you, son of man, thus says Lord YHWH to the soil of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לְאַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל קֵץ בָּא הַקֵּץ עַל־ארבעת [אַרְבַּע] כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: An end has come; the end has come. It has awakened against you—behold, it comes!
verses.hebrew: קֵץ בָּא בָּא הַקֵּץ הֵקִיץ אֵלָיִךְ הִנֵּה בָּאָה׃

verses.english: Doom has come upon you, inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near—tumult, not a joyful shout on the mountains.
verses.hebrew: בָּאָה הַצְּפִירָה אֵלֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ בָּא הָעֵת קָרוֹב הַיּוֹם מְהוּמָה וְלֹא־הֵד הָרִים׃

verses.english: Now soon I will pour My fury upon you and spend My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה מִקָּרוֹב אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲמָתִי עָלַיִךְ וְכִלֵּיתִי אַפִּי בָּךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ כִּדְרָכָיִךְ וְנָתַתִּי עָלַיִךְ אֵת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: My eye will not spare, and I will have no compassion. According to your ways I will bring it upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. You will know that I am YHWH who strikes.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תָחוֹס עֵינִי וְלֹא אֶחְמוֹל כִּדְרָכַיִךְ עָלַיִךְ אֶתֵּן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַיִךְ בְּתוֹכֵךְ תִּהְיֶיןָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מַכֶּה׃

verses.english: Now the end is upon you. I will send My anger against you, judge you according to your ways, and bring all your abominations upon you.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה הַקֵּץ עָלַיִךְ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אַפִּי בָּךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ כִּדְרָכָיִךְ וְנָתַתִּי עָלַיִךְ אֵת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: My eye will not spare you, and I will have no compassion; I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. You will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תָחוֹס עֵינִי עָלַיִךְ וְלֹא אֶחְמוֹל כִּי דְרָכַיִךְ עָלַיִךְ אֶתֵּן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַיִךְ בְּתוֹכֵךְ תִּהְיֶיןָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: An evil, a singular evil—behold, it comes!
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה רָעָה אַחַת רָעָה הִנֵּה בָאָה׃

verses.english: Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Doom has gone forth; the rod has budded; arrogance has blossomed.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם הִנֵּה בָאָה יָצְאָה הַצְּפִרָה צָץ הַמַּטֶּה פָּרַח הַזָּדוֹן׃

verses.english: Violence has risen into a rod of wickedness: nothing of them, nothing of their multitude, nothing of their abundance, and no eminence among them.
verses.hebrew: הֶחָמָס קָם לְמַטֵּה־רֶשַׁע לֹא־מֵהֶם וְלֹא מֵהֲמוֹנָם וְלֹא מֶהֱמֵהֶם וְלֹא־נֹהַּ בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is against all her multitude.
verses.hebrew: בָּא הָעֵת הִגִּיעַ הַיּוֹם הַקּוֹנֶה אַל־יִשְׂמָח וְהַמּוֹכֵר אַל־יִתְאַבָּל כִּי חָרוֹן אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ׃

verses.english: For the seller will not return to what was sold, while their lives are still among the living; for the vision against all her multitude will not turn back. No one will strengthen his life by his iniquity.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמּוֹכֵר אֶל־הַמִּמְכָּר לֹא יָשׁוּב וְעוֹד בַּחַיִּים חַיָּתָם כִּי־חָזוֹן אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ לֹא יָשׁוּב וְאִישׁ בַּעֲוֺנוֹ חַיָּתוֹ לֹא יִתְחַזָּקוּ׃

verses.english: They have blown the trumpet and prepared everything, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is against all her multitude.
verses.hebrew: תָּקְעוּ בַתָּקוֹעַ וְהָכִין הַכֹּל וְאֵין הֹלֵךְ לַמִּלְחָמָה כִּי חֲרוֹנִי אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ׃

verses.english: The sword is outside, and pestilence and famine inside. Whoever is in the field will die by the sword; whoever is in the city, famine and pestilence will devour him.
verses.hebrew: הַחֶרֶב בַּחוּץ וְהַדֶּבֶר וְהָרָעָב מִבָּיִת אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּחֶרֶב יָמוּת וַאֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר רָעָב וָדֶבֶר יֹאכֲלֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Their survivors will escape and be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each over his iniquity.
verses.hebrew: וּפָלְטוּ פְּלִיטֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ אֶל־הֶהָרִים כְּיוֹנֵי הַגֵּאָיוֹת כֻּלָּם הֹמוֹת אִישׁ בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃

verses.english: All hands will fall slack, and all knees will run with water.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיָּדַיִם תִּרְפֶּינָה וְכָל־בִּרְכַּיִם תֵּלַכְנָה מָּיִם׃

verses.english: They will gird on sackcloth, and trembling will cover them; shame will be upon every face, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.hebrew: וְחָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְכִסְּתָה אוֹתָם פַּלָּצוּת וְאֶל כָּל־פָּנִים בּוּשָׁה וּבְכָל־רָאשֵׁיהֶם קָרְחָה׃

verses.english: They will cast their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an unclean thing. Their silver and gold cannot rescue them on the day of YHWH’s wrath. They cannot satisfy their appetite or fill their inward parts, for it became the stumbling block of their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: כַּסְפָּם בַּחוּצוֹת יַשְׁלִיכוּ וּזְהָבָם לְנִדָּה יִהְיֶה כַּסְפָּם וּזְהָבָם לֹא־יוּכַל לְהַצִּילָם בְּיוֹם עֶבְרַת יְהוָה נַפְשָׁם לֹא יְשַׂבֵּעוּ וּמֵעֵיהֶם לֹא יְמַלֵּאוּ כִּי־מִכְשׁוֹל עֲוֺנָם הָיָה׃

verses.english: He made the beauty of his ornament a source of pride; they made in it the images of their abominations, their detestable things. Therefore I have made it an unclean thing to them.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבִי עֶדְיוֹ לְגָאוֹן שָׂמָהוּ וְצַלְמֵי תוֹעֲבֹתָם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם עָשׂוּ בוֹ עַל־כֵּן נְתַתִּיו לָהֶם לְנִדָּה׃

verses.english: I will give it into strangers’ hands as plunder and to the wicked of the earth as spoil; they will profane it.
verses.hebrew: וּנְתַתִּיו בְּיַד־הַזָּרִים לָבַז וּלְרִשְׁעֵי הָאָרֶץ לְשָׁלָל וחללה [וְחִלְּלוּהוּ׃]

verses.english: I will turn My face away from them, and they will profane My hidden place. Violent intruders will enter it and profane it.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִי פָנַי מֵהֶם וְחִלְּלוּ אֶת־צְפוּנִי וּבָאוּ־בָהּ פָּרִיצִים וְחִלְּלוּהָ׃

verses.english: Make the chain, for the land is full of blood judgments and the city full of violence.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה הָרַתּוֹק כִּי הָאָרֶץ מָלְאָה מִשְׁפַּט דָּמִים וְהָעִיר מָלְאָה חָמָס׃

verses.english: I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the strong, and their sanctuaries will be profaned.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתִי רָעֵי גוֹיִם וְיָרְשׁוּ אֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי גְּאוֹן עַזִּים וְנִחֲלוּ מְקַדְשֵׁיהֶם׃

verses.english: Anguish has come; they will seek peace, but there is none.
verses.hebrew: קְפָדָה־בָא וּבִקְשׁוּ שָׁלוֹם וָאָיִן׃

verses.english: Disaster upon disaster will come, and report upon report will arise. They will seek a vision from the prophet, but instruction will perish from the priest and counsel from the elders.
verses.hebrew: הֹוָה עַל־הֹוָה תָּבוֹא וּשְׁמֻעָה אֶל־שְׁמוּעָה תִּהְיֶה וּבִקְשׁוּ חָזוֹן מִנָּבִיא וְתוֹרָה תֹּאבַד מִכֹּהֵן וְעֵצָה מִזְּקֵנִים׃

verses.english: The king will mourn; the prince will clothe himself in desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. According to their way I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will judge them; they will know that I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: הַמֶּלֶךְ יִתְאַבָּל וְנָשִׂיא יִלְבַּשׁ שְׁמָמָה וִידֵי עַם־הָאָרֶץ תִּבָּהַלְנָה מִדַּרְכָּם אֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתָם וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶם אֶשְׁפְּטֵם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and Judah’s elders were sitting before me. The hand of Lord YHWH fell upon me there.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית בַּשִּׁשִּׁי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹדֶשׁ אֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּבֵיתִי וְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה יוֹשְׁבִים לְפָנָי וַתִּפֹּל עָלַי שָׁם יַד אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: I looked, and behold, a likeness with the appearance of fire: from what appeared to be His waist downward, fire; from His waist upward, an appearance of brightness, like the gleam of ḥashmal.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה דְמוּת כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵשׁ מִמַּרְאֵה מָתְנָיו וּלְמַטָּה אֵשׁ וּמִמָּתְנָיו וּלְמַעְלָה כְּמַרְאֵה־זֹהַר כְּעֵין הַחַשְׁמַלָה׃

verses.english: He stretched out the form of a hand and took me by a lock of my hair. A spirit lifted me between earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in visions of God, to the entrance of the inner gate facing north, where stood the image of jealousy that provokes jealousy.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח תַּבְנִית יָד וַיִּקָּחֵנִי בְּצִיצִת רֹאשִׁי וַתִּשָּׂא אֹתִי רוּחַ בֵּין־הָאָרֶץ וּבֵין הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתָּבֵא אֹתִי יְרוּשָׁלְַמָה בְּמַרְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים אֶל־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הַפְּנִימִית הַפּוֹנֶה צָפוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם מוֹשַׁב סֵמֶל הַקִּנְאָה הַמַּקְנֶה׃

verses.english: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision I had seen in the valley.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם כְּבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי בַּבִּקְעָה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, lift your eyes now toward the north.” I lifted my eyes toward the north, and behold, north of the altar gate, this image of jealousy was at the entrance.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם שָׂא־נָא עֵינֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ צָפוֹנָה וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי דֶּרֶךְ צָפוֹנָה וְהִנֵּה מִצָּפוֹן לְשַׁעַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סֵמֶל הַקִּנְאָה הַזֶּה בַּבִּאָה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the great abominations the house of Israel is doing here, to withdraw far from My sanctuary? Yet again you will see great abominations.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם הֲרֹאֶה אַתָּה מהם [מָה] [הֵם] עֹשִׂים תּוֹעֵבוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשִׂים פֹּה לְרָחֳקָה מֵעַל מִקְדָּשִׁי וְעוֹד תָּשׁוּב תִּרְאֶה תּוֹעֵבוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: He brought me to the courtyard entrance. I looked, and behold, there was a hole in the wall.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֹתִי אֶל־פֶּתַח הֶחָצֵר וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה חֹר־אֶחָד בַּקִּיר׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, dig now through the wall.” I dug through the wall, and behold, there was a doorway.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם חֲתָר־נָא בַקִּיר וָאֶחְתֹּר בַּקִּיר וְהִנֵּה פֶּתַח אֶחָד׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Go in and see the evil abominations they are doing here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֹּא וּרְאֵה אֶת־הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָרָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹשִׂים פֹּה׃

verses.english: I went in and looked, and behold, every form of creeping thing and detestable beast, and all the idols of the house of Israel, were engraved on the wall all around.
verses.hebrew: וָאָבוֹא וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה כָל־תַּבְנִית רֶמֶשׂ וּבְהֵמָה שֶׁקֶץ וְכָל־גִּלּוּלֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְחֻקֶּה עַל־הַקִּיר סָבִיב סָבִיב׃

verses.english: Seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them, stood before them, each with his censer in his hand, while a thick cloud of incense rose.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעִים אִישׁ מִזִּקְנֵי בֵית־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיַאֲזַנְיָהוּ בֶן־שָׁפָן עֹמֵד בְּתוֹכָם עֹמְדִים לִפְנֵיהֶם וְאִישׁ מִקְטַרְתּוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וַעֲתַר עֲנַן־הַקְּטֹרֶת עֹלֶה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, each in the chambers of his images? For they say, ‘YHWH does not see us; YHWH has abandoned the land.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הֲרָאִיתָ בֶן־אָדָם אֲשֶׁר זִקְנֵי בֵית־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשִׂים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אִישׁ בְּחַדְרֵי מַשְׂכִּיתוֹ כִּי אֹמְרִים אֵין יְהוָה רֹאֶה אֹתָנוּ עָזַב יְהוָה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Yet again you will see great abominations that they are doing.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי עוֹד תָּשׁוּב תִּרְאֶה תּוֹעֵבוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים׃

verses.english: He brought me to the entrance of the gate of YHWH’s house that is toward the north, and behold, women were sitting there weeping for Tammuz.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֹתִי אֶל־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר אֶל־הַצָּפוֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם הַנָּשִׁים יֹשְׁבוֹת מְבַכּוֹת אֶת־הַתַּמּוּז׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man? Yet again you will see abominations greater than these.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הֲרָאִיתָ בֶן־אָדָם עוֹד תָּשׁוּב תִּרְאֶה תּוֹעֵבוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת מֵאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: He brought me into the inner court of YHWH’s house, and behold, at the entrance of YHWH’s temple, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, their backs toward YHWH’s temple and their faces eastward. They were bowing eastward to the sun.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֹתִי אֶל־חֲצַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הַפְּנִימִית וְהִנֵּה־פֶתַח הֵיכַל יְהוָה בֵּין הָאוּלָם וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּעֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אִישׁ אֲחֹרֵיהֶם אֶל־הֵיכַל יְהוָה וּפְנֵיהֶם קֵדְמָה וְהֵמָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם קֵדְמָה לַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Judah to do the abominations they have done here? For they have filled the land with violence and again provoked Me; behold, they are sending the branch toward their nose.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הֲרָאִיתָ בֶן־אָדָם הֲנָקֵל לְבֵית יְהוּדָה מֵעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ־פֹה כִּי־מָלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ חָמָס וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי וְהִנָּם שֹׁלְחִים אֶת־הַזְּמוֹרָה אֶל־אַפָּם׃

verses.english: I too will act in fury. My eye will not spare, and I will have no compassion. They will cry into My ears with a loud voice, but I will not hear them.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה בְחֵמָה לֹא־תָחוֹס עֵינִי וְלֹא אֶחְמֹל וְקָרְאוּ בְאָזְנַי קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא אֶשְׁמַע אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: He called in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Draw near, you appointed punishers of the city, each with his destroying weapon in his hand.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא בְאָזְנַי קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר קָרְבוּ פְּקֻדּוֹת הָעִיר וְאִישׁ כְּלִי מַשְׁחֵתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: And behold, six men came from the direction of the upper gate that faces north, each with his shattering weapon in his hand. One man among them was clothed in linen, with a scribe’s case at his waist. They came and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שִׁשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים בָּאִים מִדֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הָעֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מָפְנֶה צָפוֹנָה וְאִישׁ כְּלִי מַפָּצוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְאִישׁ־אֶחָד בְּתוֹכָם לָבֻשׁ בַּדִּים וְקֶסֶת הַסֹּפֵר בְּמָתְנָיו וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ אֵצֶל מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

verses.english: The glory of the God of Israel rose from above the cherub on which it had been, to the threshold of the house. He called to the man clothed in linen, who had the scribe’s case at his waist.
verses.hebrew: וּכְבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲלָה מֵעַל הַכְּרוּב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה עָלָיו אֶל מִפְתַּן הַבָּיִת וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־הָאִישׁ הַלָּבֻשׁ הַבַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר קֶסֶת הַסֹּפֵר בְּמָתְנָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH said to him, “Pass through the midst of the city, through Jerusalem, and mark a mark upon the foreheads of the men who sigh and groan over all the abominations being done within her.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אלו [אֵלָיו] עֲבֹר בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְהִתְוִיתָ תָּו עַל־מִצְחוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַנֶּאֱנָחִים וְהַנֶּאֱנָקִים עַל כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הַנַּעֲשׂוֹת בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

verses.english: To these others He said in my hearing, “Pass through the city behind him and strike. Let your eyes not spare, and have no compassion.
verses.hebrew: וּלְאֵלֶּה אָמַר בְּאָזְנַי עִבְרוּ בָעִיר אַחֲרָיו וְהַכּוּ על־[אַל־] תָּחֹס עיניכם [עֵינְכֶם] וְאַל־תַּחְמֹלוּ׃

verses.english: Old man, young man, maiden, little children and women—kill them to destruction. But do not approach anyone upon whom the mark is. Begin at My sanctuary.” They began with the elderly men who were before the house.
verses.hebrew: זָקֵן בָּחוּר וּבְתוּלָה וְטַף וְנָשִׁים תַּהַרְגוּ לְמַשְׁחִית וְעַל־כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו הַתָּו אַל־תִּגַּשׁוּ וּמִמִּקְדָּשִׁי תָּחֵלּוּ וַיָּחֵלּוּ בָּאֲנָשִׁים הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: He said to them, “Defile the house and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out and struck in the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם טַמְּאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת וּמַלְאוּ אֶת־הַחֲצֵרוֹת חֲלָלִים צֵאוּ וְיָצְאוּ וְהִכּוּ בָעִיר׃

verses.english: As they struck, I was left, and I fell upon my face and cried out, saying, “Ah, Lord YHWH! Are You destroying the entire remnant of Israel as You pour out Your fury upon Jerusalem?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהַכּוֹתָם וְנֵאשֲׁאַר אָנִי וָאֶפְּלָה עַל־פָּנַי וָאֶזְעַק וָאֹמַר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הֲמַשְׁחִית אַתָּה אֵת כָּל־שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשָׁפְכְּךָ אֶת־חֲמָתְךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: He said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great. The land is filled with bloodshed, and the city full of perverted justice, for they say, ‘YHWH has abandoned the land, and YHWH does not see.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲוֺן בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה גָּדוֹל בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ דָּמִים וְהָעִיר מָלְאָה מֻטֶּה כִּי אָמְרוּ עָזַב יְהוָה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין יְהוָה רֹאֶה׃

verses.english: As for Me, My eye will not spare, and I will have no compassion. I have brought their way upon their head.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי לֹא־תָחוֹס עֵינִי וְלֹא אֶחְמֹל דַּרְכָּם בְּרֹאשָׁם נָתָתִּי׃

verses.english: And behold, the man clothed in linen, with the case at his waist, brought back word, saying, “I have done as You commanded me.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה הָאִישׁ לְבֻשׁ הַבַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר הַקֶּסֶת בְּמָתְנָיו מֵשִׁיב דָּבָר לֵאמֹר עָשִׂיתִי כאשר [כְּכֹל] [אֲשֶׁר] צִוִּיתָנִי׃

verses.english: I looked, and behold, above the expanse over the cherubim’s heads, something like sapphire stone, like the appearance of a throne’s likeness, appeared above them.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה אֶל־הָרָקִיעַ אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הַכְּרֻבִים כְּאֶבֶן סַפִּיר כְּמַרְאֵה דְּמוּת כִּסֵּא נִרְאָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: He said to the man clothed in linen—He said, “Go in among the wheelwork, beneath the cherub, and fill your cupped hands with burning coals from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in before my eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאִישׁ לְבֻשׁ הַבַּדִּים וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּא אֶל־בֵּינוֹת לַגַּלְגַּל אֶל־תַּחַת לַכְּרוּב וּמַלֵּא חָפְנֶיךָ גַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ מִבֵּינוֹת לַכְּרֻבִים וּזְרֹק עַל־הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא לְעֵינָי׃

verses.english: The cherubim were standing to the right of the house when the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.hebrew: וְהַכְּרֻבִים עֹמְדִים מִימִין לַבַּיִת בְּבֹאוֹ הָאִישׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית׃

verses.english: YHWH’s glory rose from above the cherub to the threshold of the house. The house filled with the cloud, and the court filled with the brightness of YHWH’s glory.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרָם כְּבוֹד־יְהוָה מֵעַל הַכְּרוּב עַל מִפְתַּן הַבָּיִת וַיִּמָּלֵא הַבַּיִת אֶת־הֶעָנָן וְהֶחָצֵר מָלְאָה אֶת־נֹגַהּ כְּבוֹד יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The sound of the cherubim’s wings was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Shaddai when He speaks.
verses.hebrew: וְקוֹל כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים נִשְׁמַע עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצֹנָה כְּקוֹל אֵל־שַׁדַּי בְּדַבְּרוֹ׃

verses.english: When He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from among the wheelwork, from among the cherubim,” he went in and stood beside the wheel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצַוֺּתוֹ אֶת־הָאִישׁ לְבֻשׁ־הַבַּדִּים לֵאמֹר קַח אֵשׁ מִבֵּינוֹת לַגַּלְגַּל מִבֵּינוֹת לַכְּרוּבִים וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד אֵצֶל הָאוֹפָן׃

verses.english: The cherub stretched out his hand from among the cherubim toward the fire among the cherubim, lifted it and put it into the cupped hands of the man clothed in linen. He took it and went out.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַכְּרוּב אֶת־יָדוֹ מִבֵּינוֹת לַכְּרוּבִים אֶל־הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר בֵּינוֹת הַכְּרֻבִים וַיִּשָּׂא וַיִּתֵּן אֶל־חָפְנֵי לְבֻשׁ הַבַּדִּים וַיִּקַּח וַיֵּצֵא׃

verses.english: There appeared upon the cherubim the form of a human hand beneath their wings.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא לַכְּרֻבִים תַּבְנִית יַד־אָדָם תַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I looked, and behold, four wheels were beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub and one wheel beside one cherub. The wheels’ appearance was like the gleam of a tarshish stone.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה אַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנִּים אֵצֶל הַכְּרוּבִים אוֹפַן אֶחָד אֵצֶל הַכְּרוּב אֶחָד וְאוֹפַן אֶחָד אֵצֶל הַכְּרוּב אֶחָד וּמַרְאֵה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּעֵין אֶבֶן תַּרְשִׁישׁ׃

verses.english: As for their appearance, all four had one likeness, as though a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.hebrew: וּמַרְאֵיהֶם דְּמוּת אֶחָד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הָאוֹפַן בְּתוֹךְ הָאוֹפָן׃

verses.english: As they went, they went toward their four quarters; they did not turn as they went. For wherever the head turned, they went after it; they did not turn as they went.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֶכְתָּם אֶל־אַרְבַּעַת רִבְעֵיהֶם יֵלֵכוּ לֹא יִסַּבּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּם כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִפְנֶה הָרֹאשׁ אַחֲרָיו יֵלֵכוּ לֹא יִסַּבּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּם׃

verses.english: All their flesh, their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around—the wheels belonging to all four of them.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־בְּשָׂרָם וְגַבֵּהֶם וִידֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם וְהָאוֹפַנִּים מְלֵאִים עֵינַיִם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם אוֹפַנֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: As for the wheels, they were called “the wheelwork” in my hearing.
verses.hebrew: לָאוֹפַנִּים לָהֶם קוֹרָא הַגַּלְגַּל בְּאָזְנָי׃

verses.english: The cherubim rose. This was the living creature I had seen at the river Chebar.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֹמּוּ הַכְּרוּבִים הִיא הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי בִּנְהַר־כְּבָר׃

verses.english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them. When the cherubim lifted their wings to rise above the earth, the wheels too did not turn away from beside them.
verses.hebrew: וּבְלֶכֶת הַכְּרוּבִים יֵלְכוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים אֶצְלָם וּבִשְׂאֵת הַכְּרוּבִים אֶת־כַּנְפֵיהֶם לָרוּם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ לֹא־יִסַּבּוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים גַּם־הֵם מֵאֶצְלָם׃

verses.english: When they stood, these stood; when they rose, these rose with them, for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.hebrew: בְּעָמְדָם יַעֲמֹדוּ וּבְרוֹמָם יֵרוֹמּוּ אוֹתָם כִּי רוּחַ הַחַיָּה בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH’s glory went out from above the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא כְּבוֹד יְהוָה מֵעַל מִפְתַּן הַבָּיִת וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים׃

verses.english: The cherubim lifted their wings and rose from the earth before my eyes as they went out, with the wheels alongside them. It stood at the entrance of the eastern gate of YHWH’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכְּרוּבִים אֶת־כַּנְפֵיהֶם וַיֵּרוֹמּוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ לְעֵינַי בְּצֵאתָם וְהָאוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הַקַּדְמוֹנִי וּכְבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: This was the living creature I had seen beneath the God of Israel at the river Chebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.hebrew: הִיא הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי תַּחַת אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּנְהַר־כְּבָר וָאֵדַע כִּי כְרוּבִים הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Each had four faces, each had four wings, and the likeness of human hands was beneath their wings.
verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעָה אַרְבָּעָה פָנִים לְאֶחָד וְאַרְבַּע כְּנָפַיִם לְאֶחָד וּדְמוּת יְדֵי אָדָם תַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: As for the likeness of their faces, these were the faces I had seen by the river Chebar—their appearance and they themselves. Each went straight ahead.
verses.hebrew: וּדְמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם הֵמָּה הַפָּנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָר מַרְאֵיהֶם וְאוֹתָם אִישׁ אֶל־עֵבֶר פָּנָיו יֵלֵכוּ׃

verses.english: A spirit lifted me and brought me to the eastern gate of YHWH’s house, facing east. And behold, at the gate entrance were twenty-five men. Among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂא אֹתִי רוּחַ וַתָּבֵא אֹתִי אֶל־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הַקַּדְמוֹנִי הַפּוֹנֶה קָדִימָה וְהִנֵּה בְּפֶתַח הַשַּׁעַר עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אִישׁ וָאֶרְאֶה בְתוֹכָם אֶת־יַאֲזַנְיָה בֶן־עַזֻּר וְאֶת־פְּלַטְיָהוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָהוּ שָׂרֵי הָעָם׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise evil and counsel wicked counsel in this city,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֶּן־אָדָם אֵלֶּה הָאֲנָשִׁים הַחֹשְׁבִים אָוֶן וְהַיֹּעֲצִים עֲצַת־רָע בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: who say, ‘The building of houses is not near. She is the pot, and we are the meat.’
verses.hebrew: הָאֹמְרִים לֹא בְקָרוֹב בְּנוֹת בָּתִּים הִיא הַסִּיר וַאֲנַחְנוּ הַבָּשָׂר׃

verses.english: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנָּבֵא עֲלֵיהֶם הִנָּבֵא בֶּן־אָדָם׃

verses.english: YHWH’s spirit fell upon me, and He said to me, “Say, ‘Thus says YHWH: You have said this, house of Israel, and I know what rises in your spirit.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל עָלַי רוּחַ יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי אֱמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה כֵּן אֲמַרְתֶּם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַעֲלוֹת רוּחֲכֶם אֲנִי יְדַעְתִּיהָ׃

verses.english: You have multiplied your slain in this city and filled her streets with the slain.
verses.hebrew: הִרְבֵּיתֶם חַלְלֵיכֶם בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת וּמִלֵּאתֶם חוּצֹתֶיהָ חָלָל׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Your slain whom you have placed within her are the meat, and she is the pot; but you are to be brought out of her.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה חַלְלֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתֶּם בְּתוֹכָהּ הֵמָּה הַבָּשָׂר וְהִיא הַסִּיר וְאֶתְכֶם הוֹצִיא מִתּוֹכָהּ׃

verses.english: You have feared the sword, and I will bring a sword upon you, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: חֶרֶב יְרֵאתֶם וְחֶרֶב אָבִיא עֲלֵיכֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: I will bring you out of her midst, give you into strangers’ hands, and execute judgments among you.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מִתּוֹכָהּ וְנָתַתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּיַד־זָרִים וְעָשִׂיתִי בָכֶם שְׁפָטִים׃

verses.english: You will fall by the sword. At Israel’s border I will judge you, and you will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּחֶרֶב תִּפֹּלוּ עַל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶשְׁפּוֹט אֶתְכֶם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: She will not be a pot for you, nor will you be meat within her. At Israel’s border I will judge you.
verses.hebrew: הִיא לֹא־תִהְיֶה לָכֶם לְסִיר וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ בְתוֹכָהּ לְבָשָׂר אֶל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶשְׁפֹּט אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: You will know that I am YHWH, in whose statutes you have not walked and whose judgments you have not carried out; instead you have acted according to the judgments of the nations around you.’”
verses.hebrew: וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּחֻקַּי לֹא הֲלַכְתֶּם וּמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא עֲשִׂיתֶם וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

verses.english: As I prophesied, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. I fell upon my face and cried with a loud voice, saying, “Ah, Lord YHWH! You are making a complete end of Israel’s remnant!”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהִנָּבְאִי וּפְלַטְיָהוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָה מֵת וָאֶפֹּל עַל־פָּנַי וָאֶזְעַק קוֹל־גָּדוֹל וָאֹמַר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כָּלָה אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה אֵת שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, your brothers, your brothers, the men of your kinship, and the whole house of Israel, all of it—to them Jerusalem’s inhabitants have said, ‘Keep far from YHWH; the land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם אַחֶיךָ אַחֶיךָ אַנְשֵׁי גְאֻלָּתֶךָ וְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לָהֶם יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם רַחֲקוּ מֵעַל יְהוָה לָנוּ הִיא נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ לְמוֹרָשָׁה׃

verses.english: Therefore say, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: Though I have sent them far among the nations and scattered them among the lands, I have been a little sanctuary for them in the lands where they have gone.’
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כִּי הִרְחַקְתִּים בַּגּוֹיִם וְכִי הֲפִיצוֹתִים בָּאֲרָצוֹת וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמִקְדָּשׁ מְעַט בָּאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ שָׁם׃

verses.english: Therefore say, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: I will gather you from the peoples and collect you from the lands where you have been scattered, and I will give you the soil of Israel.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְקִבַּצְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָעַמִּים וְאָסַפְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר נְפֹצוֹתֶם בָּהֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They will come there and remove all her detestable things and all her abominations from her.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ־שָׁמָּה וְהֵסִירוּ אֶת־כָּל־שִׁקּוּצֶיהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃

verses.english: I will give them one heart and put a new spirit within you. I will remove the stone heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי לָהֶם לֵב אֶחָד וְרוּחַ חֲדָשָׁה אֶתֵּן בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וַהֲסִרֹתִי לֵב הָאֶבֶן מִבְּשָׂרָם וְנָתַתִּי לָהֶם לֵב בָּשָׂר׃

verses.english: so that they may walk in My statutes, keep My judgments and carry them out. They will be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן בְּחֻקֹּתַי יֵלֵכוּ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי יִשְׁמְרוּ וְעָשׂוּ אֹתָם וְהָיוּ־לִי לְעָם וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: But their heart goes toward the heart of their detestable things and their abominations; I have brought their way upon their head, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־לֵב שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶם לִבָּם הֹלֵךְ דַּרְכָּם בְּרֹאשָׁם נָתַתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: The cherubim lifted their wings, with the wheels alongside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכְּרוּבִים אֶת־כַּנְפֵיהֶם וְהָאוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם וּכְבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s glory rose from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain east of the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל כְּבוֹד יְהוָה מֵעַל תּוֹךְ הָעִיר וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִקֶּדֶם לָעִיר׃

verses.english: A spirit lifted me and brought me to Chaldea, to the exiles, in the vision by God’s spirit. The vision I had seen rose away from me.
verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ נְשָׂאַתְנִי וַתְּבִיאֵנִי כַשְׂדִּימָה אֶל־הַגּוֹלָה בַּמַּרְאֶה בְּרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל מֵעָלַי הַמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי׃

verses.english: I spoke to the exiles all YHWH’s words that He had shown me.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֶל־הַגּוֹלָה אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָנִי׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house. They have eyes to see but have not seen, ears to hear but have not heard, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית־הַמֶּרִי אַתָּה יֹשֵׁב אֲשֶׁר עֵינַיִם לָהֶם לִרְאוֹת וְלֹא רָאוּ אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם לִשְׁמֹעַ וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵם׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, prepare exile’s baggage for yourself and go into exile by day before their eyes. Go from your place to another place before their eyes; perhaps they will see, though they are a rebellious house.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם עֲשֵׂה לְךָ כְּלֵי גוֹלָה וּגְלֵה יוֹמָם לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְגָלִיתָ מִמְּקוֹמְךָ אֶל־מָקוֹם אַחֵר לְעֵינֵיהֶם אוּלַי יִרְאוּ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Bring your baggage out like exile’s baggage by day before their eyes, and you yourself shall go out in the evening before their eyes, like those going out into exile.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצֵאתָ כֵלֶיךָ כִּכְלֵי גוֹלָה יוֹמָם לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְאַתָּה תֵּצֵא בָעֶרֶב לְעֵינֵיהֶם כְּמוֹצָאֵי גּוֹלָה׃

verses.english: Before their eyes, dig for yourself through the wall and bring it out through it.
verses.hebrew: לְעֵינֵיהֶם חֲתָר־לְךָ בַקִּיר וְהוֹצֵאתָ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Before their eyes, carry it on your shoulder; bring it out in the dusk. Cover your face and do not see the land, for I have made you a portent to the house of Israel.”
verses.hebrew: לְעֵינֵיהֶם עַל־כָּתֵף תִּשָּׂא בָּעֲלָטָה תוֹצִיא פָּנֶיךָ תְכַסֶּה וְלֹא תִרְאֶה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ כִּי־מוֹפֵת נְתַתִּיךָ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: I did so, as I was commanded. I brought my baggage out like exile’s baggage by day, and in the evening I dug for myself through the wall by hand. I brought it out in the dusk, carrying it on my shoulder before their eyes.
verses.hebrew: וָאַעַשׂ כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוֵּיתִי כֵּלַי הוֹצֵאתִי כִּכְלֵי גוֹלָה יוֹמָם וּבָעֶרֶב חָתַרְתִּי־לִי בַקִּיר בְּיָד בָּעֲלָטָה הוֹצֵאתִי עַל־כָּתֵף נָשָׂאתִי לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: In the morning YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי בַּבֹּקֶר לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם הֲלֹא אָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית הַמֶּרִי מָה אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

verses.english: Say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and the whole house of Israel who are among them.’
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הַנָּשִׂיא הַמַּשָּׂא הַזֶּה בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה בְתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: Say, ‘I am your portent. As I have done, so it will be done to them; into exile, into captivity they will go.’
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲנִי מוֹפֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם בַּגּוֹלָה בַשְּׁבִי יֵלֵכוּ׃

verses.english: The prince among them will carry on his shoulder in the dusk and go out. They will dig through the wall to bring it out through it. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eye.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנָּשִׂיא אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכָם אֶל־כָּתֵף יִשָּׂא בָּעֲלָטָה וְיֵצֵא בַּקִּיר יַחְתְּרוּ לְהוֹצִיא בוֹ פָּנָיו יְכַסֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִרְאֶה לַעַיִן הוּא אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the Chaldeans’ land, yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
verses.hebrew: וּפָרַשְׂתִּי אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי עָלָיו וְנִתְפַּשׂ בִּמְצוּדָתִי וְהֵבֵאתִי אֹתוֹ בָבֶלָה אֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים וְאוֹתָהּ לֹא־יִרְאֶה וְשָׁם יָמוּת׃

verses.english: All those around him, his help and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind; I will draw a sword after them.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתָיו עזרה [עֶזְרוֹ] וְכָל־אֲגַפָּיו אֱזָרֶה לְכָל־רוּחַ וְחֶרֶב אָרִיק אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They will know that I am YHWH when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בַּהֲפִיצִי אוֹתָם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִי אוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: I will leave a few men of them from sword, famine and pestilence, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they have gone, and they will know that I am YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתַרְתִּי מֵהֶם אַנְשֵׁי מִסְפָּר מֵחֶרֶב מֵרָעָב וּמִדָּבֶר לְמַעַן יְסַפְּרוּ אֶת־כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶם בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ שָׁם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, eat your bread with shaking, and drink your water with trembling and anxiety.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם לַחְמְךָ בְּרַעַשׁ תֹּאכֵל וּמֵימֶיךָ בְּרָגְזָה וּבִדְאָגָה תִּשְׁתֶּה׃

verses.english: Say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH concerning Jerusalem’s inhabitants upon Israel’s soil: They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with dismay, so that her land may be desolated, stripped of its fullness, because of the violence of all who dwell in her.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־עַם הָאָרֶץ כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לְיוֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶל־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחְמָם בִּדְאָגָה יֹאכֵלוּ וּמֵימֵיהֶם בְּשִׁמָּמוֹן יִשְׁתּוּ לְמַעַן תֵּשַׁם אַרְצָהּ מִמְּלֹאָהּ מֵחֲמַס כָּל־הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

verses.english: The inhabited cities will be ruined, and the land will be desolate. You will know that I am YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים הַנּוֹשָׁבוֹת תֶּחֱרַבְנָה וְהָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה תִהְיֶה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have concerning Israel’s soil, saying, ‘The days grow long, and every vision perishes’?
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם מָה־הַמָּשָׁל הַזֶּה לָכֶם עַל־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יַאַרְכוּ הַיָּמִים וְאָבַד כָּל־חָזוֹן׃

verses.english: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: I have put an end to this proverb; they will no longer use it as a proverb in Israel.’ Instead, speak to them: ‘The days have drawn near, and so has the word of every vision.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִשְׁבַּתִּי אֶת־הַמָּשָׁל הַזֶּה וְלֹא־יִמְשְׁלוּ אֹתוֹ עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־דַּבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם קָרְבוּ הַיָּמִים וּדְבַר כָּל־חָזוֹן׃

verses.english: For there will no longer be any empty vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד כָּל־חֲזוֹן שָׁוְא וּמִקְסַם חָלָק בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: For I, YHWH, will speak what I will speak—a word, and it will be done. It will no longer be delayed, for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak a word and do it, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֲדַבֵּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר דָּבָר וְיֵעָשֶׂה לֹא תִמָּשֵׁךְ עוֹד כִּי בִימֵיכֶם בֵּית הַמֶּרִי אֲדַבֵּר דָּבָר וַעֲשִׂיתִיו נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, behold, the house of Israel says, ‘The vision he sees is for many days ahead; he prophesies for distant times.’
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם הִנֵּה בֵית־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹמְרִים הֶחָזוֹן אֲשֶׁר־הוּא חֹזֶה לְיָמִים רַבִּים וּלְעִתִּים רְחוֹקוֹת הוּא נִבָּא׃

verses.english: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: None of My words will be delayed any longer. Whatever word I speak will be done, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֹא־תִמָּשֵׁךְ עוֹד כָּל־דְּבָרָי אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר דָּבָר וְיֵעָשֶׂה נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s prophets who prophesy, and say to those prophesying from their own heart, ‘Hear YHWH’s word!
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם הִנָּבֵא אֶל־נְבִיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּבָּאִים וְאָמַרְתָּ לִנְבִיאֵי מִלִּבָּם שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הוֹי עַל־הַנְּבִיאִים הַנְּבָלִים אֲשֶׁר הֹלְכִים אַחַר רוּחָם וּלְבִלְתִּי רָאוּ׃

verses.english: Your prophets, Israel, have been like foxes among ruins.
verses.hebrew: כְּשֻׁעָלִים בָּחֳרָבוֹת נְבִיאֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיוּ׃

verses.english: You have not gone up into the breaches or built a fence around the house of Israel to stand in battle on YHWH’s day.
verses.hebrew: לֹא עֲלִיתֶם בַּפְּרָצוֹת וַתִּגְדְּרוּ גָדֵר עַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲמֹד בַּמִּלְחָמָה בְּיוֹם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They have seen emptiness and lying divination, those who say, ‘YHWH declares,’ although YHWH has not sent them; yet they hope for a word to be confirmed.
verses.hebrew: חָזוּ שָׁוְא וְקֶסֶם כָּזָב הָאֹמְרִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה וַיהוָה לֹא שְׁלָחָם וְיִחֲלוּ לְקַיֵּם דָּבָר׃

verses.english: Have you not seen an empty vision and spoken lying divination, saying, ‘YHWH declares,’ although I have not spoken?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא מַחֲזֵה־שָׁוְא חֲזִיתֶם וּמִקְסַם כָּזָב אֲמַרְתֶּם וְאֹמְרִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה וַאֲנִי לֹא דִבַּרְתִּי׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you have spoken emptiness and seen lies, therefore behold, I am against you, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן דַּבֶּרְכֶם שָׁוְא וַחֲזִיתֶם כָּזָב לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֲלֵיכֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: My hand will be against the prophets who see emptiness and divine lies. They will not belong to My people’s council, nor be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter Israel’s soil. You will know that I am Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה יָדִי אֶל־הַנְּבִיאִים הַחֹזִים שָׁוְא וְהַקֹּסְמִים כָּזָב בְּסוֹד עַמִּי לֹא־יִהְיוּ וּבִכְתָב בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִכָּתֵבוּ וְאֶל־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יָבֹאוּ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: Because, yes because, they have misled My people, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and one builds a partition, and behold, they coat it with unsound plaster—
verses.hebrew: יַעַן וּבְיַעַן הִטְעוּ אֶת־עַמִּי לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם וְאֵין שָׁלוֹם וְהוּא בֹּנֶה חַיִץ וְהִנָּם טָחִים אֹתוֹ תָּפֵל׃

verses.english: say to those coating it with unsound plaster that it will fall. There will be a flooding downpour, and you, hailstones, will fall; a storm wind will split it.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֶל־טָחֵי תָפֵל וְיִפֹּל הָיָה גֶּשֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף וְאַתֵּנָה אַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ תִּפֹּלְנָה וְרוּחַ סְעָרוֹת תְּבַקֵּעַ׃

verses.english: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will it not be said to you, ‘Where is the coating with which you coated it?’
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה נָפַל הַקִּיר הֲלוֹא יֵאָמֵר אֲלֵיכֶם אַיֵּה הַטִּיחַ אֲשֶׁר טַחְתֶּם׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I will unleash a storm wind in My fury; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and hailstones in fury for complete destruction.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וּבִקַּעְתִּי רוּחַ־סְעָרוֹת בַּחֲמָתִי וְגֶשֶׁם שֹׁטֵף בְּאַפִּי יִהְיֶה וְאַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ בְּחֵמָה לְכָלָה׃

verses.english: I will tear down the wall you coated with unsound plaster and bring it to the ground; its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed within it. You will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָרַסְתִּי אֶת־הַקִּיר אֲשֶׁר־טַחְתֶּם תָּפֵל וְהִגַּעְתִּיהוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ וְנִגְלָה יְסֹדוֹ וְנָפְלָה וּכְלִיתֶם בְּתוֹכָהּ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: I will spend My fury upon the wall and those coating it with unsound plaster, and say to you, ‘There is no wall, and there are no people coating it—
verses.hebrew: וְכִלֵּיתִי אֶת־חֲמָתִי בַּקִּיר וּבַטָּחִים אֹתוֹ תָּפֵל וְאֹמַר לָכֶם אֵין הַקִּיר וְאֵין הַטָּחִים אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and see a vision of peace for her, when there is no peace,’ declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: נְבִיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִבְּאִים אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְהַחֹזִים לָהּ חֲזוֹן שָׁלֹם וְאֵין שָׁלֹם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל־בְּנוֹת עַמְּךָ הַמִּתְנַבְּאוֹת מִלִּבְּהֶן וְהִנָּבֵא עֲלֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: Say, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: Woe to the women sewing cushions upon all the joints of My hands and making coverings upon the head of every stature, to hunt lives! You hunt the lives of My people and keep lives alive for yourselves.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הוֹי לִמְתַפְּרוֹת כְּסָתוֹת עַל כָּל־אַצִּילֵי יָדַי וְעֹשׂוֹת הַמִּסְפָּחוֹת עַל־רֹאשׁ כָּל־קוֹמָה לְצוֹדֵד נְפָשׁוֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת תְּצוֹדֵדְנָה לְעַמִּי וּנְפָשׁוֹת לָכֶנָה תְחַיֶּינָה׃

verses.english: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread, putting to death lives that should not die and keeping alive lives that should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּחַלֶּלְנָה אֹתִי אֶל־עַמִּי בְּשַׁעֲלֵי שְׂעֹרִים וּבִפְתוֹתֵי לֶחֶם לְהָמִית נְפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְמוּתֶנָה וּלְחַיּוֹת נְפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תִחְיֶינָה בְּכַזֶּבְכֶם לְעַמִּי שֹׁמְעֵי כָזָב׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I am against your cushions, with which you hunt lives there as flying things. I will tear them from your arms and release the lives—the lives you hunt as flying things.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי אֶל־כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶנָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֵּנָה מְצֹדְדוֹת שָׁם אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת לְפֹרְחוֹת וְקָרַעְתִּי אֹתָם מֵעַל זְרוֹעֹתֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם מְצֹדְדוֹת אֶת־נְפָשִׁים לְפֹרְחֹת׃

verses.english: I will tear your coverings and rescue My people from your hand. They will no longer be in your hand as prey, and you will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְקָרַעְתִּי אֶת־מִסְפְּחֹתֵיכֶם וְהִצַּלְתִּי אֶת־עַמִּי מִיֶּדְכֶן וְלֹא־יִהְיוּ עוֹד בְּיֶדְכֶן לִמְצוּדָה וִידַעְתֶּן כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Because you have falsely grieved the righteous person’s heart, though I did not pain him, and strengthened the wicked person’s hands so that he does not turn from his evil way to preserve his life,
verses.hebrew: יַעַן הַכְאוֹת לֵב־צַדִּיק שֶׁקֶר וַאֲנִי לֹא הִכְאַבְתִּיו וּלְחַזֵּק יְדֵי רָשָׁע לְבִלְתִּי־שׁוּב מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרָע לְהַחֲיֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: therefore you will no longer see emptiness or practice divination. I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׁוְא לֹא תֶחֱזֶינָה וְקֶסֶם לֹא־תִקְסַמְנָה עוֹד וְהִצַּלְתִּי אֶת־עַמִּי מִיֶּדְכֶן וִידַעְתֶּן כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Men from Israel’s elders came to me and sat before me.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא אֵלַי אֲנָשִׁים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לְפָנָי׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, these men have raised their idols upon their heart and set the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces. Should I indeed let them inquire of Me?
