verses.english: They prostituted themselves in Egypt; in their youth they prostituted themselves. There their breasts were pressed, and there their virgin breasts were handled.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּזְנֶינָה בְמִצְרַיִם בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶן זָנוּ שָׁמָּה מֹעֲכוּ שְׁדֵיהֶן וְשָׁם עִשּׂוּ דַּדֵּי בְּתוּלֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine and bore sons and daughters. As for their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוֹתָן אָהֳלָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וְאָהֳלִיבָה אֲחוֹתָהּ וַתִּהְיֶינָה לִי וַתֵּלַדְנָה בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּשְׁמוֹתָן שֹׁמְרוֹן אָהֳלָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם אָהֳלִיבָה׃

verses.english: Oholah prostituted herself while under Me, and lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians near her,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּזֶן אָהֳלָה תַּחְתָּי וַתַּעְגַּב עַל־מְאַהֲבֶיהָ אֶל־אַשּׁוּר קְרוֹבִים׃

verses.english: clothed in blue-purple, governors and deputies, all desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.
verses.hebrew: לְבֻשֵׁי תְכֵלֶת פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִים בַּחוּרֵי חֶמֶד כֻּלָּם פָּרָשִׁים רֹכְבֵי סוּסִים׃

verses.english: She bestowed her prostitution upon them, all the choicest sons of Assyria. With all whom she lusted after, with all their idols, she defiled herself.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּן תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ עֲלֵיהֶם מִבְחַר בְּנֵי־אַשּׁוּר כֻּלָּם וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָגְבָה בְּכָל־גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם נִטְמָאָה׃

verses.english: She did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, for they had lain with her in her youth; they had handled her virgin breasts and poured their prostitution upon her.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא עָזָבָה כִּי אוֹתָהּ שָׁכְבוּ בִנְעוּרֶיהָ וְהֵמָּה עִשּׂוּ דַּדֵּי בְתוּלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ תַזְנוּתָם עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Therefore I gave her into her lovers’ hand, into the hand of Assyria’s sons, after whom she had lusted.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן נְתַתִּיהָ בְּיַד־מְאַהֲבֶיהָ בְּיַד בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עָגְבָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They uncovered her nakedness, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a name among women, and they executed judgments upon her.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה גִּלּוּ עֶרְוָתָהּ בָּנֶיהָ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ לָקָחוּ וְאוֹתָהּ בַּחֶרֶב הָרָגוּ וַתְּהִי־שֵׁם לַנָּשִׁים וּשְׁפוּטִים עָשׂוּ בָהּ׃

verses.english: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet made her lust more corrupt than hers, and her prostitution greater than her sister’s prostitution.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא אֲחוֹתָהּ אָהֳלִיבָה וַתַּשְׁחֵת עַגְבָתָהּ מִמֶּנָּה וְאֶת־תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ מִזְּנוּנֵי אֲחוֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: She lusted after Assyria’s sons, governors and deputies near her, clothed in splendor, horsemen riding horses, all desirable young men.
verses.hebrew: אֶל־בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר עָגָבָה פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִים קְרֹבִים לְבֻשֵׁי מִכְלוֹל פָּרָשִׁים רֹכְבֵי סוּסִים בַּחוּרֵי חֶמֶד כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: I saw that she was defiled; the two had one way.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא כִּי נִטְמָאָה דֶּרֶךְ אֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּיהֶן׃

verses.english: She added to her prostitution. She saw men portrayed upon the wall, images of Chaldeans inscribed in vermilion,
verses.hebrew: וַתּוֹסֶף אֶל־תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא אַנְשֵׁי מְחֻקֶּה עַל־הַקִּיר צַלְמֵי כשדיים [כַשְׂדִּים] חֲקֻקִים בַּשָּׁשַׁר׃

verses.english: belted at their waists, with flowing headgear upon their heads, all looking like officers, the likeness of Babylon’s sons, Chaldeans whose land was their birthplace.
verses.hebrew: חֲגוֹרֵי אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם סְרוּחֵי טְבוּלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם מַרְאֵה שָׁלִשִׁים כֻּלָּם דְּמוּת בְּנֵי־בָבֶל כַּשְׂדִּים אֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתָּם׃

verses.english: She lusted after them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
verses.hebrew: ותעגב [וַתַּעְגְּבָה] עֲלֵיהֶם לְמַרְאֵה עֵינֶיהָ וַתִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲלֵיהֶם כַּשְׂדִּימָה׃

verses.english: Babylon’s sons came to her, to a bed of lovemaking, and defiled her with their prostitution. She was defiled by them, and her soul recoiled from them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְנֵי־בָבֶל לְמִשְׁכַּב דֹּדִים וַיְטַמְּאוּ אוֹתָהּ בְּתַזְנוּתָם וַתִּטְמָא־בָם וַתֵּקַע נַפְשָׁהּ מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: She uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. My soul recoiled from her, as My soul had recoiled from her sister.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּגַל תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ וַתְּגַל אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ וַתֵּקַע נַפְשִׁי מֵעָלֶיהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נָקְעָה נַפְשִׁי מֵעַל אֲחוֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: She multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in Egypt’s land.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּרְבֶּה אֶת־תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ לִזְכֹּר אֶת־יְמֵי נְעוּרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר זָנְתָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh was like donkeys’ flesh and whose emission was like horses’ emission.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעְגְּבָה עַל פִּלַגְשֵׁיהֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׂר־חֲמוֹרִים בְּשָׂרָם וְזִרְמַת סוּסִים זִרְמָתָם׃

verses.english: You revisited the lewdness of your youth, when those from Egypt handled your breasts on account of your youthful breasts.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְקְדִי אֵת זִמַּת נְעוּרָיִךְ בַּעְשׂוֹת מִמִּצְרַיִם דַּדַּיִךְ לְמַעַן שְׁדֵי נְעוּרָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul recoiled. I will bring them against you all around:
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אָהֳלִיבָה כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי מֵעִיר אֶת־מְאַהֲבַיִךְ עָלַיִךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָקְעָה נַפְשֵׁךְ מֵהֶם וַהֲבֵאתִים עָלַיִךְ מִסָּבִיב׃

verses.english: Babylon’s sons and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa and Koa, all Assyria’s sons with them, desirable young men, all governors and deputies, officers and renowned men, all riding horses.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בָבֶל וְכָל־כַּשְׂדִּים פְּקוֹד וְשׁוֹעַ וְקוֹעַ כָּל־בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר אוֹתָם בַּחוּרֵי חֶמֶד פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִים כֻּלָּם שָׁלִשִׁים וּקְרוּאִים רֹכְבֵי סוּסִים כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: They will come against you with armament, chariots and wheels, and with an assembly of peoples. They will set large shield, small shield and helmet against you all around. I will set judgment before them, and they will judge you by their judgments.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ עָלַיִךְ הֹצֶן רֶכֶב וְגַלְגַּל וּבִקְהַל עַמִּים צִנָּה וּמָגֵן וְקוֹבַע יָשִׂימוּ עָלַיִךְ סָבִיב וְנָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיהֶם מִשְׁפָּט וּשְׁפָטוּךְ בְּמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I will set My jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will remove your nose and ears; your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי קִנְאָתִי בָּךְ וְעָשׂוּ אוֹתָךְ בְּחֵמָה אַפֵּךְ וְאָזְנַיִךְ יָסִירוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵךְ בַּחֶרֶב תִּפּוֹל הֵמָּה בָּנַיִךְ וּבְנוֹתַיִךְ יִקָּחוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵךְ תֵּאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ׃

verses.english: They will strip you of your clothes and take your splendid ornaments.
verses.hebrew: וְהִפְשִׁיטוּךְ אֶת־בְּגָדָיִךְ וְלָקְחוּ כְּלֵי תִפְאַרְתֵּךְ׃

verses.english: I will put an end to your lewdness from you and your prostitution from Egypt’s land. You will not lift your eyes toward them, and you will no longer remember Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי זִמָּתֵךְ מִמֵּךְ וְאֶת־זְנוּתֵךְ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא־תִשְׂאִי עֵינַיִךְ אֲלֵיהֶם וּמִצְרַיִם לֹא תִזְכְּרִי־עוֹד׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I am giving you into the hand of those you hated, into the hand of those from whom your soul recoiled.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי נֹתְנָךְ בְּיַד אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵאת בְּיַד אֲשֶׁר־נָקְעָה נַפְשֵׁךְ מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: They will deal with you in hatred, take all your labor’s yield, and leave you stark naked. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, with your lewdness and your prostitution.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשׂוּ אוֹתָךְ בְּשִׂנְאָה וְלָקְחוּ כָּל־יְגִיעֵךְ וַעֲזָבוּךְ עֵירֹם וְעֶרְיָה וְנִגְלָה עֶרְוַת זְנוּנַיִךְ וְזִמָּתֵךְ וְתַזְנוּתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: These things will be done to you because you prostituted yourself after nations, because you were defiled with their idols.
verses.hebrew: עָשֹׂה אֵלֶּה לָךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ אַחֲרֵי גוֹיִם עַל אֲשֶׁר־נִטְמֵאת בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: You walked in your sister’s way; I will put her cup into your hand.
verses.hebrew: בְּדֶרֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵךְ הָלָכְתְּ וְנָתַתִּי כוֹסָהּ בְּיָדֵךְ׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: You will drink your sister’s cup, deep and wide. You will become a laughingstock and a mockery; it holds much.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה כּוֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ תִּשְׁתִּי הָעֲמֻקָּה וְהָרְחָבָה תִּהְיֶה לִצְחֹק וּלְלַעַג מִרְבָּה לְהָכִיל׃

verses.english: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief: a cup of horror and desolation, your sister Samaria’s cup.
verses.hebrew: שִׁכָּרוֹן וְיָגוֹן תִּמָּלֵאִי כּוֹס שַׁמָּה וּשְׁמָמָה כּוֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

verses.english: You will drink it and drain it, gnaw its shards and tear your breasts, for I have spoken, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁתִית אוֹתָהּ וּמָצִית וְאֶת־חֲרָשֶׂיהָ תְּגָרֵמִי וְשָׁדַיִךְ תְּנַתֵּקִי כִּי אֲנִי דִבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you forgot Me and cast Me behind your back, you too must bear your lewdness and your prostitution.”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן שָׁכַחַתְּ אוֹתִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכִי אוֹתִי אַחֲרֵי גַוֵּךְ וְגַם־אַתְּ שְׂאִי זִמָּתֵךְ וְאֶת־תַּזְנוּתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Tell them their abominations,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם הֲתִשְׁפּוֹט אֶת־אָהֳלָה וְאֶת־אָהֳלִיבָה וְהַגֵּד לָהֶן אֵת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: for they committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols, and even made their sons whom they bore to Me pass over to them for food.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נִאֵפוּ וְדָם בִּידֵיהֶן וְאֶת־גִּלּוּלֵיהֶן נִאֵפוּ וְגַם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר יָלְדוּ־לִי הֶעֱבִירוּ לָהֶם לְאָכְלָה׃

verses.english: They also did this to Me: they defiled My sanctuary on that day and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.hebrew: עוֹד זֹאת עָשׂוּ לִי טִמְּאוּ אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַי חִלֵּלוּ׃

verses.english: When they slaughtered their sons for their idols, they came into My sanctuary on that same day to profane it. Behold, they did this within My house.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשַׁחֲטָם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם לְגִלּוּלֵיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְחַלְּלוֹ וְהִנֵּה־כֹה עָשׂוּ בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתִי׃

verses.english: Moreover, they sent for men coming from far away, to whom a messenger was sent; behold, they came. For them you washed, painted your eyes and adorned yourself with ornaments.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף כִּי תִשְׁלַחְנָה לַאֲנָשִׁים בָּאִים מִמֶּרְחָק אֲשֶׁר מַלְאָךְ שָׁלוּחַ אֲלֵיהֶם וְהִנֵּה־בָאוּ לַאֲשֶׁר רָחַצְתְּ כָּחַלְתְּ עֵינַיִךְ וְעָדִית עֶדִי׃

verses.english: You sat upon a splendid couch with a table arranged before it, and put My incense and My oil upon it.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ עַל־מִטָּה כְבוּדָּה וְשֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ לְפָנֶיהָ וּקְטָרְתִּי וְשַׁמְנִי שַׂמְתְּ עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: The sound of a carefree crowd was within her. Along with men from the mass of humanity, drinkers were brought from the wilderness. They put bracelets upon the women’s hands and a splendid crown upon their heads.
verses.hebrew: וְקוֹל הָמוֹן שָׁלֵו בָהּ וְאֶל־אֲנָשִׁים מֵרֹב אָדָם מוּבָאִים סובאים [סָבָאִים] מִמִּדְבָּר וַיִּתְּנוּ צְמִידִים אֶל־יְדֵיהֶן וַעֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶן׃

verses.english: I said concerning the one worn out in adulteries, ‘Now prostitution will be practiced with her—and she herself!’
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לַבָּלָה נִאוּפִים עת [עַתָּה] יזנה [יִזְנוּ] תַזְנוּתֶהָ וָהִיא׃

verses.english: One entered her as one enters a prostitute; so they entered Oholah and Oholibah, women of lewdness.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא אֵלֶיהָ כְּבוֹא אֶל־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה כֵּן בָּאוּ אֶל־אָהֳלָה וְאֶל־אָהֳלִיבָה אִשֹּׁת הַזִּמָּה׃

verses.english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and the judgment of women shedding blood, for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנָשִׁים צַדִּיקִם הֵמָּה יִשְׁפְּטוּ אוֹתְהֶם מִשְׁפַּט נֹאֲפוֹת וּמִשְׁפַּט שֹׁפְכוֹת דָּם כִּי נֹאֲפֹת הֵנָּה וְדָם בִּידֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: Bring an assembly against them and give them over to terror and plunder.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הַעֲלֵה עֲלֵיהֶם קָהָל וְנָתֹן אֶתְהֶן לְזַעֲוָה וְלָבַז׃

verses.english: The assembly will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses with fire.
verses.hebrew: וְרָגְמוּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶבֶן קָהָל וּבָרֵא אוֹתְהֶן בְּחַרְבוֹתָם בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם יַהֲרֹגוּ וּבָתֵּיהֶן בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרֹפוּ׃

verses.english: I will end lewdness from the land. All women will be disciplined and will not act according to your lewdness.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי זִמָּה מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְנִוַּסְּרוּ כָּל־הַנָּשִׁים וְלֹא תַעֲשֶׂינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶנָה׃

verses.english: They will bring your lewdness upon you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. You will know that I am Lord YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ זִמַּתְכֶנָה עֲלֵיכֶן וַחֲטָאֵי גִלּוּלֵיכֶן תִּשֶּׂאינָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי בַּשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִית בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day. Babylon’s king has pressed against Jerusalem on this very day.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם כתוב־[כְּתָב־] לְךָ אֶת־שֵׁם הַיּוֹם אֶת־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה סָמַךְ מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Speak a parable to the rebellious house and say to them, ‘Thus says Lord YHWH: Set on the pot, set it on, and pour water into it.
verses.hebrew: וּמְשֹׁל אֶל־בֵּית־הַמֶּרִי מָשָׁל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר שְׁפֹת וְגַם־יְצֹק בּוֹ מָיִם׃

verses.english: Gather its pieces into it, every good piece, thigh and shoulder; fill it with the choicest bones.
verses.hebrew: אֱסֹף נְתָחֶיהָ אֵלֶיהָ כָּל־נֵתַח טוֹב יָרֵךְ וְכָתֵף מִבְחַר עֲצָמִים מַלֵּא׃

verses.english: Take the choicest of the flock; also heap the bones beneath it. Make it boil vigorously; let its bones also cook within it.
verses.hebrew: מִבְחַר הַצֹּאן לָקוֹחַ וְגַם דּוּר הָעֲצָמִים תַּחְתֶּיהָ רַתַּח רְתָחֶיהָ גַּם־בָּשְׁלוּ עֲצָמֶיהָ בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Woe, city of bloodshed! A pot with its rust in it, whose rust has not come out of it! Bring it out piece by piece; no lot has fallen upon it.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה אוֹי עִיר הַדָּמִים סִיר אֲשֶׁר חֶלְאָתָה בָהּ וְחֶלְאָתָהּ לֹא יָצְאָה מִמֶּנָּה לִנְתָחֶיהָ לִנְתָחֶיהָ הוֹצִיאָהּ לֹא־נָפַל עָלֶיהָ גּוֹרָל׃

verses.english: For her blood was within her. She put it upon bare rock; she did not pour it upon the ground to cover it with dust.
verses.hebrew: כִּי דָמָהּ בְּתוֹכָהּ הָיָה עַל־צְחִיחַ סֶלַע שָׂמָתְהוּ לֹא שְׁפָכַתְהוּ עַל־הָאָרֶץ לְכַסּוֹת עָלָיו עָפָר׃

verses.english: To stir up fury, to exact vengeance, I set her blood upon bare rock so that it would not be covered.
verses.hebrew: לְהַעֲלוֹת חֵמָה לִנְקֹם נָקָם נָתַתִּי אֶת־דָּמָהּ עַל־צְחִיחַ סָלַע לְבִלְתִּי הִכָּסוֹת׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Woe, city of bloodshed! I too will enlarge the pyre.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אוֹי עִיר הַדָּמִים גַּם־אֲנִי אַגְדִּיל הַמְּדוּרָה׃

verses.english: Heap up the wood, kindle the fire, finish cooking the flesh, mix the seasoning, and let the bones be burned.
verses.hebrew: הַרְבֵּה הָעֵצִים הַדְלֵק הָאֵשׁ הָתֵם הַבָּשָׂר וְהַרְקַח הַמֶּרְקָחָה וְהָעֲצָמוֹת יֵחָרוּ׃

verses.english: Stand it empty upon its coals, so that its copper becomes hot and glows, its uncleanness melts within it and its rust is consumed.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמִידֶהָ עַל־גֶּחָלֶיהָ רֵקָה לְמַעַן תֵּחַם וְחָרָה נְחֻשְׁתָּהּ וְנִתְּכָה בְתוֹכָהּ טֻמְאָתָהּ תִּתֻּם חֶלְאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: She has exhausted herself with toil, yet her abundant rust will not leave her. Into the fire with her rust!
verses.hebrew: תְּאֻנִים הֶלְאָת וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִמֶּנָּה רַבַּת חֶלְאָתָהּ בְּאֵשׁ חֶלְאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: In your uncleanness is lewdness. Because I cleansed you but you were not clean, you will no longer be cleansed from your uncleanness until I let My fury rest upon you.
verses.hebrew: בְּטֻמְאָתֵךְ זִמָּה יַעַן טִהַרְתִּיךְ וְלֹא טָהַרְתְּ מִטֻּמְאָתֵךְ לֹא תִטְהֲרִי־עוֹד עַד־הֲנִיחִי אֶת־חֲמָתִי בָּךְ׃

verses.english: I, YHWH, have spoken. It comes, and I will act. I will not let go, spare or relent. According to your ways and your deeds they will judge you, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי בָּאָה וְעָשִׂיתִי לֹא־אֶפְרַע וְלֹא־אָחוּס וְלֹא אֶנָּחֵם כִּדְרָכַיִךְ וְכַעֲלִילוֹתַיִךְ שְׁפָטוּךְ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, behold, I am taking the delight of your eyes from you by a blow. You shall not lament or weep, and your tears shall not come.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם הִנְנִי לֹקֵחַ מִמְּךָ אֶת־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ בְּמַגֵּפָה וְלֹא תִסְפֹּד וְלֹא תִבְכֶּה וְלוֹא תָבוֹא דִּמְעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Groan silently; do not perform mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress upon you and put your sandals on your feet. Do not cover your upper lip or eat the bread of men.
verses.hebrew: הֵאָנֵק דֹּם מֵתִים אֵבֶל לֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה פְאֵרְךָ חֲבוֹשׁ עָלֶיךָ וּנְעָלֶיךָ תָּשִׂים בְּרַגְלֶיךָ וְלֹא תַעְטֶה עַל־שָׂפָם וְלֶחֶם אֲנָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening. In the morning I did as I had been commanded.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֶל־הָעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַתָּמָת אִשְׁתִּי בָּעָרֶב וָאַעַשׂ בַּבֹּקֶר כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוֵּיתִי׃

verses.english: The people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these things that you are doing mean for us?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי הָעָם הֲלֹא־תַגִּיד לָנוּ מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּנוּ כִּי אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

verses.english: I said to them, “YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵיהֶם דְּבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: ‘Say to Israel’s house, Thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I am profaning My sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes, what your soul cherishes. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי מְחַלֵּל אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם מַחְמַד עֵינֵיכֶם וּמַחְמַל נַפְשְׁכֶם וּבְנֵיכֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתֶּם בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: You will do as I have done: you will not cover your upper lip or eat the bread of men.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עַל־שָׂפָם לֹא תַעְטוּ וְלֶחֶם אֲנָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃

verses.english: Your headdresses will be upon your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not lament or weep, but waste away in your iniquities and groan, each to his brother.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאֵרֵכֶם עַל־רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְנַעֲלֵיכֶם בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם לֹא תִסְפְּדוּ וְלֹא תִבְכּוּ וּנְמַקֹּתֶם בַּעֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם וּנְהַמְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו׃

verses.english: Ezekiel will be a portent for you; according to everything he has done, you will do. When it comes, you will know that I am Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה יְחֶזְקֵאל לָכֶם לְמוֹפֵת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה תַּעֲשׂוּ בְּבֹאָהּ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, the delight of their eyes, the longing of their soul, their sons and daughters—
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם הֲלוֹא בְּיוֹם קַחְתִּי מֵהֶם אֶת־מָעוּזָּם מְשׂוֹשׂ תִּפְאַרְתָּם אֶת־מַחְמַד עֵינֵיהֶם וְאֶת־מַשָּׂא נַפְשָׁם בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: on that day the survivor will come to you to bring a report to your ears?
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יָבוֹא הַפָּלִיט אֵלֶיךָ לְהַשְׁמָעוּת אָזְנָיִם׃

verses.english: On that day your mouth will be opened with the survivor; you will speak and no longer be mute. You will be a portent for them, and they will know that I am YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִפָּתַח פִּיךָ אֶת־הַפָּלִיט וּתְדַבֵּר וְלֹא תֵאָלֵם עוֹד וְהָיִיתָ לָהֶם לְמוֹפֵת וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, set your face toward the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהִנָּבֵא עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Say to Ammon’s sons, ‘Hear Lord YHWH’s word! Thus says Lord YHWH: Because you said, “Aha!” over My sanctuary when it was profaned, over Israel’s soil when it was laid waste, and over Judah’s house when they went into exile,
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמּוֹן שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן אָמְרֵךְ הֶאָח אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁי כִי־נִחָל וְאֶל־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָשַׁמָּה וְאֶל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה כִּי הָלְכוּ בַּגּוֹלָה׃

verses.english: therefore behold, I am giving you to the sons of the east as a possession. They will settle their encampments in you and set their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי נֹתְנָךְ לִבְנֵי־קֶדֶם לְמוֹרָשָׁה וְיִשְּׁבוּ טִירוֹתֵיהֶם בָּךְ וְנָתְנוּ בָךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶם הֵמָּה יֹאכְלוּ פִרְיֵךְ וְהֵמָּה יִשְׁתּוּ חֲלָבֵךְ׃

verses.english: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon’s sons a resting place for sheep. You will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־רַבָּה לִנְוֵה גְמַלִּים וְאֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְמִרְבַּץ־צֹאן וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: Because you clapped your hand and stamped your foot, and rejoiced with all your contempt in your soul against Israel’s soil,
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן מַחְאֲךָ יָד וְרַקְעֲךָ בְּרָגֶל וַתִּשְׂמַח בְּכָל־שָׁאטְךָ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֶל־אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: therefore behold, I have stretched My hand against you. I will give you as plunder to the nations, cut you off from the peoples and make you perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am YHWH.’
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי נָטִיתִי אֶת־יָדִי עָלֶיךָ וּנְתַתִּיךָ־לבג [לְבַז] לַגּוֹיִם וְהִכְרַתִּיךָ מִן־הָעַמִּים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּיךָ מִן־הָאֲרָצוֹת אַשְׁמִידְךָ וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because Moab and Seir said, ‘Behold, Judah’s house is like all the nations,’
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן אֲמֹר מוֹאָב וְשֵׂעִיר הִנֵּה כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם בֵּית יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: therefore behold, I am opening Moab’s flank, removing the cities, its border cities, the land’s splendor: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי פֹתֵחַ אֶת־כֶּתֶף מוֹאָב מֵהֶעָרִים מֵעָרָיו מִקָּצֵהוּ צְבִי אֶרֶץ בֵּית הַיְשִׁימֹת בַּעַל מְעוֹן וקריתמה [וְקִרְיָתָיְמָה׃]

verses.english: to the sons of the east, along with Ammon’s sons. I will give her as a possession, so that Ammon’s sons will not be remembered among the nations.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי־קֶדֶם עַל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְמוֹרָשָׁה לְמַעַן לֹא־תִזָּכֵר בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן בַּגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: I will execute judgments upon Moab, and they will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבְמוֹאָב אֶעֱשֶׂה שְׁפָטִים וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because Edom acted by taking vengeance on Judah’s house, became deeply guilty and took vengeance upon them,
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן עֲשׂוֹת אֱדוֹם בִּנְקֹם נָקָם לְבֵית יְהוּדָה וַיֶּאְשְׁמוּ אָשׁוֹם וְנִקְּמוּ בָהֶם׃

verses.english: therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I will stretch My hand against Edom and cut off human and animal from her. I will make her a waste from Teman; as far as Dedan they will fall by the sword.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְנָטִתִי יָדִי עַל־אֱדוֹם וְהִכְרַתִּי מִמֶּנָּה אָדָם וּבְהֵמָה וּנְתַתִּיהָ חָרְבָּה מִתֵּימָן וּדְדָנֶה בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: I will place My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel. They will act upon Edom according to My anger and My fury, and they will know My vengeance, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־נִקְמָתִי בֶּאֱדוֹם בְּיַד עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָשׂוּ בֶאֱדוֹם כְּאַפִּי וְכַחֲמָתִי וְיָדְעוּ אֶת־נִקְמָתִי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, avenged themselves with contempt in their soul, to destroy in everlasting hostility,
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן עֲשׂוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים בִּנְקָמָה וַיִּנָּקְמוּ נָקָם בִּשְׁאָט בְּנֶפֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִית אֵיבַת עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Behold, I am stretching My hand against the Philistines. I will cut off the Cherethites and make the remnant of the seacoast perish.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי נוֹטֶה יָדִי עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־כְּרֵתִים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת־שְׁאֵרִית חוֹף הַיָּם׃

verses.english: I will execute great acts of vengeance upon them with furious rebukes. They will know that I am YHWH when I bring My vengeance upon them.”
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתִי בָם נְקָמוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת בְּתוֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי אֶת־נִקְמָתִי בָּם׃

verses.english: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעַשְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, Aha! The gateway of the peoples is broken; she has turned to me. I will be filled now that she is laid waste,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־אָמְרָה צֹּר עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם הֶאָח נִשְׁבְּרָה דַּלְתוֹת הָעַמִּים נָסֵבָּה אֵלָי אִמָּלְאָה הָחֳרָבָה׃

verses.english: therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי עָלַיִךְ צֹר וְהַעֲלֵיתִי עָלַיִךְ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים כְּהַעֲלוֹת הַיָּם לְגַלָּיו׃

verses.english: They will destroy Tyre's walls and tear down her towers. I will scrape her dust from her and make her a bare rock.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁחֲתוּ חֹמוֹת צֹר וְהָרְסוּ מִגְדָּלֶיהָ וְסִחֵיתִי עֲפָרָהּ מִמֶּנָּה וְנָתַתִּי אוֹתָהּ לִצְחִיחַ סָלַע׃

verses.english: She will be a place for spreading nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken—the declaration of Lord YHWH. She will become plunder for the nations,
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁטַח חֲרָמִים תִּהְיֶה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם כִּי אֲנִי דִבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהָיְתָה לְבַז לַגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: and her daughters in the field will be killed by the sword. They will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּחֶרֶב תֵּהָרַגְנָה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: I am bringing against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses, chariots, horsemen, an assembly, and many people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא אֶל־צֹר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל מִצָּפוֹן מֶלֶךְ מְלָכִים בְּסוּס וּבְרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים וְקָהָל וְעַם־רָב׃

verses.english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword, set siegeworks against you, heap up a mound against you, and raise a shield against you.
verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹתַיִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּחֶרֶב יַהֲרֹג וְנָתַן עָלַיִךְ דָּיֵק וְשָׁפַךְ עָלַיִךְ סֹלְלָה וְהֵקִים עָלַיִךְ צִנָּה׃

verses.english: He will set the blows of his battering engine against your walls and pull down your towers with his swords.
verses.hebrew: וּמְחִי קָבָלּוֹ יִתֵּן בְּחֹמוֹתָיִךְ וּמִגְדְּלֹתַיִךְ יִתֹּץ בְּחַרְבוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: The dust of his many horses will cover you. Your walls will shake at the sound of horsemen, wheels, and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a breached city.
verses.hebrew: מִשִּׁפְעַת סוּסָיו יְכַסֵּךְ אֲבָקָם מִקּוֹל פָּרַשׁ וְגַלְגַּל וָרֶכֶב תִּרְעַשְׁנָה חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ בְּבֹאוֹ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ כִּמְבוֹאֵי עִיר מְבֻקָּעָה׃

verses.english: With his horses' hoofs he will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will come down to the ground.
verses.hebrew: בְּפַרְסוֹת סוּסָיו יִרְמֹס אֶת־כָּל־חוּצוֹתָיִךְ עַמֵּךְ בַּחֶרֶב יַהֲרֹג וּמַצְּבוֹת עֻזֵּךְ לָאָרֶץ תֵּרֵד׃

verses.english: They will plunder your wealth, loot your merchandise, tear down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. They will put your stones, timber, and dust into the water.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁלְלוּ חֵילֵךְ וּבָזְזוּ רְכֻלָּתֵךְ וְהָרְסוּ חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ וּבָתֵּי חֶמְדָּתֵךְ יִתֹּצוּ וַאֲבָנַיִךְ וְעֵצַיִךְ וַעֲפָרֵךְ בְּתוֹךְ מַיִם יָשִׂימוּ׃

verses.english: I will silence the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will no longer be heard.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי הֲמוֹן שִׁירָיִךְ וְקוֹל כִּנּוֹרַיִךְ לֹא יִשָּׁמַע עוֹד׃

verses.english: I will make you a bare rock, a place for spreading nets. You will not be rebuilt, for I, YHWH, have spoken—the declaration of Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּנְתַתִּיךְ לִצְחִיחַ סֶלַע מִשְׁטַח חֲרָמִים תִּהְיֶה לֹא תִבָּנֶה עוֹד כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH to Tyre: Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and slaughter takes place within you?
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לְצוֹר הֲלֹא מִקּוֹל מַפַּלְתֵּךְ בֶּאֱנֹק חָלָל בֵּהָרֵג הֶרֶג בְּתוֹכֵךְ יִרְעֲשׁוּ הָאִיִּים׃

verses.english: All the princes of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves in trembling, sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be appalled at you.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרְדוּ מֵעַל כִּסְאוֹתָם כֹּל נְשִׂיאֵי הַיָּם וְהֵסִירוּ אֶת־מְעִילֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵי רִקְמָתָם יִפְשֹׁטוּ חֲרָדוֹת יִלְבָּשׁוּ עַל־הָאָרֶץ יֵשֵׁבוּ וְחָרְדוּ לִרְגָעִים וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלָיִךְ׃

verses.english: They will raise a lament over you and say to you: How you have perished, inhabited from the seas, praised city, mighty in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who spread their terror to all her inhabitants!
verses.hebrew: וְנָשְׂאוּ עָלַיִךְ קִינָה וְאָמְרוּ לָךְ אֵיךְ אָבַדְתְּ נוֹשֶׁבֶת מִיַּמִּים הָעִיר הַהֻלָּלָה אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה חֲזָקָה בַיָּם הִיא וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנוּ חִתִּיתָם לְכָל־יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Now the coastlands will tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea will be terrified at your departure.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה יֶחְרְדוּ הָאִיִּן יוֹם מַפַּלְתֵּךְ וְנִבְהֲלוּ הָאִיִּים אֲשֶׁר־בַּיָּם מִצֵּאתֵךְ׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: When I make you a ruined city like cities without inhabitants, when I bring the deep up over you and the many waters cover you,
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בְּתִתִּי אֹתָךְ עִיר נֶחֱרֶבֶת כֶּעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נוֹשָׁבוּ בְּהַעֲלוֹת עָלַיִךְ אֶת־תְּהוֹם וְכִסּוּךְ הַמַּיִם הָרַבִּים׃

verses.english: I will bring you down with those descending to the Pit, to the people of ancient times. I will make you dwell in the lowest parts of the earth, like ancient ruins, with those descending to the Pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will set splendor in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַדְתִּיךְ אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר אֶל־עַם עוֹלָם וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּיךְ בְּאֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּיּוֹת כָּחֳרָבוֹת מֵעוֹלָם אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר לְמַעַן לֹא תֵשֵׁבִי וְנָתַתִּי צְבִי בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃

verses.english: I will make you a terror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but never found again—the declaration of Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּלָּהוֹת אֶתְּנֵךְ וְאֵינֵךְ וּתְבֻקְשִׁי וְלֹא־תִמָּצְאִי עוֹד לְעוֹלָם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, lift up a lament over Tyre.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם שָׂא עַל־צֹר קִינָה׃

verses.english: Say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrances of the sea, trading with the peoples to many coastlands: Thus says Lord YHWH: Tyre, you have said, I am perfect in beauty.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְצוֹר הישבתי [הַיֹּשֶׁבֶת] עַל־מְבוֹאֹת יָם רֹכֶלֶת הָעַמִּים אֶל־אִיִּים רַבִּים כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צוֹר אַתְּ אָמַרְתְּ אֲנִי כְּלִילַת יֹפִי׃

verses.english: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders perfected your beauty.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֵב יַמִּים גְּבוּלָיִךְ בֹּנַיִךְ כָּלְלוּ יָפְיֵךְ׃

verses.english: They built all your planking for you from cypresses of Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast upon you.
verses.hebrew: בְּרוֹשִׁים מִשְּׂנִיר בָּנוּ לָךְ אֵת כָּל־לֻחֹתָיִם אֶרֶז מִלְּבָנוֹן לָקָחוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת תֹּרֶן עָלָיִךְ׃

verses.english: They made your oars from oaks of Bashan; they made your deck of ivory, with boxwood from the islands of Kittim.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוֹנִים מִבָּשָׁן עָשׂוּ מִשּׁוֹטָיִךְ קַרְשֵׁךְ עָשׂוּ־שֵׁן בַּת־אֲשֻׁרִים מֵאִיֵּי כתים [כִּתִּיִּים׃]

verses.english: Embroidered fine linen from Egypt was your sail, to serve you as a banner; blue and purple from the islands of Elishah were your covering.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ־בְּרִקְמָה מִמִּצְרַיִם הָיָה מִפְרָשֵׂךְ לִהְיוֹת לָךְ לְנֵס תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן מֵאִיֵּי אֱלִישָׁה הָיָה מְכַסֵּךְ׃

verses.english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, were in you; they were your pilots.
verses.hebrew: יֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאַרְוַד הָיוּ שָׁטִים לָךְ חֲכָמַיִךְ צוֹר הָיוּ בָךְ הֵמָּה חֹבְלָיִךְ׃

verses.english: The elders of Gebal and its wise men were in you, repairing your seams; all the ships of the sea and their sailors were in you to exchange your merchandise.
verses.hebrew: זִקְנֵי גְבַל וַחֲכָמֶיהָ הָיוּ בָךְ מַחֲזִיקֵי בִּדְקֵךְ כָּל־אֳנִיּוֹת הַיָּם וּמַלָּחֵיהֶם הָיוּ בָךְ לַעֲרֹב מַעֲרָבֵךְ׃

verses.english: Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war; they hung shield and helmet in you; they gave you your splendor.
verses.hebrew: פָּרַס וְלוּד וּפוּט הָיוּ בְחֵילֵךְ אַנְשֵׁי מִלְחַמְתֵּךְ מָגֵן וְכוֹבַע תִּלּוּ־בָךְ הֵמָּה נָתְנוּ הֲדָרֵךְ׃

verses.english: The sons of Arvad and your army were on your walls all around, and Gammadites were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אַרְוַד וְחֵילֵךְ עַל־חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ סָבִיב וְגַמָּדִים בְּמִגְדְּלוֹתַיִךְ הָיוּ שִׁלְטֵיהֶם תִּלּוּ עַל־חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ סָבִיב הֵמָּה כָּלְלוּ יָפְיֵךְ׃

verses.english: Tarshish traded with you because of the abundance of every kind of wealth; they gave silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.
verses.hebrew: תַּרְשִׁישׁ סֹחַרְתֵּךְ מֵרֹב כָּל־הוֹן בְּכֶסֶף בַּרְזֶל בְּדִיל וְעוֹפֶרֶת נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants; they gave human lives and bronze vessels for your merchandise.
verses.hebrew: יָוָן תֻּבַל וָמֶשֶׁךְ הֵמָּה רֹכְלָיִךְ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת נָתְנוּ מַעֲרָבֵךְ׃

verses.english: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses, horsemen, and mules for your wares.
verses.hebrew: מִבֵּית תּוֹגַרְמָה סוּסִים וּפָרָשִׁים וּפְרָדִים נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָיִךְ׃

verses.english: The sons of Dedan were your merchants; many coastlands traded at your hand; they brought you ivory tusks and ebony as payment.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי דְדָן רֹכְלַיִךְ אִיִּים רַבִּים סְחֹרַת יָדֵךְ קַרְנוֹת שֵׁן והובנים [וְהָבְנִים] הֵשִׁיבוּ אֶשְׁכָּרֵךְ׃

verses.english: Aram traded with you because of the abundance of your products; they gave turquoise, purple, embroidery, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
verses.hebrew: אֲרָם סֹחַרְתֵּךְ מֵרֹב מַעֲשָׂיִךְ בְּנֹפֶךְ אַרְגָּמָן וְרִקְמָה וּבוּץ וְרָאמֹת וְכַדְכֹּד נָתְנוּ בְּעִזְבוֹנָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Judah and the land of Israel were your merchants; they gave wheat of Minnith, pannag, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
verses.hebrew: יְהוּדָה וְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה רֹכְלָיִךְ בְּחִטֵּי מִנִּית וּפַנַּג וּדְבַשׁ וָשֶׁמֶן וָצֹרִי נָתְנוּ מַעֲרָבֵךְ׃

verses.english: Damascus traded with you because of the abundance of your products, because of the abundance of every kind of wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.
verses.hebrew: דַּמֶּשֶׂק סֹחַרְתֵּךְ בְּרֹב מַעֲשַׂיִךְ מֵרֹב כָּל־הוֹן בְּיֵין חֶלְבּוֹן וְצֶמֶר צָחַר׃

verses.english: Vedan and Javan from Uzal gave for your wares; worked iron, cassia, and cane were among your merchandise.
verses.hebrew: וְדָן וְיָוָן מְאוּזָּל בְּעִזְבוֹנַיִךְ נָתָנּוּ בַּרְזֶל עָשׁוֹת קִדָּה וְקָנֶה בְּמַעֲרָבֵךְ הָיָה׃

verses.english: Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.
verses.hebrew: דְּדָן רֹכַלְתֵּךְ בְבִגְדֵי־חֹפֶשׁ לְרִכְבָּה׃

verses.english: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar traded at your hand; they traded with you in lambs, rams, and male goats.
verses.hebrew: עֲרַב וְכָל־נְשִׂיאֵי קֵדָר הֵמָּה סֹחֲרֵי יָדֵךְ בְּכָרִים וְאֵילִים וְעַתּוּדִים בָּם סֹחֲרָיִךְ׃

verses.english: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah were your merchants; they gave the finest of every spice, every precious stone, and gold for your wares.
verses.hebrew: רֹכְלֵי שְׁבָא וְרַעְמָה הֵמָּה רֹכְלָיִךְ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־בֹּשֶׂם וּבְכָל־אֶבֶן יְקָרָה וְזָהָב נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with you.
verses.hebrew: חָרָן וְכַנֵּה וָעֶדֶן רֹכְלֵי שְׁבָא אַשּׁוּר כִּלְמַד רֹכַלְתֵּךְ׃

verses.english: They traded with you in splendid garments, in cloaks of blue and embroidery, and in chests of multicolored cloth, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה רֹכְלַיִךְ בְּמַכְלֻלִים בִּגְלוֹמֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְרִקְמָה וּבְגִנְזֵי בְּרֹמִים בַּחֲבָלִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַאֲרֻזִים בְּמַרְכֻלְתֵּךְ׃

verses.english: Ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise; you were filled and became very heavy in the heart of the seas.
verses.hebrew: אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ שָׁרוֹתַיִךְ מַעֲרָבֵךְ וַתִּמָּלְאִי וַתִּכְבְּדִי מְאֹד בְּלֵב־יַמִּים׃

verses.english: Your rowers brought you into great waters; the east wind broke you in the heart of the seas.
verses.hebrew: בְּמַיִם רַבִּים הֱבִיאוּךְ הַשָּׁטִים אֹתָךְ רוּחַ הַקָּדִים שְׁבָרֵךְ בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃

verses.english: Your wealth, your wares, your merchandise, your sailors and pilots, those repairing your seams and exchanging your merchandise, all your men of war in you, and all your assembly within you will fall in the heart of the seas on the day of your fall.
verses.hebrew: הוֹנֵךְ וְעִזְבוֹנַיִךְ מַעֲרָבֵךְ מַלָּחַיִךְ וְחֹבְלָיִךְ מַחֲזִיקֵי בִדְקֵך וְעֹרְבֵי מַעֲרָבֵךְ וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁי מִלְחַמְתֵּךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּךְ וּבְכָל־קְהָלֵךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכֵךְ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב יַמִּים בְּיוֹם מַפַּלְתֵּךְ׃

verses.english: At the sound of your pilots' cry, the surrounding lands will quake.
verses.hebrew: לְקוֹל זַעֲקַת חֹבְלָיִךְ יִרְעֲשׁוּ מִגְרֹשׁוֹת׃

verses.english: All who grasp an oar will come down from their ships; sailors and all pilots of the sea will stand on the land.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרְדוּ מֵאָנִיּוֹתֵיהֶם כֹּל תֹּפְשֵׂי מָשׁוֹט מַלָּחִים כֹּל חֹבְלֵי הַיָּם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ יַעֲמֹדוּ׃

verses.english: They will make their voice heard over you and cry bitterly; they will put dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁמִיעוּ עָלַיִךְ בְּקוֹלָם וְיִזְעֲקוּ מָרָה וְיַעֲלוּ עָפָר עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בָּאֵפֶר יִתְפַּלָּשׁוּ׃

verses.english: In their wailing they will lift up a lament over you and lament over you: Who is like Tyre, like one silenced in the midst of the sea?
verses.hebrew: וְנָשְׂאוּ אֵלַיִךְ בְּנִיהֶם קִינָה וְקוֹנְנוּ עָלָיִךְ מִי כְצוֹר כְּדֻמָה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם׃

verses.english: When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; by your abundant wealth and merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאת עִזְבוֹנַיִךְ מִיַּמִּים הִשְׂבַּעַתְּ עַמִּים רַבִּים בְּרֹב הוֹנַיִךְ וּמַעֲרָבַיִךְ הֶעֱשַׁרְתְּ מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Now that you are broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your assembly have fallen within you.
verses.hebrew: עֵת נִשְׁבֶּרֶת מִיַּמִּים בְּמַעֲמַקֵּי־מָיִם מַעֲרָבֵךְ וְכָל־קְהָלֵךְ בְּתוֹכֵךְ נָפָלוּ׃

verses.english: All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder terribly, their faces troubled.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאִיִּים שָׁמְמוּ עָלָיִךְ וּמַלְכֵיהֶם שָׂעֲרוּ שַׂעַר רָעֲמוּ פָּנִים׃

verses.english: Merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever.
verses.hebrew: סֹחֲרִים בָּעַמִּים שָׁרְקוּ עָלָיִךְ בַּלָּהוֹת הָיִית וְאֵינֵךְ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because your heart has grown high and you have said, I am a god; I sit in a seat of gods in the heart of the seas—yet you are a human, and not a god, though you set your heart like the heart of a god—
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם אֱמֹר לִנְגִיד צֹר כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה יַעַן גָּבַהּ לִבְּךָ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵל אָנִי מוֹשַׁב אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁבְתִּי בְּלֵב יַמִּים וְאַתָּה אָדָם וְלֹא־אֵל וַתִּתֵּן לִבְּךָ כְּלֵב אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Look, you are wiser than Danel; no hidden thing is obscure to you.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה חָכָם אַתָּה מדנאל [מִדָּנִיֵּאל] כָּל־סָתוּם לֹא עֲמָמוּךָ׃

verses.english: By your wisdom and understanding you made wealth for yourself and made gold and silver in your treasuries.
verses.hebrew: בְּחָכְמָתְךָ וּבִתְבוּנָתְךָ עָשִׂיתָ לְּךָ חָיִל וַתַּעַשׂ זָהָב וָכֶסֶף בְּאוֹצְרוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: By your great wisdom in your trade you increased your wealth, and your heart grew high because of your wealth.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב חָכְמָתְךָ בִּרְכֻלָּתְךָ הִרְבִּיתָ חֵילֶךָ וַיִּגְבַּהּ לְבָבְךָ בְּחֵילֶךָ׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you set your heart like the heart of a god,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן תִּתְּךָ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ כְּלֵב אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: therefore I am bringing foreigners against you, the ruthless of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and profane your splendor.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי מֵבִיא עָלֶיךָ זָרִים עָרִיצֵי גּוֹיִם וְהֵרִיקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם עַל־יְפִי חָכְמָתֶךָ וְחִלְּלוּ יִפְעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die the deaths of one slain in the heart of the seas.
verses.hebrew: לַשַּׁחַת יוֹרִדוּךָ וָמַתָּה מְמוֹתֵי חָלָל בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃

verses.english: Will you really say, I am a god, before the one killing you? You are a human, and not a god, in the hand of those piercing you.
verses.hebrew: הֶאָמֹר תֹּאמַר אֱלֹהִים אָנִי לִפְנֵי הֹרְגֶךָ וְאַתָּה אָדָם וְלֹא־אֵל בְּיַד מְחַלְלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: You will die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners, for I have spoken—the declaration of Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מוֹתֵי עֲרֵלִים תָּמוּת בְּיַד־זָרִים כִּי אֲנִי דִבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, lift up a lament over the king of Tyre and say to him: Thus says Lord YHWH: You were a seal of proportion, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שָׂא קִינָה עַל־מֶלֶךְ צוֹר וְאָמַרְתָּ לּוֹ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַתָּה חוֹתֵם תָּכְנִית מָלֵא חָכְמָה וּכְלִיל יֹפִי׃

verses.english: You were in Eden, God's garden; every precious stone was your covering: carnelian, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, emerald, and gold. The workmanship of your tambourines and your pipes was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵדֶן גַּן־אֱלֹהִים הָיִיתָ כָּל־אֶבֶן יְקָרָה מְסֻכָתֶךָ אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וְיָהֲלֹם תַּרְשִׁישׁ שֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה סַפִּיר נֹפֶךְ וּבָרְקַת וְזָהָב מְלֶאכֶת תֻּפֶּיךָ וּנְקָבֶיךָ בָּךְ בְּיוֹם הִבָּרַאֲךָ כּוֹנָנוּ׃

verses.english: You were an anointed cherub who covers, and I placed you; you were on God's holy mountain; you walked among stones of fire.
verses.hebrew: אַתְּ־כְּרוּב מִמְשַׁח הַסּוֹכֵךְ וּנְתַתִּיךָ בְּהַר קֹדֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים הָיִיתָ בְּתוֹךְ אַבְנֵי־אֵשׁ הִתְהַלָּכְתָּ׃

verses.english: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created until injustice was found in you.
verses.hebrew: תָּמִים אַתָּה בִּדְרָכֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הִבָּרְאָךְ עַד־נִמְצָא עַוְלָתָה בָּךְ׃

verses.english: Through the abundance of your trade they filled your midst with violence, and you sinned. I cast you as profane from God's mountain and destroyed you, covering cherub, from among the stones of fire.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב רְכֻלָּתְךָ מָלוּ תוֹכְךָ חָמָס וַתֶּחֱטָא וָאֶחַלֶּלְךָ מֵהַר אֱלֹהִים וָאַבֶּדְךָ כְּרוּב הַסֹּכֵךְ מִתּוֹךְ אַבְנֵי־אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: Your heart grew high because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your splendor. I cast you to the ground; I set you before kings to gaze at you.
verses.hebrew: גָּבַהּ לִבְּךָ בְּיָפְיֶךָ שִׁחַתָּ חָכְמָתְךָ עַל־יִפְעָתֶךָ עַל־אֶרֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּיךָ לִפְנֵי מְלָכִים נְתַתִּיךָ לְרַאֲוָה בָךְ׃

verses.english: Because of your many iniquities, through the injustice of your trade, you profaned your sanctuaries. I brought fire out from within you; it consumed you. I made you ashes on the ground before the eyes of all who saw you.
verses.hebrew: מֵרֹב עֲוֺנֶיךָ בְּעֶוֶל רְכֻלָּתְךָ חִלַּלְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁיךָ וָאוֹצִא־אֵשׁ מִתּוֹכְךָ הִיא אֲכָלַתְךָ וָאֶתֶּנְךָ לְאֵפֶר עַל־הָאָרֶץ לְעֵינֵי כָּל־רֹאֶיךָ׃

verses.english: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יוֹדְעֶיךָ בָּעַמִּים שָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיךָ בַּלָּהוֹת הָיִיתָ וְאֵינְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל־צִידוֹן וְהִנָּבֵא עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Say: Thus says Lord YHWH: I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am YHWH when I execute judgments in her and show Myself holy in her.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי עָלַיִךְ צִידוֹן וְנִכְבַּדְתִּי בְּתוֹכֵךְ וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי בָהּ שְׁפָטִים וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בָהּ׃

verses.english: I will send pestilence into her and blood into her streets; the slain will fall within her by the sword against her all around. They will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־בָהּ דֶּבֶר וָדָם בְּחוּצוֹתֶיהָ וְנִפְלַל חָלָל בְּתוֹכָהּ בְּחֶרֶב עָלֶיהָ מִסָּבִיב וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The house of Israel will no longer have a malignant brier or a painful thorn from all around them who despise them. They will know that I am Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה עוֹד לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל סִלּוֹן מַמְאִיר וְקוֹץ מַכְאִב מִכֹּל סְבִיבֹתָם הַשָּׁאטִים אוֹתָם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they were scattered and show Myself holy in them before the eyes of the nations, they will dwell on their land, which I gave to My servant Jacob.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בְּקַבְּצִי אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר נָפֹצוּ בָם וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בָם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם וְיָשְׁבוּ עַל־אַדְמָתָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְעַבְדִּי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: They will dwell on it securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments on all around them who despise them. They will know that I am YHWH their God.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשְׁבוּ עָלֶיהָ לָבֶטַח וּבָנוּ בָתִּים וְנָטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְיָשְׁבוּ לָבֶטַח בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי שְׁפָטִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁאטִים אֹתָם מִסְּבִיבוֹתָם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׁנָה הָעֲשִׂירִית בָּעֲשִׂרִי בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ עַל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וְהִנָּבֵא עָלָיו וְעַל־מִצְרַיִם כֻּלָּהּ׃

verses.english: Speak and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster lying among his Nile channels, who says, My Nile is mine, and I made myself.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי עָלֶיךָ פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם הַתַּנִּים הַגָּדוֹל הָרֹבֵץ בְּתוֹךְ יְאֹרָיו אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לִי יְאֹרִי וַאֲנִי עֲשִׂיתִנִי׃

verses.english: I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your Nile channels cling to your scales. I will bring you up from among your Nile channels, and all the fish of your Nile channels will cling to your scales.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי חחיים [חַחִים] בִּלְחָיֶיךָ וְהִדְבַּקְתִּי דְגַת־יְאֹרֶיךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִיךָ מִתּוֹךְ יְאֹרֶיךָ וְאֵת כָּל־דְּגַת יְאֹרֶיךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶיךָ תִּדְבָּק׃

verses.english: I will abandon you in the wilderness, you and all the fish of your Nile channels. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered or collected. I have given you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the heavens.
verses.hebrew: וּנְטַשְׁתִּיךָ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אוֹתְךָ וְאֵת כָּל־דְּגַת יְאֹרֶיךָ עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה תִּפּוֹל לֹא תֵאָסֵף וְלֹא תִקָּבֵץ לְחַיַּת הָאָרֶץ וּלְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נְתַתִּיךָ לְאָכְלָה׃

verses.english: All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am YHWH, because they were a reed staff for the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה יַעַן הֱיוֹתָם מִשְׁעֶנֶת קָנֶה לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: When they grasped you by the hand, you broke and tore every shoulder for them; when they leaned on you, you shattered and made all their loins stand.
verses.hebrew: בְּתָפְשָׂם בְּךָ בכפך [בַכַּף] תֵּרוֹץ וּבָקַעְתָּ לָהֶם כָּל־כָּתֵף וּבְהִשָּׁעֲנָם עָלֶיךָ תִּשָּׁבֵר וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ לָהֶם כָּל־מָתְנָיִם׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I am bringing a sword against you, and I will cut off human and animal from you.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא עָלַיִךְ חָרֶב וְהִכְרַתִּי מִמֵּךְ אָדָם וּבְהֵמָה׃

verses.english: The land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin, and they will know that I am YHWH, because he said, The Nile is mine, and I made it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה אֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁמָמָה וְחָרְבָּה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה יַעַן אָמַר יְאֹר לִי וַאֲנִי עָשִׂיתִי׃

verses.english: Therefore I am against you and against your Nile channels. I will make the land of Egypt utterly ruined, a desolation, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Cush.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֵלֶיךָ וְאֶל־יְאֹרֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְחָרְבוֹת חֹרֶב שְׁמָמָה מִמִּגְדֹּל סְוֵנֵה וְעַד־גְּבוּל כּוּשׁ׃

verses.english: No human foot will pass through it, nor will an animal's foot pass through it; it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲבָר־בָּהּ רֶגֶל אָדָם וְרֶגֶל בְּהֵמָה לֹא תַעֲבָר־בָּהּ וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolated lands, and its cities will be desolate among ruined cities for forty years. I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁמָמָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲרָצוֹת נְשַׁמּוֹת וְעָרֶיהָ בְּתוֹךְ עָרִים מָחֳרָבוֹת תִּהְיֶיןָ שְׁמָמָה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַהֲפִצֹתִי אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִים בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: At the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples where they were scattered.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אֲקַבֵּץ אֶת־מִצְרַיִם מִן־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר־נָפֹצוּ שָׁמָּה׃

verses.english: I will restore Egypt's fortunes and return them to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin; there they will be a lowly kingdom.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתִּי אֶת־שְׁבוּת מִצְרַיִם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֹתָם אֶרֶץ פַּתְרוֹס עַל־אֶרֶץ מְכוּרָתָם וְהָיוּ שָׁם מַמְלָכָה שְׁפָלָה׃

verses.english: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will no longer exalt itself over the nations. I will make them few, so that they do not rule over the nations.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת תִּהְיֶה שְׁפָלָה וְלֹא־תִתְנַשֵּׂא עוֹד עַל־הַגּוֹיִם וְהִמְעַטְתִּים לְבִלְתִּי רְדוֹת בַּגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: It will no longer be a source of trust for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turn after them. They will know that I am Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִהְיֶה־עוֹד לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִבְטָח מַזְכִּיר עָוֺן בִּפְנוֹתָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army perform great labor against Tyre; every head was bald and every shoulder rubbed bare. Yet neither he nor his army received wages from Tyre for the labor he performed against her.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל הֶעֱבִיד אֶת־חֵילוֹ עֲבֹדָה גְדֹלָה אֶל־צֹר כָּל־רֹאשׁ מֻקְרָח וְכָל־כָּתֵף מְרוּטָה וְשָׂכָר לֹא־הָיָה לוֹ וּלְחֵילוֹ מִצֹּר עַל־הָעֲבֹדָה אֲשֶׁר־עָבַד עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry away her abundance, take her spoil, and plunder her plunder; it will be wages for his army.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לִנְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְנָשָׂא הֲמֹנָהּ וְשָׁלַל שְׁלָלָהּ וּבָזַז בִּזָּהּ וְהָיְתָה שָׂכָר לְחֵילוֹ׃

verses.english: As his payment for the labor he performed against her, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they acted for Me—the declaration of Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: פְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָבַד בָּהּ נָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: On that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will give you an opening of the mouth among them. They will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְךָ אֶתֵּן פִּתְחוֹן־פֶּה בְּתוֹכָם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Wail, Alas for the day!
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם הִנָּבֵא וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הֵילִילוּ הָהּ לַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: For a day is near, and a day for YHWH is near; it will be a day of cloud, a time for nations.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קָרוֹב יוֹם וְקָרוֹב יוֹם לַיהוָה יוֹם עָנָן עֵת גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: A sword will come into Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt. They will take her abundance, and her foundations will be torn down.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאָה חֶרֶב בְּמִצְרַיִם וְהָיְתָה חַלְחָלָה בְּכוּשׁ בִּנְפֹל חָלָל בְּמִצְרָיִם וְלָקְחוּ הֲמוֹנָהּ וְנֶהֶרְסוּ יְסוֹדֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Cush, Put, Lud, all the mixed company, Cub, and the sons of the covenant land will fall with them by the sword.
verses.hebrew: כּוּשׁ וּפוּט וְלוּד וְכָל־הָעֶרֶב וְכוּב וּבְנֵי אֶרֶץ הַבְּרִית אִתָּם בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Egypt's supporters will fall, and the pride of her strength will come down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall in her by the sword—the declaration of Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה וְנָפְלוּ סֹמְכֵי מִצְרַיִם וְיָרַד גְּאוֹן עֻזָּהּ מִמִּגְדֹּל סְוֵנֵה בַּחֶרֶב יִפְּלוּ־בָהּ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: They will be desolate among desolated lands, and his cities will be among ruined cities.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשַׁמּוּ בְּתוֹךְ אֲרָצוֹת נְשַׁמּוֹת וְעָרָיו בְּתוֹךְ־עָרִים נַחֲרָבוֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

verses.english: They will know that I am YHWH when I set fire in Egypt and all her helpers are broken.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי־אֵשׁ בְּמִצְרַיִם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ כָּל־עֹזְרֶיהָ׃

verses.english: On that day messengers will go out from before Me in ships to terrify secure Cush; anguish will be among them on Egypt's day, for look, it is coming.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵצְאוּ מַלְאָכִים מִלְּפָנַי בַּצִּים לְהַחֲרִיד אֶת־כּוּשׁ בֶּטַח וְהָיְתָה חַלְחָלָה בָהֶם בְּיוֹם מִצְרַיִם כִּי הִנֵּה בָּאָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: I will put an end to Egypt's multitude by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי אֶת־הֲמוֹן מִצְרַיִם בְּיַד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל׃

verses.english: He and his people with him, the ruthless of nations, are being brought to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
verses.hebrew: הוּא וְעַמּוֹ אִתּוֹ עָרִיצֵי גוֹיִם מוּבָאִים לְשַׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ וְהֵרִיקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם עַל־מִצְרַיִם וּמָלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ חָלָל׃

verses.english: I will make the Nile channels dry and sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will desolate the land and all that fills it by the hand of foreigners. I, YHWH, have spoken.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי יְאֹרִים חָרָבָה וּמָכַרְתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיַד־רָעִים וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ בְּיַד־זָרִים אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the worthless gods from Noph; there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי גִלּוּלִים וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי אֱלִילִים מִנֹּף וְנָשִׂיא מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם לֹא יִהְיֶה־עוֹד וְנָתַתִּי יִרְאָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: I will desolate Pathros, set fire in Zoan, and execute judgments in No.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֶת־פַּתְרוֹס וְנָתַתִּי אֵשׁ בְּצֹעַן וְעָשִׂיתִי שְׁפָטִים בְּנֹא׃

verses.english: I will pour out My wrath on Sin, Egypt's stronghold, and cut off the multitude of No.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי חֲמָתִי עַל־סִין מָעוֹז מִצְרָיִם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־הֲמוֹן נֹא׃

verses.english: I will set fire in Egypt; Sin will writhe greatly, No will be breached, and Noph will face enemies by day.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֵשׁ בְּמִצְרַיִם חוּל תחיל [תָּחוּל] סִין וְנֹא תִּהְיֶה לְהִבָּקֵעַ וְנֹף צָרֵי יוֹמָם׃

verses.english: The young men of Aven and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and they will go into captivity.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרֵי אָוֶן וּפִי־בֶסֶת בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ וְהֵנָּה בַּשְּׁבִי תֵלַכְנָה׃

verses.english: At Tahpanhes the day will be dark when I break Egypt's yoke bars there and the pride of her strength ceases in her. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
verses.hebrew: וּבִתְחַפְנְחֵס חָשַׂךְ הַיּוֹם בְּשִׁבְרִי־שָׁם אֶת־מֹטוֹת מִצְרַיִם וְנִשְׁבַּת־בָּהּ גְּאוֹן עֻזָּהּ הִיא עָנָן יְכַסֶּנָּה וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ בַּשְּׁבִי תֵלַכְנָה׃

verses.english: I will execute judgments in Egypt, and they will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתִי שְׁפָטִים בְּמִצְרָיִם וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Look, it has not been bound up to provide healing, to put on a bandage to bind it, to strengthen it to grasp a sword.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם אֶת־זְרוֹעַ פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם שָׁבָרְתִּי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־חֻבְּשָׁה לָתֵת רְפֻאוֹת לָשׂוּם חִתּוּל לְחָבְשָׁהּ לְחָזְקָהּ לִתְפֹּשׂ בֶּחָרֶב׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הִנְנִי אֶל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעֹתָיו אֶת־הַחֲזָקָה וְאֶת־הַנִּשְׁבָּרֶת וְהִפַּלְתִּי אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מִיָּדוֹ׃

verses.english: I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲפִצוֹתִי אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand. I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he will groan before him with the groans of a slain man.
verses.hebrew: וְחִזַּקְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעוֹת מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־חַרְבִּי בְּיָדוֹ וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעוֹת פַּרְעֹה וְנָאַק נַאֲקוֹת חָלָל לְפָנָיו׃

verses.english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but Pharaoh's arms will fall. They will know that I am YHWH when I put My sword in the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out toward the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֲזַקְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעוֹת מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וּזְרֹעוֹת פַּרְעֹה תִּפֹּלְנָה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי חַרְבִּי בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל וְנָטָה אוֹתָהּ אֶל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands. They will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲפִצוֹתִי אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִי אוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בַּשְּׁלִישִׁי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and to his multitude, ‘Whom do you resemble in your greatness?
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם אֱמֹר אֶל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְאֶל־הֲמוֹנוֹ אֶל־מִי דָּמִיתָ בְגָדְלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that cast the shade of a forest. It grew tall, its crown among the thick boughs.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַשּׁוּר אֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יְפֵה עָנָף וְחֹרֶשׁ מֵצַל וּגְבַהּ קוֹמָה וּבֵין עֲבֹתִים הָיְתָה צַמַּרְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Waters made it grow; the deep raised it high, sending its rivers around its planting and sending its channels to all the field’s trees.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם גִּדְּלוּהוּ תְּהוֹם רֹמְמָתְהוּ אֶת־נַהֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלֵךְ סְבִיבוֹת מַטָּעָהּ וְאֶת־תְּעָלֹתֶיהָ שִׁלְחָה אֶל כָּל־עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

verses.english: Therefore its stature rose above all the field’s trees; its boughs multiplied and its branches lengthened because of abundant waters as it spread out.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן גָּבְהָא קֹמָתוֹ מִכֹּל עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּרְבֶּינָה סַרְעַפֹּתָיו וַתֶּאֱרַכְנָה פארתו [פֹארֹתָיו] מִמַּיִם רַבִּים בְּשַׁלְּחוֹ׃

verses.english: All the sky’s birds nested in its boughs; all the field’s animals gave birth beneath its branches, and all the many nations lived in its shade.
verses.hebrew: בִּסְעַפֹּתָיו קִנְנוּ כָּל־עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתַחַת פֹּארֹתָיו יָלְדוּ כֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּבְצִלּוֹ יֵשְׁבוּ כֹּל גּוֹיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its root reached abundant waters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְּיִף בְּגָדְלוֹ בְּאֹרֶךְ דָּלִיּוֹתָיו כִּי־הָיָה שָׁרְשׁוֹ אֶל־מַיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: Cedars in God’s garden could not overshadow it; cypresses did not resemble its boughs, and plane trees were not like its branches. No tree in God’s garden resembled it in beauty.
verses.hebrew: אֲרָזִים לֹא־עֲמָמֻהוּ בְּגַן־אֱלֹהִים בְּרוֹשִׁים לֹא דָמוּ אֶל־סְעַפֹּתָיו וְעַרְמֹנִים לֹא־הָיוּ כְּפֹארֹתָיו כָּל־עֵץ בְּגַן־אֱלֹהִים לֹא־דָמָה אֵלָיו בְּיָפְיוֹ׃

verses.english: I made it beautiful with its many branches, and all Eden’s trees in God’s garden envied it.
verses.hebrew: יָפֶה עֲשִׂיתִיו בְּרֹב דָּלִיּוֹתָיו וַיְקַנְאֻהוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־עֵדֶן אֲשֶׁר בְּגַן הָאֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Therefore, thus says Lord YHWH: Because you grew tall, and it set its crown among the thick boughs, and its heart grew proud of its height,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר גָּבַהְתָּ בְּקוֹמָה וַיִּתֵּן צַמַּרְתּוֹ אֶל־בֵּין עֲבוֹתִים וְרָם לְבָבוֹ בְּגָבְהוֹ׃

verses.english: I will give it into the hand of a mighty one of the nations; he will surely deal with it. For its wickedness I have cast it out.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְּנֵהוּ בְּיַד אֵיל גּוֹיִם עָשׂוֹ יַעֲשֶׂה לוֹ כְּרִשְׁעוֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּהוּ׃

verses.english: Foreigners, ruthless men of nations, cut it down and abandoned it. Its branches fell upon the mountains and in all the valleys; its boughs broke in all the land’s ravines. All the land’s peoples went down from its shade and abandoned it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתֻהוּ זָרִים עָרִיצֵי גוֹיִם וַיִּטְּשֻׁהוּ אֶל־הֶהָרִים וּבְכָל־גֵּאָיוֹת נָפְלוּ דָלִיּוֹתָיו וַתִּשָּׁבַרְנָה פֹארֹתָיו בְּכֹל אֲפִיקֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֵּרְדוּ מִצִּלּוֹ כָּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וַיִּטְּשֻׁהוּ׃

verses.english: All the sky’s birds will settle upon its fallen trunk, and all the field’s animals were upon its branches,
verses.hebrew: עַל־מַפַּלְתּוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ כָּל־עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם וְאֶל־פֹּארֹתָיו הָיוּ כֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

verses.english: so that no tree fed by water will tower high or set its crown among the thick boughs, and no tree that drinks water will stand so high. For they are all handed over to death, to the depths of the earth, among the people who go down to the pit.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִגְבְּהוּ בְקוֹמָתָם כָּל־עֲצֵי־מַיִם וְלֹא־יִתְּנוּ אֶת־צַמַּרְתָּם אֶל־בֵּין עֲבֹתִים וְלֹא־יַעַמְדוּ אֵלֵיהֶם בְּגָבְהָם כָּל־שֹׁתֵי מָיִם כִּי־כֻלָּם נִתְּנוּ לַמָּוֶת אֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי אָדָם אֶל־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: On the day it descended to Sheol, I caused mourning; I covered the deep over it, restrained its rivers, and the abundant waters were held back. I darkened Lebanon over it, and all the field’s trees fainted over it.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בְּיוֹם רִדְתּוֹ שְׁאוֹלָה הֶאֱבַלְתִּי כִּסֵּתִי עָלָיו אֶת־תְּהוֹם וָאֶמְנַע נַהֲרוֹתֶיהָ וַיִּכָּלְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים וָאַקְדִּר עָלָיו לְבָנוֹן וְכָל־עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה עָלָיו עֻלְפֶּה׃

verses.english: At the sound of its fall I shook nations when I brought it down to Sheol with those descending to the pit. In the lower land all Eden’s trees, the choice and best of Lebanon, all drinking water, were comforted.
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מַפַּלְתּוֹ הִרְעַשְׁתִּי גוֹיִם בְּהוֹרִדִי אֹתוֹ שְׁאוֹלָה אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ בְּאֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית כָּל־עֲצֵי־עֵדֶן מִבְחַר וְטוֹב־לְבָנוֹן כָּל־שֹׁתֵי מָיִם׃

verses.english: They too went down with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword; those who were its arm lived in its shade among nations.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־הֵם אִתּוֹ יָרְדוּ שְׁאוֹלָה אֶל־חַלְלֵי־חָרֶב וּזְרֹעוֹ יָשְׁבוּ בְצִלּוֹ בְּתוֹךְ גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: Whom do you thus resemble in glory and greatness among Eden’s trees? You will be brought down with Eden’s trees to the lower land. Among the uncircumcised you will lie with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: אֶל־מִי דָמִיתָ כָּכָה בְּכָבוֹד וּבְגֹדֶל בַּעֲצֵי־עֵדֶן וְהוּרַדְתָּ אֶת־עֲצֵי־עֵדֶן אֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית בְּתוֹךְ עֲרֵלִים תִּשְׁכַּב אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב הוּא פַרְעֹה וְכָל־הֲמוֹנֹה נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בִּשְׁנֵי־עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and say to him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of nations, but you are like a monster in the seas. You surged in your rivers, muddied water with your feet and trampled their rivers.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם שָׂא קִינָה עַל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כְּפִיר גּוֹיִם נִדְמֵיתָ וְאַתָּה כַּתַּנִּים בַּיַּמִּים וַתָּגַח בְּנַהֲרוֹתֶיךָ וַתִּדְלַח־מַיִם בְּרַגְלֶיךָ וַתִּרְפֹּס נַהֲרוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: I will spread My net over you with an assembly of many peoples, and they will haul you up in My dragnet.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וּפָרַשְׂתִּי עָלֶיךָ אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי בִּקְהַל עַמִּים רַבִּים וְהֶעֱלוּךָ בְּחֶרְמִי׃

verses.english: I will abandon you upon the land and cast you onto the open field. I will make all the sky’s birds settle upon you and satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
verses.hebrew: וּנְטַשְׁתִּיךָ בָאָרֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה אֲטִילֶךָ וְהִשְׁכַּנְתִּי עָלֶיךָ כָּל־עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהִשְׂבַּעְתִּי מִמְּךָ חַיַּת כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: I will lay your flesh upon the mountains and fill the valleys with your great bulk.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ עַל־הֶהָרִים וּמִלֵּאתִי הַגֵּאָיוֹת רָמוּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: I will water the land with your flowing blood up to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with you.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁקֵיתִי אֶרֶץ צָפָתְךָ מִדָּמְךָ אֶל־הֶהָרִים וַאֲפִקִים יִמָּלְאוּן מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: When you are extinguished, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not shine its light.
verses.hebrew: וְכִסֵּיתִי בְכַבּוֹתְךָ שָׁמַיִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּי אֶת־כֹּכְבֵיהֶם שֶׁמֶשׁ בֶּעָנָן אֲכַסֶּנּוּ וְיָרֵחַ לֹא־יָאִיר אוֹרוֹ׃

verses.english: I will darken all heaven’s shining lights over you and put darkness upon your land, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר בַּשָּׁמַיִם אַקְדִּירֵם עָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי חֹשֶׁךְ עַל־אַרְצְךָ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: I will trouble the heart of many peoples when I bring your ruin among the nations, into lands you have not known.
verses.hebrew: וְהִכְעַסְתִּי לֵב עַמִּים רַבִּים בַּהֲבִיאִי שִׁבְרְךָ בַּגּוֹיִם עַל־אֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדַעְתָּם׃

verses.english: I will make many peoples appalled over you; their kings will shudder greatly over you when I brandish My sword before them. They will tremble moment by moment, each for his life, on the day of your fall.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי עָלֶיךָ עַמִּים רַבִּים וּמַלְכֵיהֶם יִשְׂעֲרוּ עָלֶיךָ שַׂעַר בְּעוֹפְפִי חַרְבִּי עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְחָרְדוּ לִרְגָעִים אִישׁ לְנַפְשׁוֹ בְּיוֹם מַפַּלְתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: For thus says Lord YHWH: Babylon’s king’s sword will come upon you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה חֶרֶב מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל תְּבוֹאֶךָ׃

verses.english: By the swords of mighty men I will make your multitude fall, all of them ruthless men of nations. They will devastate Egypt’s pride, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
verses.hebrew: בְּחַרְבוֹת גִּבּוֹרִים אַפִּיל הֲמוֹנֶךָ עָרִיצֵי גוֹיִם כֻּלָּם וְשָׁדְדוּ אֶת־גְּאוֹן מִצְרַיִם וְנִשְׁמַד כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ׃

verses.english: I will destroy all her animals beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, nor will an animal’s hoof muddy them.
verses.hebrew: וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת־כָּל־בְּהֶמְתָּהּ מֵעַל מַיִם רַבִּים וְלֹא תִדְלָחֵם רֶגֶל־אָדָם עוֹד וּפַרְסוֹת בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִדְלָחֵם׃

verses.english: Then I will let their waters settle and make their rivers flow like oil, declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אָז אַשְׁקִיעַ מֵימֵיהֶם וְנַהֲרוֹתָם כַּשֶּׁמֶן אוֹלִיךְ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: When I make Egypt’s land desolate, and the land is emptied of its fullness, when I strike all who dwell in her, they will know that I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בְּתִתִּי אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁמָמָה וּנְשַׁמָּה אֶרֶץ מִמְּלֹאָהּ בְּהַכּוֹתִי אֶת־כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ וְיָדְעוּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: This is a lament, and they will lament it. The nations’ daughters will lament it; over Egypt and all her multitude they will lament it, declares Lord YHWH.’”
verses.hebrew: קִינָה הִיא וְקוֹנְנוּהָ בְּנוֹת הַגּוֹיִם תְּקוֹנֵנָּה אוֹתָהּ עַל־מִצְרַיִם וְעַל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ תְּקוֹנֵנָּה אוֹתָהּ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, wail over Egypt’s multitude and bring it down—her and the daughters of mighty nations—to the lowest land, with those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם נְהֵה עַל־הֲמוֹן מִצְרַיִם וְהוֹרִדֵהוּ אוֹתָהּ וּבְנוֹת גּוֹיִם אַדִּרִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּיּוֹת אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: They will fall among those slain by the sword. A sword is given; drag her away with all her multitudes!
verses.hebrew: בְּתוֹךְ חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ חֶרֶב נִתָּנָה מָשְׁכוּ אוֹתָהּ וְכָל־הֲמוֹנֶיהָ׃

verses.english: The mighty among warriors will speak to him from within Sheol, with his helpers: ‘They have descended; the uncircumcised lie down, slain by the sword.’
verses.hebrew: יְדַבְּרוּ־לוֹ אֵלֵי גִבּוֹרִים מִתּוֹךְ שְׁאוֹל אֶת־עֹזְרָיו יָרְדוּ שָׁכְבוּ הָעֲרֵלִים חַלְלֵי־חָרֶב׃

verses.english: There is Assyria and all her assembly, his graves around him, all slain, fallen by the sword,
verses.hebrew: שָׁם אַשּׁוּר וְכָל־קְהָלָהּ סְבִיבוֹתָיו קִבְרֹתָיו כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים הַנֹּפְלִים בֶּחָרֶב׃

verses.english: whose graves were set in the far reaches of the pit, her assembly around her grave, all slain, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִתְּנוּ קִבְרֹתֶיהָ בְּיַרְכְּתֵי־בוֹר וַיְהִי קְהָלָהּ סְבִיבוֹת קְבֻרָתָהּ כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים נֹפְלִים בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנוּ חִתִּית בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃

verses.english: There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave, all slain, fallen by the sword, who descended uncircumcised to the lowest land, who spread their terror in the land of the living and bore their shame with those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם עֵילָם וְכָל־הֲמוֹנָהּ סְבִיבוֹת קְבֻרָתָהּ כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים הַנֹּפְלִים בַּחֶרֶב אֲ‍שֶׁר־יָרְדוּ עֲרֵלִים אֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּיּוֹת אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ חִתִּיתָם בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים וַיִּשְׂאוּ כְלִמָּתָם אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: Among the slain they set a bed for her with all her multitude, her graves around him, all uncircumcised, slain by the sword. Because their terror was spread in the land of the living, they bore their shame with those descending to the pit. He was placed among the slain.
verses.hebrew: בְּתוֹךְ חֲלָלִים נָתְנוּ מִשְׁכָּב לָהּ בְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָהּ סְבִיבוֹתָיו קִבְרֹתֶהָ כֻּלָּם עֲרֵלִים חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב כִּי־נִתַּן חִתִּיתָם בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים וַיִּשְׂאוּ כְלִמָּתָם אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר בְּתוֹךְ חֲלָלִים נִתָּן׃

verses.english: There are Meshech, Tubal and all her multitude, her graves around him, all uncircumcised, pierced by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם מֶשֶׁךְ תֻּבַל וְכָל־הֲמוֹנָהּ סְבִיבוֹתָיו קִבְרוֹתֶיהָ כֻּלָּם עֲרֵלִים מְחֻלְלֵי חֶרֶב כִּי־נָתְנוּ חִתִּיתָם בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃

verses.english: They will not lie with the fallen mighty men of the uncircumcised, who descended to Sheol with their weapons of war and put their swords beneath their heads. Their iniquities were upon their bones, for the terror of mighty men was in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּבוּ אֶת־גִּבּוֹרִים נֹפְלִים מֵעֲרֵלִים אֲשֶׁר יָרְדוּ־שְׁאוֹל בִּכְלֵי־מִלְחַמְתָּם וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־חַרְבוֹתָם תַּחַת רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַתְּהִי עֲוֺנֹתָם עַל־עַצְמוֹתָם כִּי־חִתִּית גִּבּוֹרִים בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃

verses.english: You too will be broken among the uncircumcised and lie with those slain by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בְּתוֹךְ עֲרֵלִים תִּשָּׁבַר וְתִשְׁכַּב אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חָרֶב׃

verses.english: There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might were placed with those slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised and those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה אֱדוֹם מְלָכֶיהָ וְכָל־נְשִׂיאֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר־נִתְּנוּ בִגְבוּרָתָם אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חָרֶב הֵמָּה אֶת־עֲרֵלִים יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְאֶת־יֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: There are all the north’s princes and all the Sidonians, who descended with the slain, ashamed of their terror from their might. They lay uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bore their shame with those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה נְסִיכֵי צָפוֹן כֻּלָּם וְכָל־צִדֹנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָרְדוּ אֶת־חֲלָלִים בְּחִתִּיתָם מִגְבוּרָתָם בּוֹשִׁים וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ עֲרֵלִים אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב וַיִּשְׂאוּ כְלִמָּתָם אֶת־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude—Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אוֹתָם יִרְאֶה פַרְעֹה וְנִחַם עַל־כָּל־המונה [הֲמוֹנוֹ] חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב פַּרְעֹה וְכָל־חֵילוֹ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: For I set his terror in the land of the living, and he will be laid among the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword—Pharaoh and all his multitude—declares Lord YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָתַתִּי אֶת־חתיתו [חִתִּיתִי] בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים וְהֻשְׁכַּב בְּתוֹךְ עֲרֵלִים אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב פַּרְעֹה וְכָל־הֲמוֹנֹה נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among them and appoint him as their watchman,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אָדָם דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי־עַמְּךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם אֶרֶץ כִּי־אָבִיא עָלֶיהָ חָרֶב וְלָקְחוּ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אִישׁ אֶחָד מִקְצֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ אֹתוֹ לָהֶם לְצֹפֶה׃

verses.english: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, blows the horn and warns the people,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֶת־הַחֶרֶב בָּאָה עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְתָקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וְהִזְהִיר אֶת־הָעָם׃

verses.english: and someone hears the horn’s sound but does not heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be upon his own head.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וְלֹא נִזְהָר וַתָּבוֹא חֶרֶב וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: He heard the horn’s sound but did not heed the warning; his blood will be upon himself. But if he heeds the warning, he saves his life.
verses.hebrew: אֵת קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר שָׁמַע וְלֹא נִזְהָר דָּמוֹ בּוֹ יִהְיֶה וְהוּא נִזְהָר נַפְשׁוֹ מִלֵּט׃

verses.english: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not blow the horn, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes a person from them, he is taken in his iniquity, but I will require his blood from the watchman’s hand.’
verses.hebrew: וְהַצֹּפֶה כִּי־יִרְאֶה אֶת־הַחֶרֶב בָּאָה וְלֹא־תָקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וְהָעָם לֹא־נִזְהָר וַתָּבוֹא חֶרֶב וַתִּקַּח מֵהֶם נָפֶשׁ הוּא בַּעֲוֺנוֹ נִלְקָח וְדָמוֹ מִיַּד־הַצֹּפֶה אֶדְרֹשׁ׃

verses.english: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house. Hear a word from My mouth and warn them from Me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם צֹפֶה נְתַתִּיךָ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מִפִּי דָּבָר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ אֹתָם מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: When I say to the wicked, ‘Wicked one, you will surely die,’ and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will seek his blood from your hand.
verses.hebrew: בְּאָמְרִי לָרָשָׁע רָשָׁע מוֹת תָּמוּת וְלֹא דִבַּרְתָּ לְהַזְהִיר רָשָׁע מִדַּרְכּוֹ הוּא רָשָׁע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ יָמוּת וְדָמוֹ מִיָּדְךָ אֲבַקֵּשׁ׃
