verses.english: The outside wall alongside the chambers, toward the outer courtyard and in front of the chambers, was fifty cubits long.
verses.hebrew: וְגָדֵר אֲשֶׁר־לַחוּץ לְעֻמַּת הַלְּשָׁכוֹת דֶּרֶךְ הֶחָצֵר הַחִצוֹנָה אֶל־פְּנֵי הַלְּשָׁכוֹת אָרְכּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

verses.english: For the chambers belonging to the outer courtyard were fifty cubits long, while those facing the temple hall were a hundred cubits.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֹרֶךְ הַלְּשָׁכוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֶחָצֵר הַחִצוֹנָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה וְהִנֵּה עַל־פְּנֵי הַהֵיכָל מֵאָה אַמָּה׃

verses.english: Below these chambers was the entrance from the east, as one entered them from the outer courtyard.
verses.hebrew: ומתחתה לשכות [וּמִתַּחַת] [הַלְּשָׁכוֹת] הָאֵלֶּה המבוא [הַמֵּבִיא] מֵהַקָּדִים בְּבֹאוֹ לָהֵנָּה מֵהֶחָצֵר הַחִצֹנָה׃

verses.english: Within the breadth of the courtyard wall toward the east, opposite the separate area and opposite the building, were chambers.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹחַב גֶּדֶר הֶחָצֵר דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים אֶל־פְּנֵי הַגִּזְרָה וְאֶל־פְּנֵי הַבִּנְיָן לְשָׁכוֹת׃

verses.english: A way ran in front of them. They had the appearance of the chambers toward the north: the same length and the same breadth, with all their exits, their arrangements, and their entrances.
verses.hebrew: וְדֶרֶךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם כְּמַרְאֵה הַלְּשָׁכוֹת אֲשֶׁר דֶּרֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן כְּאָרְכָּן כֵּן רָחְבָּן וְכֹל מוֹצָאֵיהֶן וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶן וּכְפִתְחֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: Like the entrances of the chambers toward the south, there was an entrance at the head of the way, the way in front of the protecting wall toward the east as one entered them.
verses.hebrew: וּכְפִתְחֵי הַלְּשָׁכוֹת אֲשֶׁר דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם פֶּתַח בְּרֹאשׁ דָּרֶךְ דֶּרֶךְ בִּפְנֵי הַגְּדֶרֶת הֲגִינָה דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים בְּבוֹאָן׃

verses.english: He said to me, “The north chambers and the south chambers opposite the separate area are the holy chambers, where the priests who draw near to YHWH shall eat the most holy things. There they shall place the most holy things—the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering—for the place is holy.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי לִשְׁכוֹת הַצָּפוֹן לִשְׁכוֹת הַדָּרוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֶל־פְּנֵי הַגִּזְרָה הֵנָּה לִשְׁכוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר יֹאכְלוּ־שָׁם הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר־קְרוֹבִים לַיהוָה קָדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים שָׁם יַנִּיחוּ קָדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וְהַמִּנְחָה וְהַחַטָּאת וְהָאָשָׁם כִּי הַמָּקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

verses.english: When the priests enter, they shall not go out from the holy place into the outer courtyard. There they shall leave the garments in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments and approach the area belonging to the people.”
verses.hebrew: בְּבֹאָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְלֹא־יֵצְאוּ מֵהַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה וְשָׁם יַנִּיחוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־יְשָׁרְתוּ בָהֶן כִּי־קֹדֶשׁ הֵנָּה ילבשו [וְלָבְשׁוּ] בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְקָרְבוּ אֶל־אֲשֶׁר לָעָם׃

verses.english: When he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the gate facing east and measured it all around.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה אֶת־מִדּוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וְהוֹצִיאַנִי דֶּרֶךְ הַשַּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פָּנָיו דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים וּמְדָדוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He measured the east side with the measuring reed: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed, all around.
verses.hebrew: מָדַד רוּחַ הַקָּדִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה חֲמֵשׁ־אמות [מֵאוֹת] קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He measured the north side: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed, all around.
verses.hebrew: מָדַד רוּחַ הַצָּפוֹן חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He measured the south side: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
verses.hebrew: אֵת רוּחַ הַדָּרוֹם מָדָד חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה׃

verses.english: He went around to the sea side and measured five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
verses.hebrew: סָבַב אֶל־רוּחַ הַיָּם מָדַד חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה׃

verses.english: He measured it on its four sides. It had a wall all around, five hundred long and five hundred wide, to separate the holy from the common.
verses.hebrew: לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת מְדָדוֹ חוֹמָה לוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב אֹרֶךְ חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְרֹחַב חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְחֹל׃

verses.english: He led me to the gate, the gate facing east.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹלִכֵנִי אֶל־הַשָּׁעַר שַׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פֹּנֶה דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים׃

verses.english: Look—the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east. His sound was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כְּבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא מִדֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים וְקוֹלוֹ כְּקוֹל מַיִם רַבִּים וְהָאָרֶץ הֵאִירָה מִכְּבֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: The appearance of the vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when I came to destroy the city, and the visions were like the vision I had seen by the River Chebar. I fell on my face.
verses.hebrew: וּכְמַרְאֵה הַמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר־רָאִיתִי בְּבֹאִי לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָעִיר וּמַרְאוֹת כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי אֶל־נְהַר־כְּבָר וָאֶפֹּל אֶל־פָּנָי׃

verses.english: The glory of YHWH entered the house by the gate facing east.
verses.hebrew: וּכְבוֹד יְהוָה בָּא אֶל־הַבָּיִת דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פָּנָיו דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים׃

verses.english: A spirit lifted me and brought me into the inner courtyard. Look—the glory of YHWH filled the house.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂאֵנִי רוּחַ וַתְּבִיאֵנִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי וְהִנֵּה מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהוָה הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: I heard someone speaking to me from the house, while a man stood beside me.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמַע מִדַּבֵּר אֵלַי מֵהַבָּיִת וְאִישׁ הָיָה עֹמֵד אֶצְלִי׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I shall dwell among the sons of Israel forever. The house of Israel shall no longer defile My holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the corpses of their kings at their high places.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם אֶת־מְקוֹם כִּסְאִי וְאֶת־מְקוֹם כַּפּוֹת רַגְלַי אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁכָּן־שָׁם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעוֹלָם וְלֹא יְטַמְּאוּ עוֹד בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי הֵמָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם בִּזְנוּתָם וּבְפִגְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם בָּמוֹתָם׃

verses.english: By setting their threshold beside My threshold and their doorpost beside My doorpost, with only the wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed. So I consumed them in My anger.
verses.hebrew: בְּתִתָּם סִפָּם אֶת־סִפִּי וּמְזוּזָתָם אֵצֶל מְזוּזָתִי וְהַקִּיר בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיהֶם וְטִמְּאוּ אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי בְּתוֹעֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וָאֲכַל אֹתָם בְּאַפִּי׃

verses.english: Now let them put their prostitution and the corpses of their kings far away from Me, and I shall dwell among them forever.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה יְרַחֲקוּ אֶת־זְנוּתָם וּפִגְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם מִמֶּנִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְתוֹכָם לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: You, son of man, describe the house to the house of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; let them measure the pattern.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה בֶן־אָדָם הַגֵּד אֶת־בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַבַּיִת וְיִכָּלְמוּ מֵעֲוֺנוֹתֵיהֶם וּמָדְדוּ אֶת־תָּכְנִית׃

verses.english: If they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the form of the house and its arrangement, its exits and entrances, all its forms and all its statutes, all its forms and all its instructions. Write them before their eyes, so that they may keep all its form and all its statutes and carry them out.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־נִכְלְמוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ צוּרַת הַבַּיִת וּתְכוּנָתוֹ וּמוֹצָאָיו וּמוֹבָאָיו וְכָל־צוּרֹתָו וְאֵת כָּל־חֻקֹּתָיו וְכָל־צורתי [צוּרֹתָיו] וְכָל־תורתו [תּוֹרֹתָיו] הוֹדַע אוֹתָם וּכְתֹב לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְיִשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־כָּל־צוּרָתוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתָיו וְעָשׂוּ אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: This is the instruction for the house: on the mountain's summit, its entire territory all around is most holy. Look—this is the instruction for the house.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבָּיִת עַל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר כָּל־גְּבֻלוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הִנֵּה־זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: These are the altar's measurements in cubits, each cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: the base was a cubit, and a cubit wide, with a border along its edge all around of one span. This was the base of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מִדּוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בָּאַמּוֹת אַמָּה אַמָּה וָטֹפַח וְחֵיק הָאַמָּה וְאַמָּה־רֹחַב וּגְבוּלָהּ אֶל־שְׂפָתָהּ סָבִיב זֶרֶת הָאֶחָד וְזֶה גַּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: From the ground-level base to the lower ledge was two cubits, with a breadth of one cubit. From the smaller ledge to the larger ledge was four cubits, with a breadth of a cubit.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵחֵיק הָאָרֶץ עַד־הָעֲזָרָה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה שְׁתַּיִם אַמּוֹת וְרֹחַב אַמָּה אֶחָת וּמֵהֳעֲזָרָה הַקְּטַנָּה עַד־הָעֲזָרָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וְרֹחַב הָאַמָּה׃

verses.english: The altar hearth was four cubits, and above the hearth were the four horns.
verses.hebrew: וְהַהַרְאֵל אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וּמֵהָאֲרִאֵיל וּלְמַעְלָה הַקְּרָנוֹת אַרְבַּע׃

verses.english: The hearth was twelve cubits long by twelve cubits wide, square on its four sides.
verses.hebrew: והאראיל [וְהָאֲרִיאֵל] שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֹרֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה רֹחַב רָבוּעַ אֶל אַרְבַּעַת רְבָעָיו׃

verses.english: The ledge was fourteen cubits long by fourteen cubits wide on its four sides. Its border all around was half a cubit, and its surrounding base was a cubit. Its steps faced east.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲזָרָה אַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה אֹרֶךְ בְּאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה רֹחַב אֶל אַרְבַּעַת רְבָעֶיהָ וְהַגְּבוּל סָבִיב אוֹתָהּ חֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְהַחֵיק־לָהּ אַמָּה סָבִיב וּמַעֲלֹתֵהוּ פְּנוֹת קָדִים׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Son of man, thus says Lord YHWH: These are the altar's statutes on the day it is made, for offering burnt offerings on it and dashing blood against it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן־אָדָם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אֵלֶּה חֻקּוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּיוֹם הֵעָשׂוֹתוֹ לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וְלִזְרֹק עָלָיו דָּם׃

verses.english: You shall give the Levitical priests who are of Zadok's offspring and draw near to Me to minister to Me—declares Lord YHWH—a young bull as a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר הֵם מִזֶּרַע צָדוֹק הַקְּרֹבִים אֵלַי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לְשָׁרְתֵנִי פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: You shall take some of its blood and put it on the altar's four horns, on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall purify it from sin and make atonement for it.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִדָּמוֹ וְנָתַתָּה עַל־אַרְבַּע קַרְנֹתָיו וְאֶל־אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הָעֲזָרָה וְאֶל־הַגְּבוּל סָבִיב וְחִטֵּאתָ אוֹתוֹ וְכִפַּרְתָּהוּ׃

verses.english: You shall take the bull for the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the designated part of the house, outside the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֵת הַפָּר הַחַטָּאת וּשְׂרָפוֹ בְּמִפְקַד הַבַּיִת מִחוּץ לַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃

verses.english: On the second day you shall present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and they shall purify the altar from sin as they purified it with the bull.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי תַּקְרִיב שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים תָּמִים לְחַטָּאת וְחִטְּאוּ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר חִטְּאוּ בַּפָּר׃

verses.english: When you have finished purifying it from sin, you shall present an unblemished young bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
verses.hebrew: בְּכַלּוֹתְךָ מֵחַטֵּא תַּקְרִיב פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר תָּמִים וְאַיִל מִן־הַצֹּאן תָּמִים׃

verses.english: You shall present them before YHWH, and the priests shall throw salt upon them and offer them as a burnt offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלַח וְהֶעֱלוּ אוֹתָם עֹלָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: For seven days you shall prepare a goat as a sin offering each day; they shall also prepare a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּעֲשֶׂה שְׂעִיר־חַטָּאת לַיּוֹם וּפַר בֶּן־בָּקָר וְאַיִל מִן־הַצֹּאן תְּמִימִים יַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: For seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and cleanse it, and they shall fill its hand.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְכַפְּרוּ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְטִהֲרוּ אֹתוֹ וּמִלְאוּ ידו [יָדָיו׃]

verses.english: They shall complete the days. From the eighth day onward, the priests shall offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings on the altar, and I shall accept you—declares Lord YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וִיכַלּוּ אֶת־הַיָּמִים וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יַעֲשׂוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת־עוֹלוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־שַׁלְמֵיכֶם וְרָצִאתִי אֶתְכֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה׃

verses.english: He brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faced east, and it was shut.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֹתִי דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הַחִיצוֹן הַפֹּנֶה קָדִים וְהוּא סָגוּר׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, “This gate shall remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, for YHWH, the God of Israel, has entered through it. It shall remain shut.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי יְהוָה הַשַּׁעַר הַזֶּה סָגוּר יִהְיֶה לֹא יִפָּתֵחַ וְאִישׁ לֹא־יָבֹא בוֹ כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא בוֹ וְהָיָה סָגוּר׃

verses.english: As for the prince, because he is prince, he may sit in it to eat bread before YHWH. He shall enter by the porch of the gate and go out by the same way.”
verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַנָּשִׂיא נָשִׂיא הוּא יֵשֶׁב־בּוֹ לֶאֱכָול־לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה מִדֶּרֶךְ אֻלָם הַשַּׁעַר יָבוֹא וּמִדַּרְכּוֹ יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: He brought me by the north gate to the front of the house. I looked, and behold—the glory of YHWH filled the house of YHWH. I fell on my face.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הַצָּפוֹן אֶל־פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה וָאֶפֹּל אֶל־פָּנָי׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, “Son of man, set your heart on, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears everything I tell you concerning all the statutes of the house of YHWH and all its instructions. Set your heart on the house's entrance and all the sanctuary's exits.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי יְהֹוָה בֶּן־אָדָם שִׂים לִבְּךָ וּרְאֵה בְעֵינֶיךָ וּבְאָזְנֶיךָ שְּׁמָע אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְדַבֵּר אֹתָךְ לְכָל־חֻקּוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וּלְכָל־תורתו [תּוֹרֹתָיו] וְשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ לִמְבוֹא הַבַּיִת בְּכֹל מוֹצָאֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃

verses.english: Say to the rebellious—to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: Enough of all your abominations, house of Israel!
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־מֶרִי אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה רַב־לָכֶם מִכָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: You brought foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, into My sanctuary to profane it, My house, when you presented My food, fat and blood. They broke My covenant in addition to all your abominations.
verses.hebrew: בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶם בְּנֵי־נֵכָר עַרְלֵי־לֵב וְעַרְלֵי בָשָׂר לִהְיוֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁי לְחַלְּלוֹ אֶת־בֵּיתִי בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם אֶת־לַחְמִי חֵלֶב וָדָם וַיָּפֵרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֶל כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You did not keep charge of My holy things, but appointed others to keep My charge in My sanctuary for you.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שְׁמַרְתֶּם מִשְׁמֶרֶת קָדָשָׁי וַתְּשִׂימוּן לְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמַרְתִּי בְּמִקְדָּשִׁי לָכֶם׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh shall enter My sanctuary—none of the foreigners who are among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כָּל־בֶּן־נֵכָר עֶרֶל לֵב וְעֶרֶל בָּשָׂר לֹא יָבוֹא אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁי לְכָל־בֶּן־נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: But the Levites who went far away from Me when Israel strayed, who strayed from Me after their idols, shall bear their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־הַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר רָחֲקוּ מֵעָלַי בִּתְעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּ מֵעָלַי אַחֲרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם וְנָשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: They shall be ministers in My sanctuary, with oversight at the gates of the house and service to the house. They shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and stand before them to serve them.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ בְמִקְדָּשִׁי מְשָׁרְתִים פְּקֻדּוֹת אֶל־שַׁעֲרֵי הַבַּיִת וּמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת־הַבָּיִת הֵמָּה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַזֶּבַח לָעָם וְהֵמָּה יַעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם לְשָׁרְתָם׃

verses.english: Because they served them before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, I have lifted My hand against them—declares Lord YHWH—and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ אוֹתָם לִפְנֵי גִלּוּלֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבֵית־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִכְשׁוֹל עָוֺן עַל־כֵּן נָשָׂאתִי יָדִי עֲלֵיהֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְנָשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: They shall not draw near to Me to serve Me as priests, nor approach any of My holy things, the most holy things. They shall bear their shame and the abominations they committed.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִגְּשׁוּ אֵלַי לְכַהֵן לִי וְלָגֶשֶׁת עַל־כָּל־קָדָשַׁי אֶל־קָדְשֵׁי הַקְּדָשִׁים וְנָשְׂאוּ כְּלִמָּתָם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

verses.english: I shall appoint them to keep charge of the house, for all its service and everything done in it.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אוֹתָם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבָּיִת לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה בּוֹ׃

verses.english: But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept charge of My sanctuary when the sons of Israel strayed from Me, shall draw near to Me to minister to Me. They shall stand before Me to present fat and blood to Me—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי צָדוֹק אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי בִּתְעוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלַי הֵמָּה יִקְרְבוּ אֵלַי לְשָׁרְתֵנִי וְעָמְדוּ לְפָנַי לְהַקְרִיב לִי חֵלֶב וָדָם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: They shall enter My sanctuary and approach My table to minister to Me, and they shall keep My charge.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יָבֹאוּ אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁי וְהֵמָּה יִקְרְבוּ אֶל־שֻׁלְחָנִי לְשָׁרְתֵנִי וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּי׃

verses.english: When they enter the gates of the inner courtyard, they shall wear linen garments. No wool shall be upon them when they minister at the gates of the inner courtyard and inside the house.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּבוֹאָם אֶל־שַׁעֲרֵי הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית בִּגְדֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִלְבָּשׁוּ וְלֹא־יַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם צֶמֶר בְּשָׁרְתָם בְּשַׁעֲרֵי הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית וָבָיְתָה׃

verses.english: Linen headdresses shall be on their heads and linen undergarments on their hips. They shall not gird themselves in a way that causes sweat.
verses.hebrew: פַּאֲרֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִהְיוּ עַל־רֹאשָׁם וּמִכְנְסֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִהְיוּ עַל־מָתְנֵיהֶם לֹא יַחְגְּרוּ בַּיָּזַע׃

verses.english: When they go out to the outer courtyard—to the outer courtyard, to the people—they shall take off the garments in which they minister, leave them in the holy chambers, and put on other garments, so that they do not sanctify the people with their garments.
verses.hebrew: וּבְצֵאתָם אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה אֶל־הָעָם יִפְשְׁטוּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה מְשָׁרְתִם בָּם וְהִנִּיחוּ אוֹתָם בְּלִשְׁכֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְלָבְשׁוּ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־יְקַדְּשׁוּ אֶת־הָעָם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They shall not shave their heads or let their hair grow unrestrained; they shall carefully trim the hair of their heads.
verses.hebrew: וְרֹאשָׁם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּפֶרַע לֹא יְשַׁלֵּחוּ כָּסוֹם יִכְסְמוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם׃

verses.english: No priest shall drink wine when entering the inner courtyard.
verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן לֹא־יִשְׁתּוּ כָּל־כֹּהֵן בְּבוֹאָם אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית׃

verses.english: They shall not take a widow or a divorced woman as wives, but virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel; they may also take a widow who is the widow of a priest.
verses.hebrew: וְאַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה לֹא־יִקְחוּ לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים כִּי אִם־בְּתוּלֹת מִזֶּרַע בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה מִכֹּהֵן יִקָּחוּ׃

verses.english: They shall teach My people the difference between holy and common, and make known to them the difference between unclean and clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַמִּי יוֹרוּ בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל וּבֵין־טָמֵא לְטָהוֹר יוֹדִעֻם׃

verses.english: In a dispute they shall stand to judge; they shall judge it according to My judgments. They shall keep My instructions and My statutes at all My appointed festivals, and sanctify My Sabbaths.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־רִיב הֵמָּה יַעַמְדוּ לשפט [לְמִשְׁפָּט] בְּמִשְׁפָּטַי ושפטהו [יִשְׁפְּטוּהוּ] וְאֶת־תּוֹרֹתַי וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַי בְּכָל־מוֹעֲדַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַי יְקַדֵּשׁוּ׃

verses.english: A priest shall not approach a dead person to become unclean, except that they may become unclean for a father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or sister who has not belonged to a husband.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־מֵת אָדָם לֹא יָבוֹא לְטָמְאָה כִּי אִם־לְאָב וּלְאֵם וּלְבֵן וּלְבַת לְאָח וּלְאָחוֹת אֲשֶׁר־לֹא־הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ יִטַּמָּאוּ׃

verses.english: After his cleansing, they shall count seven days for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי טָהֳרָתוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִסְפְּרוּ־לוֹ׃

verses.english: On the day he enters the holy place, the inner courtyard, to minister in the holy place, he shall present his sin offering—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם בֹּאוֹ אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יַקְרִיב חַטָּאתוֹ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: This shall be their inheritance: I am their inheritance. You shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם לְנַחֲלָה אֲנִי נַחֲלָתָם וַאֲחֻזָּה לֹא־תִתְּנוּ לָהֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי אֲחֻזָּתָם׃

verses.english: They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering. Everything devoted in Israel shall belong to them.
verses.hebrew: הַמִּנְחָה וְהַחַטָּאת וְהָאָשָׁם הֵמָּה יֹאכְלוּם וְכָל־חֵרֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָהֶם יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: The first of all the firstfruits of everything, and every contribution of everything from all your contributions, shall belong to the priests. You shall give the first of your dough to the priest, to cause a blessing to rest upon your house.
verses.hebrew: וְרֵאשִׁית כָּל־בִּכּוּרֵי כֹל וְכָל־תְּרוּמַת כֹּל מִכֹּל תְּרוּמוֹתֵיכֶם לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיֶה וְרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסוֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַכֹּהֵן לְהָנִיחַ בְּרָכָה אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: The priests shall not eat anything that has died of itself or has been torn by beasts, whether bird or animal.”
verses.hebrew: כָּל־נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה מִן־הָעוֹף וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָה לֹא יֹאכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

verses.english: When you allot the land as an inheritance, you shall set aside a contribution to YHWH, a holy part of the land, twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in breadth. It shall be holy throughout its entire boundary all around.
verses.hebrew: וּבְהַפִּילְכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהוָה קֹדֶשׁ מִן־הָאָרֶץ אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אֹרֶךְ וְרֹחַב עֲשָׂרָה אָלֶף קֹדֶשׁ־הוּא בְכָל־גְּבוּלָהּ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: From this, a square of five hundred by five hundred shall belong to the sanctuary, with open ground of fifty cubits all around it.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיֶה מִזֶּה אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת בַּחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת מְרֻבָּע סָבִיב וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה מִגְרָשׁ לוֹ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: From this measured area you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand and a breadth of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, the most holy place.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַמִּדָּה הַזֹּאת תָּמוֹד אֹרֶךְ חמש [חֲמִשָּׁה] וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וְרֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וּבוֹ־יִהְיֶה הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים׃

verses.english: This is a holy part of the land. It shall belong to the priests who minister in the sanctuary and draw near to minister to YHWH. It shall be a place for their houses and a sacred area for the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: קֹדֶשׁ מִן־הָאָרֶץ הוּא לַכֹּהֲנִים מְשָׁרְתֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ יִהְיֶה הַקְּרֵבִים לְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהוָה וְהָיָה לָהֶם מָקוֹם לְבָתִּים וּמִקְדָּשׁ לַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃

verses.english: An area twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad shall belong to the Levites who minister to the house, as their possession, with twenty chambers.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אֹרֶךְ וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רֹחַב יהיה [וְהָיָה] לַלְוִיִּם מְשָׁרְתֵי הַבַּיִת לָהֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה עֶשְׂרִים לְשָׁכֹת׃

verses.english: You shall give the city a possession five thousand broad and twenty-five thousand long, alongside the holy contribution. It shall belong to the whole house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר תִּתְּנוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים רֹחַב וְאֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף לְעֻמַּת תְּרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: The prince shall have land on both sides of the holy contribution and the city's possession, alongside the holy contribution and alongside the city's possession, from the west side westward and from the east side eastward. Its length shall correspond to one of the portions, from the western border to the eastern border.
verses.hebrew: וְלַנָּשִׂיא מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לִתְרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר אֶל־פְּנֵי תְרוּמַת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל־פְּנֵי אֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר מִפְּאַת־יָם יָמָּה וּמִפְּאַת־קֵדְמָה קָדִימָה וְאֹרֶךְ לְעֻמּוֹת אַחַד הַחֲלָקִים מִגְּבוּל יָם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדִימָה׃

verses.english: This land shall be his possession in Israel. My princes shall no longer oppress My people, but shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.hebrew: לָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ לַאֲחֻזָּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יוֹנוּ עוֹד נְשִׂיאַי אֶת־עַמִּי וְהָאָרֶץ יִתְּנוּ לְבֵית־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: Enough, princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and practice justice and righteousness. Stop your expulsions of My people—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה רַב־לָכֶם נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חָמָס וָשֹׁד הָסִירוּ וּמִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה עֲשׂוּ הָרִימוּ גְרֻשֹׁתֵיכֶם מֵעַל עַמִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: You shall have honest balances, an honest ephah, and an honest bath.
verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי־צֶדֶק וְאֵיפַת־צֶדֶק וּבַת־צֶדֶק יְהִי לָכֶם׃

verses.english: The ephah and the bath shall have one capacity: the bath shall hold a tenth of a homer, and the ephah a tenth of a homer. Their capacity shall be reckoned by the homer.
verses.hebrew: הָאֵיפָה וְהַבַּת תֹּכֶן אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָשֵׂאת מַעְשַׂר הַחֹמֶר הַבָּת וַעֲשִׂירִת הַחֹמֶר הָאֵיפָה אֶל־הַחֹמֶר יִהְיֶה מַתְכֻּנְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall make your mina.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשֶּׁקֶל עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה עֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים עֲשָׂרָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה שֶׁקֶל הַמָּנֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: This is the contribution you shall set aside: a sixth of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give a sixth of an ephah from a homer of barley.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּרִימוּ שִׁשִּׁית הָאֵיפָה מֵחֹמֶר הַחִטִּים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם הָאֵיפָה מֵחֹמֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִים׃

verses.english: The prescribed oil portion, measured by the bath of oil, shall be a tenth of a bath from a kor—ten baths being a homer, for ten baths are a homer.
verses.hebrew: וְחֹק הַשֶּׁמֶן הַבַּת הַשֶּׁמֶן מַעְשַׂר הַבַּת מִן־הַכֹּר עֲשֶׂרֶת הַבַּתִּים חֹמֶר כִּי־עֲשֶׂרֶת הַבַּתִּים חֹמֶר׃

verses.english: One sheep from every two hundred of the flock, from Israel's watered pastures, shall be for the grain offering, burnt offering, and peace offerings, to make atonement for them—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשֶׂה־אַחַת מִן־הַצֹּאן מִן־הַמָּאתַיִם מִמַּשְׁקֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִנְחָה וּלְעוֹלָה וְלִשְׁלָמִים לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: All the people of the land shall be responsible for this contribution for the prince in Israel.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל הָעָם הָאָרֶץ יִהְיוּ אֶל־הַתְּרוּמָה הַזֹּאת לַנָּשִׂיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The prince shall be responsible for the burnt offerings, grain offering, and drink offering at the festivals, new moons, and Sabbaths, at all the appointed festivals of the house of Israel. He shall provide the sin offering, grain offering, burnt offering, and peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַנָּשִׂיא יִהְיֶה הָעוֹלוֹת וְהַמִּנְחָה וְהַנֵּסֶךְ בַּחַגִּים וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים וּבַשַּׁבָּתוֹת בְּכָל־מוֹעֲדֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא־יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת־הַחַטָּאת וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֶת־הָעוֹלָה וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָמִים לְכַפֵּר בְּעַד בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: In the first month, on the first of the month, you shall take an unblemished young bull and purify the sanctuary from sin.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תִּקַּח פַּר־בֶּן־בָּקָר תָּמִים וְחִטֵּאתָ אֶת־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ׃

verses.english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the house's doorpost, on the four corners of the altar's ledge, and on the doorpost of the gate of the inner courtyard.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת וְנָתַן אֶל־מְזוּזַת הַבַּיִת וְאֶל־אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הָעֲזָרָה לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעַל־מְזוּזַת שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית׃

verses.english: You shall do the same on the seventh of the month for anyone who errs or is simple, and you shall make atonement for the house.
verses.hebrew: וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּשִׁבְעָה בַחֹדֶשׁ מֵאִישׁ שֹׁגֶה וּמִפֶּתִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a festival of weeks of days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.hebrew: בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַפָּסַח חָג שְׁבֻעוֹת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

verses.english: On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַנָּשִׂיא בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד כָּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ פַּר חַטָּאת׃

verses.english: For the seven days of the festival, he shall provide a burnt offering to YHWH: seven bulls and seven unblemished rams each day for the seven days, and a male goat each day as a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעַת יְמֵי־הֶחָג יַעֲשֶׂה עוֹלָה לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת פָּרִים וְשִׁבְעַת אֵילִים תְּמִימִם לַיּוֹם שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וְחַטָּאת שְׂעִיר עִזִּים לַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: He shall provide a grain offering of an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָה אֵיפָה לַפָּר וְאֵיפָה לָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָה׃

verses.english: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the festival he shall provide the same for the seven days: the sin offering, burnt offering, grain offering, and oil.
verses.hebrew: בַּשְּׁבִיעִי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בֶּחָג יַעֲשֶׂה כָאֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים כַּחַטָּאת כָּעֹלָה וְכַמִּנְחָה וְכַשָּׁמֶן׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: The gate of the inner courtyard facing east shall be shut during the six working days, but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית הַפֹּנֶה קָדִים יִהְיֶה סָגוּר שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יִפָּתֵחַ וּבְיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ יִפָּתֵחַ׃

verses.english: The prince shall enter from outside by the porch of the gate and stand by the gate's doorpost. The priests shall offer his burnt offering and his peace offerings. He shall bow down at the gate's threshold and go out, but the gate shall not be shut until evening.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַנָּשִׂיא דֶּרֶךְ אוּלָם הַשַּׁעַר מִחוּץ וְעָמַד עַל־מְזוּזַת הַשַּׁעַר וְעָשׂוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־עוֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־שְׁלָמָיו וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוָה עַל־מִפְתַּן הַשַּׁעַר וְיָצָא וְהַשַּׁעַר לֹא־יִסָּגֵר עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: The people of the land shall bow down before YHWH at the entrance of that gate on Sabbaths and new moons.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ עַם־הָאָרֶץ פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר הַהוּא בַּשַּׁבָּתוֹת וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The burnt offering the prince presents to YHWH on the Sabbath day shall be six unblemished lambs and an unblemished ram.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִב הַנָּשִׂיא לַיהוָה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שִׁשָּׁה כְבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם וְאַיִל תָּמִים׃

verses.english: The grain offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs a grain offering as his hand gives, with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָה אֵיפָה לָאַיִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂים מִנְחָה מַתַּת יָדוֹ וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָה׃

verses.english: On the day of the new moon there shall be an unblemished young bull, six lambs, and a ram; they shall be unblemished.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר תְּמִימִם וְשֵׁשֶׁת כְּבָשִׂם וָאַיִל תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: He shall provide an ephah for the bull and an ephah for the ram as a grain offering, and for the lambs as much as his hand can afford, with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵיפָה לַפָּר וְאֵיפָה לָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה וְלַכְּבָשִׂים כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָה׃

verses.english: When the prince enters, he shall enter by the porch of the gate and go out by the same way.
verses.hebrew: וּבְבוֹא הַנָּשִׂיא דֶּרֶךְ אוּלָם הַשַּׁעַר יָבוֹא וּבְדַרְכּוֹ יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: When the people of the land come before YHWH at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to bow down shall go out by the south gate, and whoever enters by the south gate shall go out by the north gate. He shall not return by the gate through which he entered; they shall go out straight opposite it.
verses.hebrew: וּבְבוֹא עַם־הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בַּמּוֹעֲדִים הַבָּא דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר צָפוֹן לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת יֵצֵא דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר נֶגֶב וְהַבָּא דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר נֶגֶב יֵצֵא דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר צָפוֹנָה לֹא יָשׁוּב דֶּרֶךְ הַשַּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר־בָּא בוֹ כִּי נִכְחוֹ יצאו [יֵצֵא׃]

verses.english: The prince shall be among them: when they enter, he shall enter, and when they go out, they shall go out.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנָּשִׂיא בְּתוֹכָם בְּבוֹאָם יָבוֹא וּבְצֵאתָם יֵצֵאוּ׃

verses.english: At the festivals and appointed gatherings the grain offering shall be an ephah for each bull, an ephah for each ram, and for the lambs as his hand gives, with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחַגִּים וּבַמּוֹעֲדִים תִּהְיֶה הַמִּנְחָה אֵיפָה לַפָּר וְאֵיפָה לָאַיִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂים מַתַּת יָדוֹ וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָה׃

verses.english: When the prince makes a freewill offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a freewill offering to YHWH, the east-facing gate shall be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering and his peace offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and the gate shall be shut after he goes out.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יַעֲשֶׂה הַנָּשִׂיא נְדָבָה עוֹלָה אוֹ־שְׁלָמִים נְדָבָה לַיהוָה וּפָתַח לוֹ אֶת הַשַּׁעַר הַפֹּנֶה קָדִים וְעָשָׂה אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־שְׁלָמָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת וְיָצָא וְסָגַר אֶת־הַשַּׁעַר אַחֲרֵי צֵאתוֹ׃

verses.english: You shall prepare an unblemished year-old lamb as a daily burnt offering to YHWH; morning by morning you shall prepare it.
verses.hebrew: וְכֶבֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ תָּמִים תַּעֲשֶׂה עוֹלָה לַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: Morning by morning you shall prepare with it a grain offering of a sixth of an ephah and a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour: a grain offering to YHWH, perpetual statutes, continually.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָה תַעֲשֶׂה עָלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר שִׁשִּׁית הָאֵיפָה וְשֶׁמֶן שְׁלִישִׁית הַהִין לָרֹס אֶת־הַסֹּלֶת מִנְחָה לַיהוָה חֻקּוֹת עוֹלָם תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: They shall prepare the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil morning by morning as a continual burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: ועשו [יַעֲשׂוּ] אֶת־הַכֶּבֶשׂ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶן בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר עוֹלַת תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: If the prince gives a gift to one of his sons, it is his inheritance and shall belong to his sons; it is their inherited possession.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה כִּי־יִתֵּן הַנָּשִׂיא מַתָּנָה לְאִישׁ מִבָּנָיו נַחֲלָתוֹ הִיא לְבָנָיו תִּהְיֶה אֲחֻזָּתָם הִיא בְּנַחֲלָה׃

verses.english: If he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall belong to him until the year of release, and then return to the prince. His inheritance shall belong only to his sons.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יִתֵּן מַתָּנָה מִנַּחֲלָתוֹ לְאַחַד מֵעֲבָדָיו וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ עַד־שְׁנַת הַדְּרוֹר וְשָׁבַת לַנָּשִׂיא אַךְ נַחֲלָתוֹ בָּנָיו לָהֶם תִּהְיֶה׃

verses.english: The prince shall not take from the people's inheritance, oppressing them out of their possession. He shall give his sons an inheritance from his own possession, so that none of My people is scattered from his possession.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִקַּח הַנָּשִׂיא מִנַּחֲלַת הָעָם לְהוֹנֹתָם מֵאֲחֻזָּתָם מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַנְחִל אֶת־בָּנָיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָפֻצוּ עַמִּי אִישׁ מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: He brought me through the entrance beside the gate to the priests' holy chambers facing north. Look—there was a place at their far end toward the west.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵנִי בַמָּבוֹא אֲשֶׁר עַל־כֶּתֶף הַשַּׁעַר אֶל־הַלִּשְׁכוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים הַפֹּנוֹת צָפוֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם מָקוֹם בירכתם [בַּיַּרְכָתַיִם] יָמָּה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and sin offering and bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them into the outer courtyard and sanctify the people.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי זֶה הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יְבַשְּׁלוּ־שָׁם הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת־הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יֹאפוּ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹצִיא אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה לְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־הָעָם׃

verses.english: He brought me out into the outer courtyard and led me past its four corners. Look—a courtyard in one corner of the courtyard, and a courtyard in another corner of the courtyard!
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצֹנָה וַיַּעֲבִירֵנִי אֶל־אַרְבַּעַת מִקְצוֹעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְהִנֵּה חָצֵר בְּמִקְצֹעַ הֶחָצֵר חָצֵר בְּמִקְצֹעַ הֶחָצֵר׃

verses.english: In the four corners of the courtyard were enclosed courts, forty long and thirty wide; all four corner courts had one measure.
verses.hebrew: בְּאַרְבַּעַת מִקְצֹעוֹת הֶחָצֵר חֲצֵרוֹת קְטֻרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים אֹרֶךְ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים רֹחַב מִדָּה אַחַת לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם מְהֻקְצָעוֹת׃

verses.english: There was a row all around them, around all four, with cooking places made underneath the rows all around.
verses.hebrew: וְטוּר סָבִיב בָּהֶם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם וּמְבַשְּׁלוֹת עָשׂוּי מִתַּחַת הַטִּירוֹת סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He said to me, “These are the cooking houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the people's sacrifices.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי אֵלֶּה בֵּית הַמְבַשְּׁלִים אֲשֶׁר יְבַשְּׁלוּ־שָׁם מְשָׁרְתֵי הַבַּיִת אֶת־זֶבַח הָעָם׃

verses.english: He brought me back to the house's entrance, and look—water was flowing out from beneath the house's threshold toward the east, for the house faced east. The water was descending from below the house's right side, south of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשִׁבֵנִי אֶל־פֶּתַח הַבַּיִת וְהִנֵּה־מַיִם יֹצְאִים מִתַּחַת מִפְתַּן הַבַּיִת קָדִימָה כִּי־פְנֵי הַבַּיִת קָדִים וְהַמַּיִם יֹרְדִים מִתַּחַת מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית מִנֶּגֶב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: He brought me out by the north gate and led me around outside to the outer gate facing east. Look—water was trickling from the right side.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִאֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר צָפוֹנָה וַיְסִבֵּנִי דֶּרֶךְ חוּץ אֶל־שַׁעַר הַחוּץ דֶּרֶךְ הַפּוֹנֶה קָדִים וְהִנֵּה־מַיִם מְפַכִּים מִן־הַכָּתֵף הַיְמָנִית׃

verses.english: As the man went east with a line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits and led me through the water—ankle-deep water.
verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאת־הָאִישׁ קָדִים וְקָו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף בָּאַמָּה וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי בַמַּיִם מֵי אָפְסָיִם׃

verses.english: He measured a thousand and led me through knee-deep water. He measured a thousand and led me through waist-deep water.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי בַמַּיִם מַיִם בִּרְכָּיִם וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי מֵי מָתְנָיִם׃

verses.english: He measured a thousand—a river I could not cross, for the water had risen, water for swimming, a river that could not be crossed.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף נַחַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר כִּי־גָאוּ הַמַּיִם מֵי שָׂחוּ נַחַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֵעָבֵר׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man?” Then he led me back to the riverbank.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הֲרָאִיתָ בֶן־אָדָם וַיּוֹלִכֵנִי וַיְשִׁבֵנִי שְׂפַת הַנָּחַל׃

verses.english: When I returned, look—very many trees were on the riverbank, on both sides.
verses.hebrew: בְּשׁוּבֵנִי וְהִנֵּה אֶל־שְׂפַת הַנַּחַל עֵץ רַב מְאֹד מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה׃

verses.english: He said to me, “These waters flow out to the eastern district, descend to the Arabah, and enter the sea—the waters being brought out into the sea—and the waters shall be healed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הַמַּיִם הָאֵלֶּה יוֹצְאִים אֶל־הַגְּלִילָה הַקַּדְמוֹנָה וְיָרְדוּ עַל־הָעֲרָבָה וּבָאוּ הַיָּמָּה אֶל־הַיָּמָּה הַמּוּצָאִים ונרפאו [וְנִרְפּוּ] הַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: Every living creature that swarms wherever the streams come shall live. There shall be very many fish, because these waters have come there, and the waters shall be healed. Everything shall live wherever the river comes.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כָל־נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה אֲ‍שֶׁר־יִשְׁרֹץ אֶל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יָבוֹא שָׁם נַחֲלַיִם יִחְיֶה וְהָיָה הַדָּגָה רַבָּה מְאֹד כִּי בָאוּ שָׁמָּה הַמַּיִם הָאֵלֶּה וְיֵרָפְאוּ וָחָי כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יָבוֹא שָׁמָּה הַנָּחַל׃

verses.english: Fishers shall stand along it from En-gedi to En-eglaim; there shall be places for spreading nets. Their fish shall be of their kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea, very many.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה יעמדו [עָמְדוּ] עָלָיו דַּוָּגִים מֵעֵין גֶּדִי וְעַד־עֵין עֶגְלַיִם מִשְׁטוֹחַ לַחֲרָמִים יִהְיוּ לְמִינָה תִּהְיֶה דְגָתָם כִּדְגַת הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל רַבָּה מְאֹד׃

verses.english: Its swamps and marshes shall not be healed; they are given over to salt.
verses.hebrew: בצאתו [בִּצֹּאתָיו] וּגְבָאָיו וְלֹא יֵרָפְאוּ לְמֶלַח נִתָּנוּ׃

verses.english: Along the river, on its bank on both sides, every kind of food-bearing tree shall grow. Its leaf shall not wither and its fruit shall not fail; month by month it shall bear fresh fruit, because its waters come out from the sanctuary. Its fruit shall be for food and its leaf for healing.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַנַּחַל יַעֲלֶה עַל־שְׂפָתוֹ מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה כָּל־עֵץ־מַאֲכָל לֹא־יִבּוֹל עָלֵהוּ וְלֹא־יִתֹּם פִּרְיוֹ לָחֳדָשָׁיו יְבַכֵּר כִּי מֵימָיו מִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הֵמָּה יוֹצְאִים והיו [וְהָיָה] פִרְיוֹ לְמַאֲכָל וְעָלֵהוּ לִתְרוּפָה׃

verses.english: Thus says Lord YHWH: This is the boundary by which you shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel; Joseph shall have portions.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה גֵּה גְבוּל אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יוֹסֵף חֲבָלִים׃

verses.english: You shall inherit it, each like his brother, the land I lifted My hand to give to your fathers. This land shall fall to you as an inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וּנְחַלְתֶּם אוֹתָהּ אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־יָדִי לְתִתָּהּ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וְנָפְלָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה׃

verses.english: This is the boundary of the land on the north side: from the Great Sea by the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Zedad,
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה גְּבוּל הָאָרֶץ לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל הַדֶּרֶךְ חֶתְלֹן לְבוֹא צְדָדָה׃

verses.english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which lies between the territory of Damascus and the territory of Hamath, and Hazer-hatticon, which is on the boundary of Hauran.
verses.hebrew: חֲמָת בֵּרוֹתָה סִבְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בֵּין־גְּבוּל דַּמֶּשֶׂק וּבֵין גְּבוּל חֲמָת חָצֵר הַתִּיכוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶל־גְּבוּל חַוְרָן׃

verses.english: The boundary shall run from the sea to Hazar-enon, the boundary of Damascus, and northward to the north, with the boundary of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה גְבוּל מִן־הַיָּם חֲצַר עֵינוֹן גְּבוּל דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְצָפוֹן צָפוֹנָה וּגְבוּל חֲמָת וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן׃

verses.english: The east side runs between Hauran and Damascus, and between Gilead and the land of Israel, along the Jordan. You shall measure from the boundary to the eastern sea. This is the east side.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת קָדִים מִבֵּין חַוְרָן וּמִבֵּין־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וּמִבֵּין הַגִּלְעָד וּמִבֵּין אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִגְּבוּל עַל־הַיָּם הַקַּדְמוֹנִי תָּמֹדּוּ וְאֵת פְּאַת קָדִימָה׃

verses.english: The south side toward the south runs from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, along the wadi to the Great Sea. This is the southern side toward the south.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה מִתָּמָר עַד־מֵי מְרִיבוֹת קָדֵשׁ נַחֲלָה אֶל־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וְאֵת פְּאַת־תֵּימָנָה נֶגְבָּה׃

verses.english: The west side is the Great Sea, from the boundary to opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת־יָם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מִגְּבוּל עַד־נֹכַח לְבוֹא חֲמָת זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃

verses.english: You shall divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְחִלַּקְתֶּם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לְשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: You shall allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the sojourners dwelling among you who have fathered children among you. They shall be to you as native-born among the sons of Israel; with you they shall receive an inheritance among Israel's tribes.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה תַּפִּלוּ אוֹתָהּ בְּנַחֲלָה לָכֶם וּלְהַגֵּרִים הַגָּרִים בְּתוֹכְכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹלִדוּ בָנִים בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם כְּאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתְּכֶם יִפְּלוּ בְנַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: In whatever tribe the sojourner dwells, there you shall give him his inheritance—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַשֵּׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר־גָּר הַגֵּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם תִּתְּנוּ נַחֲלָתוֹ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: These are the names of the tribes: from the northern extremity, alongside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan, the northern boundary of Damascus beside Hamath, extending from the eastern side to the sea—Dan, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַשְּׁבָטִים מִקְצֵה צָפוֹנָה אֶל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ־חֶתְלֹן לְבוֹא־חֲמָת חֲצַר עֵינָן גְּבוּל דַּמֶּשֶׂק צָפוֹנָה אֶל־יַד חֲמָת וְהָיוּ־לוֹ פְאַת־קָדִים הַיָּם דָּן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Dan's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Asher, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל דָּן מִפְּאַת קָדִים עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה אָשֵׁר אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Asher's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Naphtali, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל אָשֵׁר מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Naphtali's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Manasseh, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל נַפְתָּלִי מִפְּאַת קָדִמָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Manasseh's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Ephraim, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִפְּאַת קָדִמָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה אֶפְרַיִם אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Ephraim's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Reuben, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל אֶפְרַיִם מִפְּאַת קָדִים וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה רְאוּבֵן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Reuben's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Judah, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל רְאוּבֵן מִפְּאַת קָדִים עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה יְהוּדָה אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Judah's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side, shall be the contribution you set aside, twenty-five thousand in breadth, with a length like one of the portions from the eastern side to the western side. The sanctuary shall be in its midst.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל יְהוּדָה מִפְּאַת קָדִים עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה תִּהְיֶה הַתְּרוּמָה אֲ‍שֶׁר־תָּרִימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף רֹחַב וְאֹרֶךְ כְּאַחַד הַחֲלָקִים מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה וְהָיָה הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בְּתוֹכוֹ׃

verses.english: The contribution you set aside for YHWH shall be twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad.
verses.hebrew: הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּרִימוּ לַיהוָה אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וְרֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים׃

verses.english: The holy contribution shall belong to these—to the priests: twenty-five thousand on the north, a breadth of ten thousand on the west, a breadth of ten thousand on the east, and a length of twenty-five thousand on the south. The sanctuary of YHWH shall be in its midst.
verses.hebrew: וּלְאֵלֶּה תִּהְיֶה תְרוּמַת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ לַכֹּהֲנִים צָפוֹנָה חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וְיָמָּה רֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְקָדִימָה רֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְנֶגְבָּה אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וְהָיָה מִקְדַּשׁ־יְהוָה בְּתוֹכוֹ׃

verses.english: It shall be for the consecrated priests among the sons of Zadok, who kept My charge and did not stray when the sons of Israel strayed, as the Levites strayed.
verses.hebrew: לַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְקֻדָּשׁ מִבְּנֵי צָדוֹק אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תָעוּ בִּתְעוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּעוּ הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: They shall have a contribution from the contribution of the land, most holy, beside the Levites' boundary.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם תְּרוּמִיָּה מִתְּרוּמַת הָאָרֶץ קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים אֶל־גְּבוּל הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: The Levites shall have land alongside the priests' boundary, twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand broad. The entire length shall be twenty-five thousand and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם לְעֻמַּת גְּבוּל הַכֹּהֲנִים חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אֹרֶךְ וְרֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כָּל־אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וְרֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים׃

verses.english: They shall not sell any of it, nor exchange it; the first portion of the land shall not be transferred, for it is holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִמְכְּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא יָמֵר וְלֹא יעבור [יַעֲבִיר] רֵאשִׁית הָאָרֶץ כִּי־קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: The five thousand remaining in breadth alongside the twenty-five thousand shall be for the city's common use, for dwelling and open ground. The city shall be in its midst.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים הַנּוֹתָר בָּרֹחַב עַל־פְּנֵי חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף חֹל־הוּא לָעִיר לְמוֹשָׁב וּלְמִגְרָשׁ וְהָיְתָה הָעִיר בתוכה [בְּתוֹכוֹ׃]

verses.english: These are its measurements: on the north side, four thousand five hundred; on the south side, four thousand five hundred; on the east side, four thousand five hundred; and on the west side, four thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מִדּוֹתֶיהָ פְּאַת צָפוֹן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים וּפְאַת־נֶגֶב חֲמֵשׁ חמש מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים וּמִפְּאַת קָדִים חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים וּפְאַת־יָמָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים׃

verses.english: The city shall have open ground: two hundred fifty to the north, two hundred fifty to the south, two hundred fifty to the east, and two hundred fifty to the west.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מִגְרָשׁ לָעִיר צָפוֹנָה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם וְנֶגְבָּה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם וְקָדִימָה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם וְיָמָּה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: The remaining length alongside the holy contribution, ten thousand to the east and ten thousand to the west, shall lie alongside the holy contribution. Its produce shall be food for the city's workers.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר בָּאֹרֶךְ לְעֻמַּת תְּרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים קָדִימָה וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים יָמָּה וְהָיָה לְעֻמַּת תְּרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהָיְתָה תבואתה [תְבוּאָתוֹ] לְלֶחֶם לְעֹבְדֵי הָעִיר׃

verses.english: The city's workers, from all Israel's tribes, shall cultivate it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹבֵד הָעִיר יַעַבְדוּהוּ מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The entire contribution shall be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall set aside the holy contribution as a square, together with the city's possession.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַתְּרוּמָה חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף בַּחֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף רְבִיעִית תָּרִימוּ אֶת־תְּרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר׃

verses.english: The remainder shall belong to the prince on both sides of the holy contribution and the city's possession: alongside the contribution's twenty-five thousand as far as the eastern boundary, and westward alongside the twenty-five thousand as far as the western boundary, corresponding to the other portions, for the prince. The holy contribution and the house's sanctuary shall be in its midst.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר לַנָּשִׂיא מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לִתְרוּמַת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר אֶל־פְּנֵי חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף תְּרוּמָה עַד־גְּבוּל קָדִימָה וְיָמָּה עַל־פְּנֵי חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף עַל־גְּבוּל יָמָּה לְעֻמַּת חֲלָקִים לַנָּשִׂיא וְהָיְתָה תְּרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמִקְדַּשׁ הַבַּיִת בתוכה [בְּתוֹכוֹ׃]

verses.english: Apart from the Levites' possession and the city's possession, which lie in the midst of what belongs to the prince, the land between Judah's boundary and Benjamin's boundary shall belong to the prince.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֲחֻזַּת הַלְוִיִּם וּמֵאֲחֻזַּת הָעִיר בְּתוֹךְ אֲשֶׁר לַנָּשִׂיא יִהְיֶה בֵּין גְּבוּל יְהוּדָה וּבֵין גְּבוּל בִּנְיָמִן לַנָּשִׂיא יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: As for the remaining tribes, from the eastern side to the western side—Benjamin, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר הַשְּׁבָטִים מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה בִּנְיָמִן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Benjamin's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Simeon, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל בִּנְיָמִן מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה שִׁמְעוֹן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Simeon's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Issachar, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל שִׁמְעוֹן מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה יִשָׂשכָר אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Issachar's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Zebulun, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל יִשָׂשכָר מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה זְבוּלֻן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Zebulun's boundary, from the eastern side to the western side—Gad, one portion.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל זְבוּלֻן מִפְּאַת קָדִמָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָמָּה גָּד אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Beside Gad's boundary on the southern side toward the south, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, along the wadi to the Great Sea.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל גְּבוּל גָּד אֶל־פְּאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה וְהָיָה גְבוּל מִתָּמָר מֵי מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ נַחֲלָה עַל־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל׃

verses.english: This is the land you shall allot as an inheritance to Israel's tribes, and these are their portions—declares Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּפִּילוּ מִנַּחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵלֶּה מַחְלְקוֹתָם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: These are the city's exits: on the north side, four thousand five hundred by measure.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹצְאֹת הָעִיר מִפְּאַת צָפוֹן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים מִדָּה׃

verses.english: The city's gates shall bear the names of Israel's tribes. Three gates shall face north: one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, and one gate of Levi.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׁעֲרֵי הָעִיר עַל־שְׁמוֹת שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁעָרִים שְׁלוֹשָׁה צָפוֹנָה שַׁעַר רְאוּבֵן אֶחָד שַׁעַר יְהוּדָה אֶחָד שַׁעַר לֵוִי אֶחָד׃

verses.english: On the east side, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, and one gate of Dan.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־פְּאַת קָדִימָה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁעָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וְשַׁעַר יוֹסֵף אֶחָד שַׁעַר בִּנְיָמִן אֶחָד שַׁעַר דָּן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: On the south side, four thousand five hundred by measure, with three gates: one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, and one gate of Zebulun.
verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים מִדָּה וּשְׁעָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה שַׁעַר שִׁמְעוֹן אֶחָד שַׁעַר יִשָּׂשכָר אֶחָד שַׁעַר זְבוּלֻן אֶחָד׃

verses.english: On the west side, four thousand five hundred, with their three gates: one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, and one gate of Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: פְּאַת־יָמָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים שַׁעֲרֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה שַׁעַר גָּד אֶחָד שַׁעַר אָשֵׁר אֶחָד שַׁעַר נַפְתָּלִי אֶחָד׃

verses.english: The circuit shall be eighteen thousand. From that day the city's name shall be ‘YHWH Is There.’”
verses.hebrew: סָבִיב שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר מִיּוֹם יְהוָה שָׁמָּה׃
